It solves the problem of having too many features and bloated apps and having very minimal support for locally stored wallpapers. What if you just wanted an app that allows you to browse and select your own locally stored wallpapers and lets you manage and set wallpapers from there? then Peristyle is for you :)

 Simple architecture, browse wallpapers and use system wallpaper manager to set them as wallpaper.
 Multiple folders support.

izzyondroid:net.snapdrop.name: Pairdrop Snapdrop
izzyondroid:net.snapdrop.summary: Transfer files between phones and laptops on same wifi
izzyondroid:net.snapdrop.description:
Snapdrop can be used to transfer files between phones and laptops on same wifi. The app is a wrapper around the snapdrop project using webview and some javascript interface for downloads.
 Using Snapdrop is as easy as this:
 Open Snapdrop app (or visit www.snapdrop.net).
 Tap on a device name and select files to transfer.
 Make sure both devices are connected to same Wifi or hotspot.
 NOTE: You can create hotspot on one phone, connect other devices to it and then transfer files using the app or the website.
 KNOWN ISSUES: 
 Might not work with VPN enabled on your devices.
 The app renames all the downloaded files to something starting with Snapdrop_. You'll find these files in your Downloads folder.
 There are times when it just won't work and there's nothing anyone can do about it. Sorry. Please refresh, restart or try again later.
 If the problem doesn't go away, report your issue .
 CREDIT: 
 This app and logo is based on the free and open source Snapdrop project by Robin Linus .
 APP: 
 Developed by Tanuj. Free and open source . No login, no ads.
 FEATURE REQUESTS: 
 Features are chosen very carefully because complexity grows exponentially with each other feature. We focus very narrowly on a single use case: instant file transfer. Please don't be sad if we decline your feature request for the sake of simplicity. Thank you for understanding.
 PRIVACY: 
 None of your files are ever sent to any server. Files go directly from one device to another and are encrypted by default.

fdroid:com.chmouel.liseur.name: Liseur
fdroid:com.chmouel.liseur.summary: A modern, open-source EPUB reader with powerful reading features.
fdroid:com.chmouel.liseur.description:
Read EPUBs your way: follow the text as it reads aloud, translate a page as you go, or ask about characters and events. Liseur brings books from your phone, OPDS catalogs, calibre-web, Komga, BookOrbit and liseur-sync into one library.
Read aloud
Listen to any EPUB with sentence highlighting and automatic page turns. Android voices can read offline when a compatible offline voice is installed. Choose voices by language, adjust the speed, keep listening with the screen off, or set a sleep timer. Connect an OpenAI-compatible speech server, including one on your own network.
Translation
Translate a selection or read a book page by page in another language. Liseur saves translated sentences on your phone, so they are ready when you return to a page. Use Android's on-device translator or an OpenAI-compatible service on your network or hosted online. Read translated pages aloud in the target language and look up words without leaving the page.
Reading companion
Ask the reading companion about characters and events. Character profiles use passages before the selected text, including earlier chapters and earlier passages in the current chapter; source excerpts show where details come from. Turn on background chapter recaps for each book. Use an OpenAI-compatible service.
Even without an AI service, the companion builds a searchable, on-device index of people, places and groups, and shows which names appear together in earlier chapters. It finds names by their capital letters, so a script without letter case, such as Chinese, is not indexed. It needs no API key.
Your reader
Choose paginated pages or continuous scroll, adjust type, margins and brightness, and use light, sepia, dark or black themes. Add highlights, notes and bookmarks, search the full text, and open footnotes in a popup. Import your own fonts or use the bundled and publisher fonts. E-ink mode turns off animations and supports refresh controls on Onyx devices.
Your library and sync
Browse local folders and SD cards, group books into series, or find free books in the built-in Project Gutenberg catalog. Home-screen widgets show your current book or a shelf of covers. Back up settings, fonts, reading positions and annotations in a ZIP file.
Sync reading positions with calibre-web, Komga, BookOrbit or liseur-sync. Connect any OPDS catalog to a KOReader sync server. With liseur-sync, back up settings per device and see reading statistics across devices.
Privacy
No ads. You do not need an account to read books on your device. Android's system translator and the companion's on-device index process book text on your phone. When you choose an online service for translation, the reading companion or speech, Liseur sends text to that provider. Optional dictionary lookups contact Wiktionary; browsing the catalog also contacts Project Gutenberg.
MIT licensed. Source code and issue tracker: https://github.com/chmouel/liseur

fdroid:com.juliencardoux.openwol.name: OpenWOL
fdroid:com.juliencardoux.openwol.summary: OpenWOL is a simple, private and efficient Wake-on-LAN app for Android.
fdroid:com.juliencardoux.openwol.description:
OpenWOL is a simple, private and efficient Wake-on-LAN app for Android.
Send a Magic Packet to any device on your local network with a single tap. No account, no cloud, no tracking — everything stays on your device and your local network.
 FEATURES 
- Send Wake-on-LAN Magic Packets to wake up devices on your local network
- Create automations to trigger a wake up command on a specific SSID (WiFi) connection
- Notify (if enabled) when an automation is triggered
- Privacy first: no tracking, no ads, zero data collection and fully open-source
- No network scanning & no background pings
- Simple and straight to the point app
 PERMISSIONS 
Location permissions (ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION) are used exclusively to read the Wi-Fi network name (SSID) in order to trigger automations. Android requires these permissions to access the SSID. No location data is ever collected, stored, or shared. These permissions are only requested when the user enables the optional Automations feature.
 SETUP 
1. Enable Wake-on-LAN in your device's BIOS (look for "Wake on Magic Packet" or "Power On By PCI-E").
2. On Windows, enable "Wake on Magic Packet" in Device Manager under your network adapter's Advanced properties.
3. Add your device in OpenWOL and tap its card to send a Magic Packet.
4. Optionally, create an Automation to wake your device automatically when connecting to your home Wi-Fi.
 PRIVACY 
OpenWOL collects no data. There are no analytics, no ads, no trackers. Location permissions are used only to read the Wi-Fi SSID for automations, no location data is ever stored or shared. Automations are optional and the app works fully without them.

fdroid:com.keycardpal.offline.name: Keycard Pal Offline
fdroid:com.keycardpal.offline.summary: Sign Ethereum and Bitcoin by QR code with a Keycard NFC smart card
fdroid:com.keycardpal.offline.description:
Keycard Pal is a hardware wallet companion app. It works with a Keycard NFC smart card to sign Ethereum and Bitcoin transactions, and the key on the card never leaves it.
Requires a Keycard hardware smart card (keycard.tech). The app talks to the card over NFC: no USB, no Bluetooth.
Your wallet and Keycard Pal talk through animated QR codes. The wallet shows a request, you review it in Keycard Pal, tap your card, and show the signature back. No network connection is needed for any of it.
The phone handles key material only when you ask it to: a recovery phrase or SLIP-39 shares while you generate, import or verify them, and secrets you derive with BIP-85.
Features:
- Sign Ethereum transactions (legacy, EIP-1559, EIP-2930)
- Sign EIP-712 typed data with decoded preview before approval
- Sign personal messages (EIP-191 / SIWE)
- Sign Bitcoin transactions via PSBT
- Sign Bitcoin messages (BIP-322)
- Export wallet keys to MetaMask, Rabby, Ledger Live, Sparrow, BlueWallet, and Bitget via UR QR codes
- Generate a key pair on the card, or import a recovery phrase (BIP-39) or SLIP-39 shares
- Derive BIP-85 secrets from the card's key and show them on the phone: recovery phrases, WIF and XPRV keys, hex entropy and passwords (needs a Keycard with applet 4 or later)
- Genuine Keycard check
- No telemetry, no analytics, no account
Keycard Pal comes in two builds:
- Keycard Pal Offline (com.keycardpal.offline) has no internet permission. It cannot make a network connection.
- Keycard Pal (com.keycardpal) has the internet permission for optional features: WalletConnect, ENS names, transaction simulation with Tenderly, token images, and downloading the clear-signing descriptor registry. Each one is off until you turn it on in Settings. WalletConnect needs your own Reown Project ID and simulation needs your own Tenderly API key.
Keycard Pal is free and open-source software.
Keycard Pal is made by an independent developer, not by Keycard. The Keycard team has provided equipment for its development.

fdroid:com.vocahq.vocaphone.name: VocaPhone
fdroid:com.vocahq.vocaphone.summary: Voice dictation keyboard that transcribes on hardware you control
fdroid:com.vocahq.vocaphone.description:
Speak into your phone and the text shows up where you are already typing. VocaPhone is a system keyboard: switch to it in any app, dictate, and the transcript is inserted at your cursor through Android's normal input method interface.
Transcription never touches a cloud speech service. It runs either on your own device or on a machine you already own and administer via a self-hosted gateway. There are no accounts, no analytics SDK, and no subscription. The Play build offers optional anonymous usage reporting, off unless you turn it on, reporting to a server the developers self-host; it never includes your speech, your text, or your gateway address. The F-Droid build has it compiled out entirely.
 Two ways to transcribe 
- On device. Download a Whisper model once and dictate with no network at all. The speech engine is whisper.cpp, compiled from source as part of the app. Models range from a few tens of megabytes to several gigabytes, and the app recommends one that fits your phone's memory. Where available, the catalog also includes sherpa-onnx models such as Parakeet.
- Through your own gateway. Point the app at VocaGateway running on your Mac, Linux desktop, or home server, and that machine does the work. This is the faster option for large models and lets a phone use hardware it does not have.
You choose the network path to your gateway: a trusted LAN, a private Tailscale network, or HTTPS behind your own reverse proxy. Access uses bearer tokens issued per device, which you can name and revoke individually, and pairing can be done by scanning a QR code.
 Dictation 
- 54 selectable languages plus automatic detection: English, Mandarin Chinese, Cantonese, Spanish, French, German, Russian, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Ukrainian, Czech, Slovak, Slovenian, Croatian, Serbian, Bulgarian, Romanian, Hungarian, Greek, Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, Finnish, Estonian, Latvian, Lithuanian, Maltese, Catalan, Turkish, Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Swahili, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, Malay and Filipino, along with Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Gujarati, Urdu, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi, Assamese and Nepali
- Four writing styles: Formal, Casual, Very Casual and Excited, with punctuation that follows the script rather than assuming a Latin full stop
- Start, finish, cancel, retry and undo, all from the keyboard
- Automatic microphone routing, or pick an input explicitly, with the microphone in use shown in the app
- Bluetooth headset microphones are supported
 Permissions 
The keyboard writes through InputConnection and never reads the contents of the field you are typing into. Camera access is requested only when you tap "Scan QR" to pair with a gateway, and the microphone is used only while a dictation is running, with a foreground service notification for the duration.
 About this build 
The build distributed here is compiled entirely from source. It leaves out the optional sherpa-onnx speech engine, which upstream ships as a prebuilt binary library, so on-device transcription uses the Whisper model catalog. Gateway transcription is unaffected and can use any engine your gateway supports. On supported builds, sherpa-onnx models such as Parakeet are available alongside Whisper.
VocaPhone is part of the Voca family alongside VocaLinux and VocaMac. Report issues on the GitHub issue tracker.

fdroid:fr.counted.app.name: Counted
fdroid:fr.counted.app.summary: Split expenses with friends. Encrypted, no account, free, 100% European.
fdroid:fr.counted.app.description:
Counted is the expense-splitting app for friends: 100% European, private by design, with an environmental mission. Holiday, flat share, weekend, group gift: log your expenses and Counted tells you who owes how much to whom, in the fewest transfers.
🔗 No account needed
Create a project, send the link. That is it. Your friends join and take part without signing up. An account? Never required. It is for finding your projects on another device, inviting friends from the app and sharing your payment details.
🔒 Encrypted on your phone
Names, amounts, projects, history: everything is encrypted on your phone. Only you hold the key. Nobody can read your books, not even us. Your password, too, never leaves your phone.
📷 Receipt scanning, on your phone
Take a photo of the receipt: amount, date and category fill in on their own. Everything happens on your phone. The photo is not kept.
🇪🇺 100% European
Servers in Germany, emails sent from France. Your projects never leave the European Union.
💸 Free, really
Free, with no ads, no trackers and no cap on expenses or participants. Everything described here is free and stays free. We collect nothing, we do not sell your data. That is not our model.
✨ Everything for shared expenses
• Expenses, transfers and gains, with several payers and several beneficiaries
• Split equally, by shares or by exact amount, checked to the cent
• The fewest transfers to settle the group
• Recurring expenses like rent or subscriptions: entered once, added every time they fall due

fdroid:org.joinmastodon.android.name: Mastodon
fdroid:org.joinmastodon.android.description:
Mastodon is the best way to keep up with what’s happening. Follow anyone across the fediverse and see it all in chronological order. No algorithms, ads, or clickbait in sight.
This is the official Android app for Mastodon. It is blazing fast and stunningly beautiful, designed to be not just powerful but also easy to use. In our app, you can:
EXPLORE
■ Discover new writers, journalists, artists, photographers, scientists and more
■ See what’s happening in the world
READ
■ Keep up with people you care about in a chronological feed with no interruptions
■ Follow hashtags to keep up with specific topics in real time
CREATE
■ Post to your followers or the whole world, with polls, high quality images and videos
■ Participate in interesting conversations with other people
CURATE
■ Create lists of people to never miss a post
■ Filter words or phrases to control what you do and don’t want to see
AND MORE!
■ A beautiful theme that adapts to your personalized color scheme, light or dark
■ Share and scan QR codes to quickly exchange Mastodon profiles with others
■ Login and switch between multiple accounts
■ Get notified when a specific person posts with the bell button
■ No spoilers! You can put your posts behind content warnings
A POWERFUL PUBLISHING PLATFORM
You no longer have to try and appease an opaque algorithm that decides if your friends are going to see what you posted. If they follow you, they’ll see it.
If you publish it to the open web, it’s accessible on the open web. You can safely share links to Mastodon in the knowledge that anyone will be able to read them without logging in.
Between threads, polls, high quality images, videos, audio, and content warnings, Mastodon offers plenty of ways to express yourself in a way that suits you.
A POWERFUL READING PLATFORM
We don’t need to show you ads, so we don’t need to keep you in our app. Mastodon has the richest selection of 3rd party apps and integrations so you can choose the experience that fits you best. 
Thanks to the chronological home feed, it’s easy to tell when you’ve caught up on all updates and can move on to something else.
No need to worry that a misclick will ruin your recommendations forever. We don’t guess what you want to see, we let you control it.
PROTOCOLS, NOT PLATFORMS
Mastodon is not like a traditional social media platform, but is built on a decentralized protocol. You can sign up on our official server, or choose a 3rd party to host your data and moderate your experience.
Thanks to the common protocol, no matter what you choose, you can communicate seamlessly with people on other Mastodon servers. But there’s more: With just one account, you can communicate with people from other fediverse platforms.
Not happy with your choice? You can always switch to a different Mastodon server while taking your followers with you. For advanced users, you can even host your data on your own infrastructure, since Mastodon is open-source.
NON-PROFIT IN NATURE
Mastodon is a registered non-profit in the US and Germany. We are not motivated by extracting monetary value from the platform, but by what’s best for the platform.
AS FEATURED IN: TIME, Forbes, Wired, The Guardian, CNN, The Verge, TechCrunch, Financial Times, Gizmodo, PCMAG.com, and more.

• Cloud synchronization

• Unlock with Touch ID

SECURITY FEATURES
• All data is encrypted, including Entry names, Category definitions and the data itself.
• Encrypts data using AES or Blowfish algorithms with key sizes of 256, 192 or 128 bits.
• When the data file is decrypted, up to all combinations of algorithm and key size are tried with the Master password to unlock the data file. The app itself does not store any hint to the actual cipher or key size.
• Uses a randomly generated 'salt' combined with the Master password. Salt helps to protect from off-line dictionary attacks.
• The key to open the data file is created by combining your master password with the 512-bit 'salt'. The result is hashed 1000 times by SHA-256. Repetitive hashing makes a brute force attack more difficult.
• Supports auto destruction of the data file after a predefined number of unsuccessful unlocks have been tried.
For more info see http://www.awallet.org/

DevKit is the developer toolbox you already keep open in a browser tab, rebuilt as a native app for iPhone, iPad and Mac — and it works with the radio off.
Paste something and DevKit works out what it is. A JSON Web Token, a certificate, a cron line, a CIDR block, a colour, a hex digest: it recognises the shape and offers the right tool.
WHAT YOU GET FREE
• JSON Format — pretty-print, minify and validate, keeping your key order and number literals
• JWT Decode — header, claims and expiry, with optional HMAC verification
• Base64 — standard and URL-safe, padded or not
• URL Encode — query, form and path semantics
• Regex Tester — matches, capture groups, named groups, replace and split
• Hash — MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512
• UUID Generate — version 4 and time-ordered version 7, in bulk
• Unix Time — epoch seconds, milliseconds, microseconds and nanoseconds, any time zone
• Colour Convert — HEX, RGB, HSL, HSB, CMYK, with WCAG contrast ratios
• String Case — camel, snake, kebab, Pascal and eight more, all at once
• Number Base — binary, octal, decimal, hex and any base from 2 to 36, with a bit view
• Text Diff — line-by-line comparison with counts
WHAT PRO ADDS

Pro also unlocks unlimited history, iCloud sync of your favourites and history, Home Screen widgets, and the share extension.
BUILT FOR HOW YOU WORK

• Send selected text straight to DevKit from any app, or from the Services menu on a Mac
• Search and keyboard shortcuts on iPad and Mac, and a menu bar popover on macOS

PRIVACY, PLAINLY
DevKit makes no network requests. It has no account, no analytics and no third-party SDKs. Everything you paste is processed on your device. History is stored locally, you can turn off saving previews, and you can erase everything from Settings. One purchase covers your iPhone, iPad and Mac.

apple-macos:6770101349.name: mono - private messenger
apple-macos:6770101349.description:
the app to have that conversation.
one line. two people.
mono is an encrypted 1-to-1 messaging app.
you can have only one conversation at a time — no chat lists, groups, channels, or feeds. you connect via a unique, ephemeral 18-character key that
rotates every 180 seconds.
no matchmaking, stranger discovery, or public directory. no one can reach you unless you deliberately shared a key with them.
no registration, no identity
no name, email, phone, or personal data. no profile picture, no history, no trace — nothing tied to your real identity.
radical privacy
every message is end-to-end encrypted — only you and the other person can read it. not mono, not any server, not anyone else.
ephemeral messages
only the last 15 messages stay visible. the rest is permanently deleted.
cut the line
either person can cut the line — everything is deleted for both, instantly and permanently.
screenshot protection (iphone and mac)
messages, keys, photos, videos, and files stay hidden from screenshots and screen recordings.
optional protection
face id, passcode, keyword lock, and an emergency panic pin.
36-hour rule
after 36 hours of inactivity, the entire conversation is permanently deleted for both.
no notifications
no badges, no banners, no sounds.
no extras
just text, images, videos, and files. no calls, video calls, or voice notes.
view once
images, videos, and files open once per person, then lock for good.

flathub:org.telegram.desktop.name: Telegram
flathub:org.telegram.desktop.description:
Pure instant messaging — simple, fast, secure, and synced across all your devices. One of the
 world's top 10 most downloaded apps with over 500 million active users.
 FAST: Telegram is the fastest messaging app on the market, connecting people via a unique, distributed
 network of data centers around the globe.
 SYNCED: You can access your messages from all your phones, tablets and computers at once. Telegram
 apps are standalone, so you don’t need to keep your phone connected. Start typing on one device
 and finish the message from another. Never lose your data again.
 UNLIMITED: You can send media and files, without any limits on their type and size. Your entire
 chat history will require no disk space on your device, and will be securely stored in the Telegram
 cloud for as long as you need it.
 SECURE: We made it our mission to provide the best security combined with ease of use. Everything
 on Telegram, including chats, groups, media, etc. is encrypted using a combination of 256-bit symmetric
 AES encryption, 2048-bit RSA encryption, and Diffie–Hellman secure key exchange.
 100% FREE & OPEN: Telegram has a fully documented and free API for developers, open source
 apps and verifiable builds to prove the app you download is built from the exact same source code
 that is published.
 POWERFUL: You can create group chats with up to 200,000 members, share large videos, documents
 of any type (.DOCX, .MP3, .ZIP, etc.) up to 2 GB each, and even set up bots for specific tasks.
 Telegram is the perfect tool for hosting online communities and coordinating teamwork.
 RELIABLE: Built to deliver your messages using as little data as possible, Telegram is the most
 reliable messaging system ever made. It works even on the weakest mobile connections.
 FUN: Telegram has powerful photo and video editing tools, animated stickers and emoji, fully
 customizable themes to change the appearance of your app, and an open sticker/GIF platform to cater
 to all your expressive needs.
 SIMPLE: While providing an unprecedented array of features, we take great care to keep the interface
 clean. Telegram is so simple you already know how to use it.
 PRIVATE: We take your privacy seriously and will never give any third parties access to your
 data. You can delete any message you ever sent or received for both sides, at any time and without
 a trace. Telegram will never use your data to show you ads.
 We keep expanding the boundaries of what you can do with a messaging app. Don’t wait years for
 older messengers to catch up with Telegram — join the revolution today.

Keep WhatsApp Web discreet when others can see your screen. Messages and previews stay blurred until you move the pointer over them.
 What you get 
- Blur all chat messages or only the sidebar preview
- Hide media thumbnails, gallery icons, and profile pictures

firefox-addons:2836097.name: Privacy Portal: Privacy for your email
firefox-addons:2836097.summary: Hide your email when signing up for websites or enrolling to newsletters. Use auto-generated "Privacy Addresses" instead and have all your emails delivered to your personal inbox. This protects your privacy and eliminates spam from your inbox.
firefox-addons:2836097.description:
Your personal email can easily be linked to your identity. Using the same email address for all your accounts makes it extremely easy for advertisers, data brokers, and bad actors to connect your accounts and aggregate your data to profile you. Using unique addresses for every service shrinks your digital footprint and makes you a smaller target.
Whenever a website asks you for your email address, simply type the "@" sign in the email field and Privacy Portal will automatically fill in a new Privacy Address that privately relays emails to your personal inbox. Alternatively, you can click on the "Hide my Email" suggestion that appears on the page for the same effect.
Privacy Portal's Mail Relay is compatible with all standard email providers. You don't need a special email account to use it.
 Privacy & Transparency 
The Privacy Portal extension is Open Source . It offers minimal functionality by design to provide you with the highest levels of privacy while browsing.
 Privacy Portal is better for your privacy! 
At Privacy Portal, we build privacy-first products. We design our software from the ground up ensuring that every feature aligns with our strict privacy goals.
Our Mail Relay service processes emails in-memory and does not store nor log any of your emails. Check our Privacy Policy for more information.
 Plans Overview 
Privacy Portal offers a generous basic protection plan free of charge. An upgrade is available for users who wish to get more advanced functionality such as email encryption, unlimited Privacy Addresses, multiple personal emails, ...

firefox-addons:2940951.description:
🔒 Privacy Mode Timer helps users stay secure and distraction-free by automatically switching to private browsing mode based on a custom time schedule.
Whether you want to block distractions, enhance privacy during late hours, or schedule work-specific browsing windows, this extension ensures your private tabs are opened only when needed — and can auto-close them after inactivity.
✅ Features:
⏰ Schedule browser to open private tabs during specific time blocks (e.g., 8 PM–11 PM).
🛑 Auto-close inactive private tabs after X minutes.
🔔 Optional alerts before opening or closing private tabs.
📋 Overview of active privacy sessions and upcoming scheduled switches.
🧠 Works even if the browser is left idle or minimized.

firefox-addons:2916594.description:
This extension allows users to easily save Shopee product data and images into a single ZIP file. Ideal for documentation, analysis, or creating offline catalogs, it offers a convenient and efficient way to manage product information directly from the Shopee page.

Welcome to Avatar World, the most innovative role-playing game of 2024.
Explore and experience a fun and super cute world, full of incredible locations, towns, cities and characters, with endless items and avatars to interact with.
(We are soooooooo excited to create this special game for you, the players! thank you for choosing us, and we look forward to communicate with you and build the things that you want!)

You can also design their homes to suit their needs and lifestyle, adding features such as home offices, gyms, and music rooms. Exploring different towns and discovering new characters and exciting events adds to the fun of this engaging experience.

By learning those skills in an entertaining and immersive environment, players can apply what they have learned in their real lives.

3D scan objects easily—wherever you are

- Enhanced Project Library for storing and managing your projects

bluejetty:00062770:ios.description:
Hop on board the wheel of the seasons! Through this adorable game aimed for children aged 3 and more, practice and advance essential basic concepts of early learning. As the seasons change, your child will learn Visual Perception concepts such as size, color, orientation and shapes, early math concept such as counting and sequencing, and higher skills such as categorical thinking and task persistence. 
Seasons’ beautifully illustrated environments allow your child to explore common weather conditions typical for each season, the characteristics of weather conditions, and the types of clothing needed for each season.
Game features:
- Easy and intuitive: Toddlers can play this game independently.
- No stress or time limits.
- Safe environment for your kids (girls & boys). Ads free and No pop-ups.
- Enjoyable and educational.
Educational targets:
- Practice visual perception concepts.
- Establish Motor skills such as Hand-eye coordination.
- Practice Visual Attention. 
- Explore the unique characteristics of each season.
- Early math concepts such as counting and sequencing.
- Advance categorical thinking.
 - Practice task persistence. 
The game consists of 12 engaging boards ordered in an ascending level of difficulty. The boards were CAREFULLY CHOSEN in order to practice and advance early learning concepts and skills. Your child will visit many different unique environments that spark the curiosity and imagination and make learning a fun experience.
Game Boards:
Autumn 
Cleaning up the park from autumn leaves by MATCHING to SILHOUETTES 
COUNT TO 4 and prepare the pumpkin booth for to Halloween. 
Storing food to the winter by SHAPE and SIZE.
Winter 
Build snowmen by SORTING according to SIZE. 
MATCH SHAPES and Help the deer and bear get home
Get warm by the fireplace and MATCH POLYCUBES
Spring
COUNT TO 5 and plant a vegetable garden. 
play with butterflies and find the ODD ONE OUT
Set up a picnic blanket using CATEGORICAL THINKING
Summer
DRESS up the deer at the beach by finding the ODD ONE OUT
COUNT and SEQUENCE objects at the beach
Practice visual memory and CATEGORICAL THINKING on a beautiful day at the beach
About Us:
At ToyaTap we are dedicated to creating high-quality learning experiences that children and parents can enjoy together.
We hope you and your child will enjoy playing this game as much as we enjoyed creating it!

bluejetty:00072309:ios.description:

• Type and Listen: Enter your own text and have it spoken back instantly.

• Built for Accessibility: Created with accessibility in mind for people with dyslexia and other reading difficulties.
AudibleAnything is a powerful tool for anyone who wants a simpler way to consume written content. Whether you need support for reading, studying, reviewing documents, or listening on the go, AudibleAnything helps turn text into an easier experience.

bluejetty:00023496:ios.description:
With Off, you can control your computers remotely, from anywhere in the world.
Off has several commands it can trigger on your computers, including:
- Wake Up (Wake-on-LAN)
- Shutdown
- Restart
- Sleep
- Hibernate
- Lock
- Keep Awake
- Display Message
- Media keys: play, pause, skip and volume
It works with any Windows PC, Mac or Linux PC. It doesn't require any complex setup or configuration; anyone can use it. Just scan the QR code the Off Helper shows on your computer.
Off has widgets for your Home Screen, Lock Screen and Control Center. See your computer's battery life and power status at a glance, or shut it down, wake it up or skip a track without opening the app.
Schedule your computer to shut down, restart or sleep at a set time, and follow the countdown on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island with Live Activities. If you've got kids, you can use this to limit how long they're spending on their computers by turning them off when it's time for bed.
Off keeps a status report of when each computer was on, asleep or off, so you can see how it's being used.
Off is integrated into Siri. You can create voice commands like "Hey Siri, switch off my computer" or "Hey Siri, wake up my Mac".
Off is fully compatible with Apple's Shortcuts app. With this, you can design your own automation routines that combine Off's ability to control your computers with any other action available through Shortcuts. For example, you could create a 'Finished Work' routine that turns off your office lights and shuts down your computer at the same time.
Off comes with an Apple Watch app. With just a tap on your wrist, you can control the computers in your home.
With Off, you'll be able to save money on your electricity because it'll be effortless to shut down your power-hungry machines. If you stream media from your computer, Off is invaluable as it lets you control playback and fix problems by restarting without even getting up.
Off is secure: if you want to set a password to stop unwanted access, you can.
Off requires the free Off Helper application to be installed on any computer you wish to control. It's available from www.bridgetech.io
Off is compatible with:
Windows 10 and 11 (32-bit and 64-bit)
macOS 13 (Ventura) and later
Ubuntu
Raspberry Pi OS

Blood Kiss is a mysterious interactive otome game where your choices shape the story.
Meet charming vampire characters, make meaningful decisions, and unlock different episodes as the story unfolds.
Your choices matter — discover multiple story paths and build unique relationships with each character.
[Intro]
A new job leads you to an unexpected workplace… one surrounded by vampires?
What would you do if you had to work alongside mysterious vampires who keep their true identities hidden?
Experience a secret romance in this interactive otome game, Blood Kiss.
[Story]
Burdened by the debt your father left behind, you accept a mysterious offer that promises to change your life.
Soon, you find yourself in a hidden place where vampires live among humans.
Your decisions will determine how the story develops and which relationships you build.
Meet unforgettable characters:
Dayn – A calm and charismatic CEO with a noble background
Gray – A reserved coworker struggling with his true self
Ruel – A thoughtful character with a complicated past
Eden – A dependable partner who supports Dayn
Dana – A strict secretary who keeps her distance from humans
Will your new life lead to romance, trust, or unexpected challenges?
Discover the evolving stories of Blood Kiss.
[About the Game]
An interactive visual novel otome game where your choices shape the story
Multiple story routes and endings based on your decisions
You are the main character — experience the story from your perspective
Over 200 choices to explore character routes and special endings
Unlock bonus episodes and hidden content as you progress
[Blood Kiss is for players who…]
Enjoy interactive otome and story-driven games
Like mystery and fantasy themes
Want to explore different story paths and endings
Enjoy character-focused romance stories
Like anime-style art and narrative games

bluejetty:00058743:android.summary:
The Rodalies de Catalunya app allows you to consult information on Rodalies lines, routes and stations.
It is free and available in Catalan, Spanish and English.
Available for consultation:
- Service status and favourite line notifications
bluejetty:00058743:android.description:
The Rodalies de Catalunya app allows you to consult information on Rodalies lines, routes and stations.
It is free and available in Catalan, Spanish and English.
Available for consultation:
- Service status and favourite line notifications
- Train timetables for planned journeys
- Real-time train times at stations and departure platform
- Fares and ticket prices
- Accessibility of trains and stations
- The station closest to the user's geographical position (geolocation must be activated)
- Rodalies network maps
It also allows you to customise the home page: you can add favourite routes and stations and set up your favourite lines to receive service status alerts.
You can also learn about the environmental and health benefits of using public transport instead of the car.
You can consult the application's accessibility statement at: 
- Android: https://rodalies.gencat.cat/ca/atencio_al_client/app_rodalies/declaracio-accessibilitat-android/

bluejetty:00127988:ios.name: AlchiMerge: Merge & Craft
bluejetty:00127988:ios.summary:
• In AlchiMerge you are the Shopkeeper of your very own Alchemy Shop!
• Match and Merge materials to harvest magical ingredients for your Shop!
• Craft mystical Potions, Spells and more!
• Sell them to customers for profits and become a Leg
bluejetty:00127988:ios.description:
• In AlchiMerge you are the Shopkeeper of your very own Alchemy Shop!
• Match and Merge materials to harvest magical ingredients for your Shop!
• Craft mystical Potions, Spells and more!
• Sell them to customers for profits and become a Legendary Shop Tycoon!
• Decorate your Shop and Customize your human, Catanian (cat) or Lupinian (dog) avatar! 
• Befriend heroes along your way and uncover the mysteries of the Vortex Isles!
•Join forces with other players and Invest in your City together!
Interested in knowing more? Here’s what you can expect from AlchiMerge: Merge & Craft.
■ Backstory:
The kingdoms of Catania and Lupinia used to live secluded from each other, but everything changed when the Great Tremor hit, causing a Rift Storm in the middle of the great ocean. Dimensional rifts started to appear out of magical thunder, introducing a whole new archipelago to the world.
These are the Vortex Isles, a place of magical flora, mystical ruins and ever-lasting storm clouds.
Upon sailing to the Vortex Isles, Catanians and Lupinians met Humans for the very first time. They were also brought to the world of Anima by the Rift Storm. In AlchiMerge these three kingdoms meet to explore the mysterious Vortex Isles. Will they all get along?
Players familiar with PocApp Studios' previous titles, Castle Cats & Dungeon Dogs, will be able to meet beloved heroes in an entirely new format. Completing Quests from new and old heroes will reveal unique stories of the characters and the world of Anima.
Key Features:
■ Merge Gameplay: Merge Your Way Through the World of Anima!
Match and Merge endless materials to harvest magical ingredients for your shop!
■ Crafting: Sell your wares to customers!
Craft mystical Potions, Spells, and ancient Trinkets. Sell and trade them to customers for profits!
■ Shop Tycoon: Become the best!
Hustle, bargain, and strike deals to become the most prestigious Shopkeeper on the Vortex Isles!
■ Avatar Customization: Show off your Shopkeeper!
Customize your avatar to your own liking and start your adventure either as a human, catanian (cat), or lupinian (dog), the choice is yours!
■ Shop Decoration: Show off your interior skills!
Be as creative as you want - your customers value a well-designed shop! 
■ Multiplayer: Join Forces with Other Players!
Team up with friends, invest together, build thriving Cities, and powerful alliances between Humans, Catanians, and Lupinians!
■ Story Progression: Uncover the mysteries of the Vortex Isles!
Can the three races work together? Are dogs still a Human’s best friend? Complete Quests from Trust Characters to unlock their unique stories and learn more about the world of Anima!
■ Helpful Links
WE LOVE FEEDBACK! Don’t hesitate to write to us at contact@pocappstudios.com
Need support? Contact us at support@pocappstudios.com and we’ll get back to you shortly!
Privacy Policy: https://www.pocappstudios.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service and EULA: https://www.pocappstudios.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00030780:ios.description:
Get Chatomic Now and experience the future of artificial intelligence. Chatomic is your all-in-one AI companion, offering 100+ specialized AI chatbots to enhance your productivity, creativity, learning, and enjoyment in all aspects of your life.
YOUR PERSONAL AI ASSISTANT
Chatomic is not just another chatbot app—it's a comprehensive AI hub that brings the power of advanced AI to your fingertips. From simplifying daily tasks with our email generator and grammar checker to expanding your creative horizons with our article generator and beyond.
100+ CUSTOM AI CHATBOTS
● Email Generator: From crafting persuasive sales pitches to perfecting your professional correspondence, Chatomic has got your back.
● Grammar Checker: Say goodbye to typos and grammar mistakes with an advanced AI tool that polishes your text to perfection.
● AI Chat: Ask artificial intelligence anything you want and get an instant answer.
● Article Generator: Effortlessly create well-structured and informative articles on a wide range of topics.
● Image Generator: Bring your ideas to life with AI-generated images.
● Writing Assistant: Enhance your writing with real-time suggestions on style, clarity, and tone.
● Paraphrasing Tool: Quickly rewrite text to improve readability or alter phrasing without losing the original meaning.
● Social Media Posts: Capture attention with engaging content for all your social media profiles.
● Language Translator: Instantly translate text from one language to another.
● Resume Builder & Job Interview Prep: Make your job search a success with AI assistance that creates standout resumes and prepares you for interviews.
● Language Learning: Converse with AI teachers in various languages, making learning not only effective but also truly engaging.
● Workout & Diet Plans: Get personalized recommendations from Chatomic’s fitness and diet assistants, designed to seamlessly integrate into your lifestyle.
● Travel Companion: Planning a trip has never been easier. Discover the best hotspots and learn essential travel phrases in a snap.
● Creative Writing: Generate lyrics, poems, and even engage in fun role-play to unlock your creativity.
● Code Creator & Mentor: Dive into coding with an intelligent assistant by your side, ready to coach you through any programming challenge.
● Trivia Master: Challenge yourself or have fun with friends answering questions on a wide array of topics.
● Meditation & Sleep Enhancers: Learn to manage stress and improve your sleep with guided exercises and effective tips.
● Marketing Mentor & Sales Copy Generator: Sharpen your marketing strategies and create copy that sells with AI-backed insights.
● Tech Support 360: Resolve your technical issues with AI efficiency
…and much more. With over 100 specialized chatbots, Chatomic is the ultimate companion that adapts to your unique needs, interests, and goals.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
* The free version of Chatomic allows a limited number of messages you can send to the chatbot. To remove these limitations, please purchase a paid subscription.
* Subscriptions with a free trial period will automatically convert to a paid subscription unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the expiration of the free trial period.
* Your subscription will automatically renew unless you turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
* Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account.
* You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your App Store account settings after purchase. You can also cancel the free trial by going to your App Store account settings.
How to cancel a subscription:
https://support.apple.com/118428
How to switch to a different subscription plan:
https://support.apple.com/118448
Terms of Service:
https://chatomic.app/terms.html
Privacy Policy:
https://chatomic.app/privacy-policy.html

bluejetty:00092362:ios.description:
The SDGFP Hunt/Fish application lets users view the hunting and fishing regulations, apply for licenses to hunt and fish in South Dakota, reserve a campsite in one of the state parks, and view maps of public hunting and fishing opportunities.
The maps use GPS to show the user where they are on public land. The hunting and fishing regulations are divided into sections to make it easier to find the information the user is looking for. 
This application is maintained by the State of South Dakota Department of Game, Fish and Parks.

bluejetty:00026339:ios.description:
Sky View - Explore Universe application provides a learning experience about planets. Learn the previous information about the sky and stars.
Are you ready to begin your cosmic journey? Download Sky View - Explore the Universe today and experience the magnificence of the universe from the comfort of your own device!
Take a cosmic adventure with Sky View - Explore Universe, the go-to planetarium Sky Observatory app. Immerse yourself in real-time stargazing and discover the night sky's mysteries.
App Features: 
1. Simply point your device at the sky to identify planets, constellations, satellites, and thousands of stars.
2. Explore our star map to find the precise locations of stars and constellations, thereby enhancing your astronomical knowledge.
3. Follow the course of celestial objects and see their exact locations in the sky at any moment and date.
4. Visualise the Earth's day and night zones to help with your stargazing planning.
5. Get detailed information about the sun and moon, including current positions and phases.
6. Learn about the sizes and positions of planets and the moon, expanding your knowledge of our celestial neighbours.
7. Explore a comprehensive list of satellites, complete with photographs and specialised information.
8. Stay up to date on the current moon phase and time, ideal for lunar mates.
9. Display moon phases in current time and date.
10. space explorer with rocket research & observations.
11. satellite information with planets and galaxies with star planets.
Premium Feature:
Dive into the wonders of the universe with our interactive Space Quiz! Challenge yourself with exciting questions about planets, stars, galaxies, and more. Expand your knowledge and curiosity about the mysteries of space.
What You'll Get in the Premium Plan:
1. Exclusive Space Quizzes: Access a wide range of advanced questions that delve deeper into space science.
2. Learn and Explore: Detailed explanations for every question to help you learn as you play.
Unlock the premium plan to turn your curiosity into expertise and become a space enthusiast! Ready to journey through the stars?
If you have any questions or need help. reach out to us at app-support@md-tech.in.

bluejetty:00150609:ios.name: Wrestle Deck
bluejetty:00150609:ios.summary: Wrestle Deck allows the player to call the shots in the ring! There are over 100 cards to collect, featuring some of the hottest names in indie wrestling. Your stable of wrestlers will compete in a series of matches with unlockable promotio
bluejetty:00150609:ios.description:
Wrestle Deck allows the player to call the shots in the ring! There are over 100 cards to collect, featuring some of the hottest names in indie wrestling. Your stable of wrestlers will compete in a series of matches with unlockable promotions like Monster Factory, New Texas Pro Wrestling, Action Pro Wrestling, Wrestling Revolver and Warrior Wrestling. Work your way up from a small arena to showcasing your fights in a champion ring. With type advantages and gimmicks in the mix, each fight will strike just enough balance between strategy and a potential upset! 
Expand your locker to accommodate more talent, as you build up your deck. Switch between multiple stables, pre-set by you, to challenge opponents in the ring. Daily tasks will allow you to not only expand your locker but upgrade your gym bag as well, enabling you to carry more gimmicks that will help spice up the matches for your deck. 
Some of the awesome talent featured in the deck include...
- Rachael Ellering
- Ace Austin
- Ricky Morton
- Fuego Del Sol
- Alex Zayne
- JD Drake
- Anthony Henry
- Masha Slamovich
- Zicky Dice
- Danny Limelight
- World Famous Cheeseburger
...And many more!
Wrestle Deck Gameplay:
- Create a stable featuring talents from all over the world, from major promotions and the independent wrestling scene.
- Build your locker room with some of the hottest names in wrestling, including some up-and-coming talent.
- Level up your cards by competing in matches and use type advantages to defeat your opponents.
- Collect gimmicks and store them in your gym bag to help you along the way.
- Finish Daily Tasks to earn rings that allow you to unlock more storage in your gym bag, and expand your locker room to hold more cards.
- The Books allow you to see cards you’ve gone up against, or collected.
Draw cards to build up your deck, create the ultimate stable, and rise to the top to boast the title of Wrestle Deck champion!

 • Collections: swipe through curated rentals and discover new ones
Search together

Now in Spanish

bluejetty:00091542:ios.summary:
Storm Sniffer lets you capture and inspect HTTP / HTTPS requests &responses on your iOS device. 
It's easy to debug your app’s networking issues without a computer.
* Features
Packet capture: capture http / HTTPS traffic from iOS devices
bluejetty:00091542:ios.description:
Storm Sniffer lets you capture and inspect HTTP / HTTPS requests &responses on your iOS device. 
It's easy to debug your app’s networking issues without a computer.
* Features
Packet capture: capture http / HTTPS traffic from iOS devices using local VPN. View http / HTTPS requests and responses in text form, and support HTML, JS, CSS formatting preview;
Rewrite: modify http / HTTPS requests and responses in real time. Including URL redirection, custom header, local / remote file mock, etc;
Replay: Perform arbitrary HTTP requests with cron support;
Scripts: Use local/remote Javascript for more scalability.
* How it works
Storm Sniffer creates a local VPN on your device, then forwarding all traffic to a Local Man-in-The-Middle Server. As long as the VPN is active, Storm Sniffer can capture all HTTP / HTTPS traffic over Wi-Fi or Cellular Data.
* About the sensitive data
Storm Sniffer's Root Certificate is a self-signed certificate that is generated in your device. All HTTP / HTTPS requests & responses are captured and stored on your devices WITHOUT ANY REMOTE SERVERS involved. 
* About Subscription
After subscription, you can unlock all advanced functions. Currently, there are three kinds of auto-renewable subscription: 
Annual $17.99、Quarterly $3.99、 Monthly $1.99
* Terms of Use
https://sniffer.x-storm.com/terms/
* Privacy Policy
https://sniffer.x-storm.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00021247:ios.summary:
"This app is designed to be used with the Comfort Sync A3 thermostat.
The Comfort Sync® A3 thermostat doesn’t just control temperatures like a conventional thermostat, it automatically adapts to individual lifestyles and to the changing en
bluejetty:00021247:ios.description:
"This app is designed to be used with the Comfort Sync A3 thermostat.
The Comfort Sync® A3 thermostat doesn’t just control temperatures like a conventional thermostat, it automatically adapts to individual lifestyles and to the changing environment to help deliver precision comfort, energy savings and peace of mind. The Comfort Syc (Sync) App allows the user to control their HVAC system from anywhere in the world as though they were standing in front of their own thermostat.
App Features
• Adjust and view your house temperature from anywhere in the world
• Edit and view your thermostat schedule
• Away Sync™ uses the location on your mobile phone to detect when the house is empty and automatically change the temperature to a more energy-efficient setting. When a family member is on the way home it automatically returns the temperature to its regular setting
• Much like a weather report will use a temperature and wind speed to determine a Wind Chill index to indicate the perceived temperature, the Comfort Sync True Temp™ temperature takes into account indoor and outdoor temperature and humidity to make a home feel exactly like the homeowner desires. Therefore, when the thermostat is set to 72 degrees, a home will “Feel Like” (a home's ""True Temp"" will be"") 72 degrees year-round
• Allergy Sync™ on the Comfort Sync A3 gives immediate allergy relief by monitoring air quality and pollen levels outside. When high levels of pollutants and allergens are detected, the fan automatically turns on to keep the home’s air clean
• The thermostat’s advanced warning system predicts problems before they happen and alerts the homeowner and your dealer if enabled
• Get alerts, reminders and advanced warnings from your system wherever you are
You must own a Comfort Sync A3 thermostat to use this app. The Comfort Sync A3 thermostat must also be connected to your home’s Wi-Fi router before the app can control the settings.
We truly appreciate your questions and comments. Please keep sending your suggestions to consumeraffairssocial@lennoxind.com or @AskDaveLennox on Twitter
*Continued use of GPS in the background can dramatically affect battery life"

bluejetty:00127888:ios.description:
Cartoons and games Bimi Boo is a new way of educating and engaging kids that combines interactive cartoons with educational games. This app is perfect for parents who want their little ones to have fun while learning!
Trusted by the largest teacher community in the USA: "We Are Teachers"!
Key Features of Bimi Boo Kids:
- 35+ interactive episodes that offer many hours of educational content on a wide range of topics that your child can explore and learn from independently.
- 90+ educational games including shape and color matching, sorting, coloring, puzzles that have been specifically created to enhance your child's cognitive abilities, including problem-solving, critical thinking, logic, and hand-eye coordination.
- Regular updates with new educational content added every month means that your child can continue to learn and explore with our app, and always have fresh and engaging material to work with.
- Safe content: All Bimi Boo series and games are age-appropriate, ensuring your child has a secure and enjoyable space to learn and grow.
- No ads: You will never find annoying ads inside our apps, nothing will interrupt your kids from playing and learning.
Cartoons and games Bimi Boo is a subscription-based game that allows you to try it with 3 completely free episodes before committing to a subscription. This gives you the opportunity to explore the app and its offerings before making a decision.
Subscription details:
- Both the monthly and yearly subscriptions include a 3-day free trial.
- You can opt out of the subscription any time during the trial period.
- All subscriptions are automatically renewed unless canceled at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period.
- You will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period.
- You can cancel the auto-renewal at any time in your Account Settings, however no refunds are available within the active subscription period.
- Unused portions of a free trial period will be forfeited if you decide to purchase a subscription.
The core of our dedicated team has over 12 years of experience in early childhood development apps, and we're passionate about creating high-quality, age-appropriate content that ensures your child has a safe and enjoyable space to explore, learn, and grow.
Unlock the power of interactive cartoons and educational games with us. Join Bimi Boo and friends on an exciting adventure to explore all the cool and amazing things!
Our Privacy Policy: https://bimiboo.net/privacy-policy/
Our Terms of Use: https://bimiboo.net/terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00170341:ios.description:
Design your ideal day. Every day
Navigating daily life, especially with ADHD, can be challenging. RoutineFlow offers the solution to manage your day with ease, turning every morning into a triumph and helping to keep procrastination at bay. Dive into the magic of structured routines, one step at a time.
REDUCE PROCRASTINATION
The daunting thought of beginning a task is often worse than the task itself. With RoutineFlow, watch as tasks turn from mountains into manageable molehills, assisting you to embark on them without hesitation.
MANAGE ADHD SYMPTOMS
Designed with ADHD users in mind, RoutineFlow provides structure and consistency, two keys to managing ADHD symptoms. The intuitive design and timers cater specifically to the needs of those seeking order in their often chaotic days.
STICK TO GOOD HABITS
Whether it's drinking more water, stretching, or simply making your bed, these small actions compound over time. RoutineFlow aids you in cultivating and adhering to these habits, making them an integral part of your daily life.
MASTER YOUR MORNING ROUTINE
Mornings set the tone for the rest of the day. Use RoutineFlow to ensure you kick off each day on the right foot. By following your tailored morning routine, embrace days filled with purpose and clarity.
IMPROVE TIME MANAGEMENT
With our analytics feature, get insights into how long each task takes, allowing you to plan your days better. No more guessing or feeling overwhelmed. Know exactly how long your routine will take and adjust accordingly.
FEATURES:
- Create Custom Routines: Choose from predefined steps or customize your own. Attach an emoji for a personalized touch!
- Timed Tasks: Turn your routines into a sequence of timers. Feel the accomplishment as you progress through your list.
- Detailed Analytics: Review your habits over the past 365 days, allowing for introspection and growth.

bluejetty:00132046:ios.description:
Hello Aurora: the Northern Lights tracker trusted by 330,000+ users. 110,000+ aurora sightings reported since 2020. 
Get a live Northern Lights forecast and instant aurora alerts, wherever you are. Hello Aurora tells you exactly when to look up.
“Best aurora app out there” – App Store user
“Good app with lots of data” – App Store user
NORTHERN LIGHTS FORECAST FOR YOUR LOCATION
- Real-time updates: Live aurora forecast updated every few minutes, sourced from the closest data points to your coordinates.
- Local metrics: Track real-time aurora strength, Bz levels, and viewing conditions tailored to you.
- Peak hours (Pro): Discover today's best viewing windows at your location powered by community data.
INSTANT AURORA ALERTS
- Aurora Sighting Alert: Get an instant aurora alert when users spot the lights nearby.
- Geomagnetic Storms: Get notified when a geomagnetic storm is predicted (G1 to G5).
- Solar Wind Shocks: Receive alerts up to an hour before a shock arrives and the exact second it hits.
- Substorm Alert: Trigger a high-priority aurora alert when a substorm starts.
- Pro Filters: Customize distance radius, photo-only sightings, intensity levels, and Bz threshold drops.
LAST NIGHT’S SUMMARY (PRO)
- Local Sightings: See aurora reports from last night.
- Countries reach: Discover how many countries witnessed the Northern Lights.
- Northern Lights map & photos: View exact aurora locations and top photos with timestamps.
- Peak real-time metrics: Check minimum aurora strength and Bz levels.
LONG-TERM NORTHERN LIGHTS FORECAST
- 27-day guide: Plan ahead with a long-range aurora forecast looking up to 27 days in advance, including the full solar rotation breakdown for Pro users.
- 12 months seasonal outlook: Pro users can find the best week to view the Northern Lights over the next 12 months using historical solar cycles and 6+ years of exclusive data.
LIVE NORTHERN LIGHTS MAP
- Live Aurora Map: See exactly where the Northern Lights are occurring right now.
- Aurora Oval & Cloud Tracking: Track the aurora oval expansion and find clear skies with total/low cloud filters.
- Community Sightings: View live reports. Pro users can filter pins to the last 30 minutes or last night.
- 3D Globe (Pro): Enjoy interactive 3D visualizations.
AURORA PASSPORT & COMMUNITY (PRO)
- Track Your Journey: Record sightings, countries visited, likes, and points in your personal gallery.
- Verified Community: Share and view live, location-verified photos with strict 1-hour reporting rules.
EASY TO USE & 100% AD-FREE
- One Northern Lights tracker for everything you'll need
- Global coverage: Add custom locations worldwide. 
- Sightings alerts supported in Iceland, Norway, Sweden, Finland, Canada, US, UK, Germany, Italy, France, Poland, Austria, and Switzerland.
- No Ads: Enjoy a clean experience on both Free and Pro versions.
- Multilingual: Available in English, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Swedish, Norwegian, Finnish, and Thai.
Download Hello Aurora now and be ready when the lights dance. Save money on tours with this ultimate northern lights tracker!

Support: contact@hello-aurora.com
Apple TOS: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00177417:ios.description:
The Garmin Drive™ app is a simple and convenient app solution for the latest Garmin automotive navigators and dash cams. Visit garmin.com/driveapp for a list of compatible devices.
For compatible navigators, the Garmin Drive app provides real-time information for traffic, parking, advanced weather, and photoLive traffic cameras, in addition to smart notifications from your Bluetooth-enabled mobile device.
For compatible dash cams, the Garmin Drive app provides quick access to camera controls, settings, and recorded footage. Up to four dash cams can be wirelessly connected with the Dash Cam Auto Sync feature to provide comprehensive coverage around a vehicle, offering various viewpoints recorded by the multiple cameras. The Garmin Drive app can create a “picture-in-picture” video from any two perspectives at the same time, making it easy to review video and also share videos with friends, insurance agencies, or legal authorities.
Garmin Speak™ and Garmin DriveSmart™ 65 with Amazon Alexa are two Garmin products that bring what you love about Amazon Alexa to your vehicle. Just ask Alexa to hear music, news, and more. Also, enjoy Garmin turn-by-turn navigation. Stream the audio (music and other responses) from your vehicle’s stereo when you connect Garmin Speak to your stereo using Bluetooth® or AUX.
Older Bluetooth-capable Garmin navigators are compatible with the Garmin Smartphone Link app, and older Wi-Fi-enabled Garmin dash cams can access video footage through the Garmin VIRB app.

bluejetty:00024218:ios.description:
ATTENTION: Only for use in participating Caleco Laundry locations.
Caleco CleanPay is an iPhone application providing the easiest and smartest complete laundry solution. This app allows you to pay for laundry cycles from your account by using Bluetooth to communicate with the washer or dryer.
Simply use Caleco CleanPay to purchase credit right from the app, then use that credit for your laundry. A full accounting is available to see your transaction purchase history.
• Scan the QR code of your laundry room (one time process)
• Start laundry machines via Bluetooth by scanning QR code on the machine
• Check your card/account balance, and add value to your account for laundry.
For participating laundry rooms, you can view machine availability as well as receive alerts when your laundry cycle is complete.

bluejetty:00075671:ios.name: GPS Navigation and GPS Maps
bluejetty:00075671:ios.summary:
Welcome to the app!
The app is a powerful and versatile navigation tool designed to assist users in planning and navigating their journeys effectively. With a wide range of features, this app offers a comprehensive and user-friendly naviga
bluejetty:00075671:ios.description:
Welcome to the app!
The app is a powerful and versatile navigation tool designed to assist users in planning and navigating their journeys effectively. With a wide range of features, this app offers a comprehensive and user-friendly navigation experience. 
Let's explore some of the key features of the app:
Find routes:
- You can find the route from your location to the place you want to choose. Just enter the place you want to choose the destination, and the system will give you the right route.
- You can also search for routes you want to learn. You just need to enter where you started in the start cell, where it ends in the destination cell.
- The app utilizes advanced GPS technology to provide users with accurate, turn-by-turn directions to their desired destinations. No matter where you're going, this app ensures you stay on the right track.
Near search
- You can search for restaurants, gas stations, cafes, malls,... stay closest to your location.
- Help you search the nearest route to the service store around you
Voice guided navigation:
- The app offers voice-guided instructions, eliminating the need to constantly look at your device while driving. Clear and concise navigation prompts keep you informed and focused on the road.
Offline maps:
- You can download the map to the machine to view the path easier
- Make it easy to find your way when you're in places with no waves or wifi
Location history
-The app helps you search for old routes without having to fill back time
Compass 
- Help you to know which direction you are moving
Others features in app:
- Speedometer
- World clock
- Find address
- Map option view
- Map my location
The app is a reliable and feature-packed navigation tool that helps you navigate with confidence wherever your destination may be. With accurate directions, real-time traffic updates, voice-guided navigation, and a range of customization options, this app is your ultimate travel companion. Whether you're commuting to work or embarking on a road trip, this app ensures you reach your destination safely and efficiently.
Policy: https://hoanghangstudio.netlify.app/policy
Term of use: https://hoanghangstudio.netlify.app/terms
Thank you for using the app.

bluejetty:00041366:ios.description:
ABOUT
GnollHack is a remastered and enhanced version of the classic roguelike game NetHack, one of the most iconic games developed in 1980s and 1990s. With GnollHack, you get:
- Traditional roguelike with turn-based gameplay
- Modern user interface
- Legendary strategic depth of NetHack
- Endless replayability
- Several new features, enhancing your gameplay experience
STORY
In GnollHack, you are a hero sent by your deity into the perilous Dungeons of Doom, tasked with recovering the stolen Amulet of Yendor from the clutches of the malevolent god Moloch, who has hidden it in the fiery depths of the underworld. Along your journey, you will encounter formidable enemies, discover great magical artifacts, and strive for glory. You must either triumph or perish in the attempt.
ROGUELIKE GAMEPLAY
Explore procedurally generated dungeons filled with monsters, traps, and treasures.
RICH CLASS AND RACE SYSTEM
- 13 classes: wizard, barbarian, rogue, etc.
- 5 races: human, elf, gnoll, etc.
DEEP ITEM AND MAGIC SYSTEM
Hundreds of items, spells, and artifacts with diverse effects.
CHALLENGING PERMADEATH
(Classic Mode Only)
Death is permanent, requiring players to adapt, plan, and learn from mistakes to progress further.
TUTORIALS AND GAMEPLAY INFORMATION
- GnollHack wiki: https://wiki.gnollhack.com
SUPPORT
- Discord: https://discord.gg/cQuExnzUQy

bluejetty:00176016:ios.description:
tap in. work. pay only for the rest of the day.
lans is your key to coworking spaces across the city — one wallet, one tap, and every space becomes yours for the day.
we're building the access layer for the city's work spaces: walk into any spot on the map like you already belong there, and pay only for the hours left in the day. that's the prorated day pass, and we're the only ones doing it.
how lans works
- open the map, pick your vibe: rooftop glass, plant jungle, quiet loft — every space is independent, local, and one tap away.
- tap in: check-in happens in seconds. your pass and wallet settle instantly, and you're at a desk before your coffee cools.
- pay for what's left of the day: arrive at 2pm, pay from 2pm. your money goes to hours you actually use.
- stay flexible: one balance works everywhere. drop in today, a different neighborhood tomorrow, a different city next month.
- bring your people: see where friends are locking in and cowork irl. good wifi is better with company.
- instant answers: our ai assistant is one tap away, anytime.
your local area network
independent spaces across sf, nyc, la, miami, chicago, austin and denver with more cities dropping. lans grows every week: more spots, more vibes, more places to lock in before your next side quest.
built for people who move
remote workers, founders, travelers, students between classes! anyone whose office is wherever the laptop opens. keep it simple, keep your freedom (and yes: no membership, ever).
there is always somewhere else to go. tap in and see.
thoughts? tell us: hello@lans.app

bluejetty:00156762:ios.description:
Your story lives in the Waco Tribune-Herald. From reporting on all of your favorite teams to the news that matters most in the community, we cover it all. Get in-depth stories from the Waco region and beyond – including news, sports, opinion, obituaries, entertainment, and politics.
Easily access the very latest news in an app built for you. Read, see, and hear exclusive commentary, stunning photography, video updates, and binge-worthy podcasts.
Plus, subscribers have the ability to upgrade to News+, our premium ad-free experience! That means faster-loading pages and an uninterrupted reading experience. 
Our app features:
* Your Stories – personalize your experience by selecting the local news topics that matter most to you
* Get notified – stay in the loop by selecting alerts for news, sports, weather, and more
* Easy navigation – see all the latest local stories by simply swiping up/down, and left/right.
* Read stories your way – either in the News Feed or via the E-edition
* Breaking news updates – top banners let you know what’s happening right now
* Follow author – get notifications whenever your favorite writers post a story
* Bookmark for later – save stories to enjoy at your leisure
* Listen to articles – press the play button to listen instead
* Customize your text size – make the content bigger or smaller in your profile settings
* Weather where you are – hourly, 10-day forecasts, and frequent video updates
Free to download. Subscribers enjoy unlimited access.
https://wacotrib.com/terms

bluejetty:00114334:ios.name: SnapCard: Sports Card Scanner
bluejetty:00114334:ios.summary: SnapCard is an AI-powered sports card scanner that instantly identifies your cards, checks real-time values, and tracks your entire collection. Scan baseball, football, basketball, hockey, soccer, Pokemon, and TCG cards — get pricing, gradi
bluejetty:00114334:ios.description:
SnapCard is an AI-powered sports card scanner that instantly identifies your cards, checks real-time values, and tracks your entire collection. Scan baseball, football, basketball, hockey, soccer, Pokemon, and TCG cards — get pricing, grading insights, and market data in seconds.
Built for collectors who want speed and accuracy, SnapCard uses AI card recognition to match cards across thousands of sets and deliver up-to-date value estimates based on current market data.
AI CARD SCANNER
Snap a photo of any sports card or trading card. SnapCard's AI identifies the card, matches it to the correct set, year, and variation, and returns results in seconds. Works with baseball cards, football cards, basketball cards, hockey cards, soccer cards, and more.
REAL-TIME CARD VALUES & PRICES
Check what your cards are worth with real-time pricing data. See value trends, recent sales, and market movement to make smarter buying, selling, and trading decisions.
PSA GRADING & CONDITION TOOLS
Review grading insights, AI-powered condition analysis for raw cards, and tools that help you understand card quality before submitting to PSA, SGC, or BGS. Know your card's potential grade and estimated graded value.
POKEMON & TCG SUPPORT
SnapCard supports Pokemon, Magic: The Gathering, and Yu-Gi-Oh cards. Scan TCG cards, check values, and manage your collection beyond sports.

bluejetty:00175129:ios.description:
Stop asking "What stock is the one?" and start seeing the answer. Stock Scanner & Market Screener answers the investor's biggest question by automatically filtering the entire market to find top-rated stocks, breakouts, and hidden opportunities in real-time.
Whether you are looking for the next massive penny stock runner or a safe long-term investment, our AI engine does the hard work for you. It scans the whole stock market to pinpoint the best stocks to buy now.
AI-POWERED DISCOVERY
The Answer to "Which Stock"
-Daily Top Picks: Don't waste time searching. Get a daily list of stocks with the highest "Buy" probability based on our proprietary algorithms.
-Breakout Detector: Catch the move before it happens. Our scanner identifies abnormal volume and momentum spikes instantly.
-Penny Stock Hunter: Specifically tuned to find low-priced stocks with high upside potential before the crowd jumps in.
PROFESSIONAL SCREENER
Create your own "Buy" criteria with professional-grade filters:
-Technical Scanning: RSI, MACD crossovers, Moving Averages, and Bollinger Bands.
-Fundamental Filtering: Screen by P/E ratio, Dividend Yield, Market Cap, and Sector.
-Sector Heatmaps: Instantly see which industries are heating up (e.g., AI, Energy, Biotech) and which are cooling down.
SMART ALERTS
-Price Actions: Get notified the second a stock hits your buy zone.
-Market Movers: Alerts for Pre-market and After-hours runners.
-News Catalyst: Real-time financial news linked to specific tickers so you know why a stock is moving.
ADVANCED CHARTING
Verify every signal with interactive charts. Toggle between "Day Trading" views (1-minute candles) and "Swing Trading" views (Daily/Weekly) to time your entry perfectly.
Disclaimers:
-Informational Tool: This app provides market analysis and data; it does not offer personalized financial advice.
-Independence: We are an independent analytical tool and are not affiliated with Finviz, Benzinga, TradingView, Webull, or Robinhood.
-Asset Coverage: Screening covers Equities (Stocks) only; Mutual Funds and Futures are currently not supported.
Privacy Policy: https://sagamill.firebaseapp.com/privacy.html
Terms of Service: https://sagamill.firebaseapp.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00128993:ios.description:
Available for free: 4 levels of the game and 10 attempts per day in Brawl mode. The full version can be unlocked with one payment in the game.
*Supported Devices: iPhone 8 Plus, Apple iPad Pro 12.9 (2015) and above. iPod Touches are not supported.
Let's play a game: I'll give you some puny humans, and you try to help them make it through my labyrinth. No, you won't be controlling them in battles - they'll fight automatically! My game is about strategy and praying to RNGesus, not mashing buttons. You can buy items for the humans: swords, crossbows, coffins, stale pretzels. Plus, I'll let you give them cool mutations! A few Topochlorians in the blood and some Crocodile Skin never hurt anyone. There's one catch, though: if you die, you have to start over entirely, and the whole world will be generated again from scratch. Yes, my game is a roguelike game. Well, roguelite, if you're a nerd who loves compartmentalizing us creators into strict genres.
I almost forgot: my game has a multiplayer mode, too! But I'm not going to tell you anything about it, because King of the Hill is a special secret multiplayer mode that only unlocks once you beat the game.
* sincerely, with disrespect for puny humans, your local evil AI:
 d'Spot

bluejetty:00095854:ios.description:
A new escape game series from Jammsworks.
The first chapter features Vincent van Gogh, the painter beloved by solitude.
This is no ordinary “room”—what you enter is his memory, the deepest part of his heart.
— The Room in Arles
— The Asylum in Saint-Rémy
— The Solitary Atelier
— And one more: The “Letter Room”
Gather the hidden “words” and complete the letter.
It is his final message—addressed to his brother Theo.
A story that journeys through the borders between art and loneliness, dreams and reality.
【Features】
・Easy to start for first players. Let’s challenge!
・There are Hints, so Don’t worry!
・Auto-save function!
・No need for paper and pen! Swipe left from the right edge of the screen to take notes!
【How to play】
Very easy operation method!
・Search by tapping the screen.
・Change the viewpoint by tapping the button on the bottom of the screen.
・Double tap the item button, it will enlarged.
・Use an item by dragging it.
・While one item is displayed, select another item by either tapping or dragging it to combine them.
・There is a hint button from MENU which is the upper left corner of the screen.
【Jammsworks】
programmer：Asahi Hirata
Designer：Naruma Saito
Produced by two of us.
Our goal is to produce a game that would be fun for the users.
If you like this game, please play other games!
【Provide】
Music is VFR：http://musicisvfr.com
Pocket Sound : http://pocket-se.info/
icons8：https://icons8.com/
