bluejetty:00063080:ios.name: Calligraphy Penmanship
bluejetty:00063080:ios.summary:
Most of penmen use only a pointed pen to create all their artworks. This seems incredible to realize digitally on a mobile device. Except if you have in hands the appropriate tool and an excellent app.
Calligraphy Penmanship is bringing th
bluejetty:00063080:ios.description:
Most of penmen use only a pointed pen to create all their artworks. This seems incredible to realize digitally on a mobile device. Except if you have in hands the appropriate tool and an excellent app.
Calligraphy Penmanship is bringing the best experience ever to calligraphers and letters lovers to create digital artworks on a famous mobile device. 
Just use it like a pointed ink pen. A tiny variation of your hand pressure will create elegant and majestic shades. 
We have added a bonus to your freehand drawing: the ability to adjust to your hand the pressure and smoothness of the pen. The fineness of the strokes is really surprising. 
We have found some advantages of the digital Penmanship:
- You don't need to reload your pen with ink.
- You don't need to clean your pen nibs when changing the colors.
- The undo function let you create a great number of variation of a single stroke. Free your imagination without pain.
Main features:
- Flourished hands to learn and practice Penmanship. The most important technique to master is to push or pull your pencil in order to create thin and fat lines in one single stroke.
- Learning: you can evaluate your progress with stroke by stroke exercises. Try your best to trace the models and hit the high scores. This is the best way to understand the anatomy of each letter. and each decorative curve. 
- Training: with each letter, a full training page provides models to trace, guide lines and grids.
- Learn to decorate beautifully your lettering works. You can find simple patterns to trace, to change or to improve. With this updated version, you have the ability to create ornamental frames where to insert your works.
Frame creating is based on a multiple combination of different types of symmetry drawing. This function is really easy to understand and practice.
- Want to create your own lettering words and quotes ? Try out the text typing keyboard. How it works: type your text, validate, then trace them with embellishments and ornaments.
- A set of plain color for your pen. But also two specific effects: gradient and alternated colors. This is on of our best deal for unique lettering creations.
- A 3 day free trial is activated when you open the app for the first time. Enough time to have the pleasure to perform your lettering.
What's your next project ? Why not sending a beautifully framed quote or invitation to a friend, entirely created with your lettering ?
Warning: even you can draw with your fingers, this app offers the best experience with the Apple Pencil.

bluejetty:00130120:ios.description:
Max On-Demand is an affordable shared ride service that gets you just about anywhere in the center and east side of the city from morning to night.
HOW IT WORKS:
- Download the app and create an account.
- Book an on-demand ride on your phone.
- Meet your driver on a nearby corner.
CONVENIENT
Use your phone to tell Max On-Demand where you are and where you want to go. You’ll receive a nearby pick-up location for a Max On-Demand vehicle only a short walk away.
FAST
It just takes a minute to book your ride! The app will send you an approximate arrival time for your Max On-Demand vehicle.
AFFORDABLE
Max On-Demand is a low cost, public transit option. Pay easily with a credit/debit card through the app!
Questions? Reach out at support-bhm@ridewithvia.com 
Loving your experience so far? Throw us a 5-star rating. You’ll have our eternal gratitude.

bluejetty:00147303:ios.description:
The JobWalk App is the easiest and fastest way to create 360° progress documentation of your construction site with your 360° camera. Share progress with stakeholders and maintain security of your data with multi-tiered levels of access management. 
Capturing 360° photos with the JobWalk App is as easy as:
1. Connect your 360° camera (e.g. Ricoh Theta V, Theta S/SC, Garmin VIRB 360, Samsung Gear 360, LG 360 cam, NCTech iris360, Insta 360 Pro with custom firmware...) to your phone
2. Upload a sheet in order to provide a location for all 360° images on site
3. Tap the desired image location on the sheet and then tap the capture button to take a 360° image. Images are automatically timestamped and linked to the location on the floor plan. Repeat this process throughout your jobsite to capture the entire project then sync your project to your account.
360° photo documentation is the best way to keep track of the construction progress, create thorough as-built documents, and manage all construction projects from one place online. 
We’re always happy to hear from you! If you have questions or feedback write us at support+jobwalk@holobuilder.com

bluejetty:00021164:ios.description:
Erby helps you easily track and record breastfeeding, newborn activity, sleep statistics. It's also a handy food diary for your baby and nursing mom!
You will be able to make sure that the newborn is getting enough breast milk and to establish the daily baby care. Enter information about food, beverages, medications and supplements you are taking. This will help identify allergic reactions in the infant.
LACTATION
Start the breastfeeding timer with one click! Track the duration of feedings, easily remember which breast you fed the last time: this will help to establish breastfeeding and avoid lactostasis. Record data on pumping and responses to the first complementary foods.
PUMPING
Consider the volume of expressed milk with the option to start the feeding timer separately for each breast or both at the same time.
Keep records of frozen milk - make sure you have enough stocks in your milk stash
SLEEP
Use a sleep tracker and note down when your child is asleep and awake. Record night and day sleep to understand baby's sleep and wake patterns
DIAPERS
Schedule your diaper change so you know how many diapers you need. Write urination (with volume as needed) and bowel movements separately
HEALTH, FEEDING
Mark various symptoms and temperature, enter data on vitamins, medicines and vaccination. 
Record complementary feeding data and track the baby's response. Monitor your baby's weight gain and growth. Watch for teething. Erby is great for visiting a pediatrician.
ACTIVITIES
Record bathing and walking, tummy time, games, massage. 
STATISTICS AND HISTORY
View event statistics so you can spot trends and, if necessary, make adjustments to your baby's care. Study your daily routine. A complete history of events, the ability to filter them by type (for example, only walks or pump log) is always at your fingertips.
REMINDERS
Set reminders for the events you need. You will not miss your medication and will not forget to feed or put your child to bed at the right time.
Erby is not just a baby development journal, it is a memory of your precious first months with him.
You can keep a diary for multiple children. Suitable for twins!
Our breast feeding app was created to help even the most sleep-deprived parents keep track of their baby's progress up to one year old by recording daily activities and feeding statistics in this easy-to-use diary.

bluejetty:00077991:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00077991:ios.description:
Meet Strongify, the easiest workout tracker app. Enter the number of reps and the weight you lifted in just a few taps. Create any exercise and track your progress over time. Set up now the gym routine you deserve.
EASY
You can name your routines and exercises as you want. Don't spend that much time trying to find the official (long and boring) name of your workout in an endless list of exercises. Create a routine, create an exercise in it, and you are ready to go! You know what needs to be done for your body, and an app shouldn't make it difficult
FAST
Tracking your progress should be fast. In fact, Strongify does it in a few taps only! Are you going to the gym to look at your workout app? We don't think so! That's why Strongify will remember the last weight and reps you entered, which makes adding a workout fast and convenient.
Focus on the gains; we take care of the rest.
STAY MOTIVATED
Check your progress over time with our charts. Nothing is more motivating than seeing your own improvement. Every time you go to the gym, you will know how well you performed last time.
Outperform yourself week after week.
SHARE YOUR SUCCESSES
Share your workout with your social networks. You can also directly add them to your Instagram Story! We think you should be proud of what you accomplish (especially if you broke your previous bench press max weight). Share that with style with our different cards:
- Total volume lifted
- Best set
- Progress over time
- Reps Only
- Duration
TIME-BASED EXERCISES
You can also track your planks, stretching exercises, or yoga sessions.
CALENDAR
Another way to get motivated is to see how often you've worked out this week or month. We included a calendar that shows exactly that. You can quickly overview your past workouts and see exactly what exercises you performed on a specific day.
THEMES
Everyone has different tastes, we are totally fine if you don't like the default theme. That's why we included others. Prefer pink? Maybe black? We've got you covered!
APP FEATURES:
- Easy and simple UI
- Fast, no more wasted time at the gym
- Efficient tracking of your workout
- Log your reps and weight in a few taps.
- Create any custom routines you want
- Support for imperial and metric units
- Track your progress
- Get relevant stats on your progress
- Multiple charts
- Reach your fitness goals
- Analyze your performance
- Share your workout on your Instagram Story
- See all your past workouts on a calendar
- Try themes before trying the Premium version
- Get your dream body
A note from the developer:
I could never remember how much weight I lifted during my previous workouts. I wanted an easy way to track my workouts without spending too much time on it. I tried to create a simple, yet effective way to track my progress without bloating the app with useless features; I hope you like it!
Feel free to consult our privacy policy here: https://astrochimp.framer.website/privacy and our terms of use here: https://astrochimp.framer.website/terms
Keep it Strong!

- Reach your fitness goals

- See all your past workouts on a calendar
- Try themes before trying the Premium version

Keep it Strong!

bluejetty:00074140:ios.summary:

Topo Maps US is built for people who go where cell service doesn't: hikers, backpackers, hunters, anglers, paddlers, mountain bi
bluejetty:00074140:ios.description:
Download USGS topographic maps of the United States and use them offline, with no account and no subscription.
Topo Maps US is built for people who go where cell service doesn't: hikers, backpackers, hunters, anglers, paddlers, mountain bikers, geocachers, and anyone who wants a real topographic map in their pocket.
MAPS
Choose from three USGS map layers: standard topographic, aerial imagery with a topographic overlay, or plain aerial imagery.
OFFLINE
Tap the map squares you want and download them before you leave. Downloaded maps work with no Internet connection and use no cell data in the field.
TRAILS AND POINTS OF INTEREST BUILT IN
Every map download includes the trails, summits, lakes, campsites, and other named places in that area from OpenStreetMap, so you can search them by name while you're offline.
TRAIL RECORDING
Record where you go. Recorded trails show your path on the map with distance, elapsed time, and average speed. Recording stops automatically when you start driving, and any drive at the start or end of a trail is trimmed off.
ELEVATION PROFILES
Every recorded or imported trail gets an elevation profile with distance labels and color-coded grade shading. Drag along the chart to see the matching point on the map, its elevation, and the time you passed it.
FLAGS
Mark your current location or any spot on the map. Flags record coordinates and elevation, and you can add notes and organize them by color: geocaches, trailheads, summits, camps, and so on.
NAVIGATION
Pick a flag and follow the direction arrow, driven by your compass heading, with the distance remaining. Handy for geocaching and for finding your way back to camp or the car.
LOCATION
See where you are on the map, your elevation, speed, and the accuracy of the GPS fix.
MEASURE
Trace a route on the map to measure its distance, then save it as a trail to follow later.
IMPORT AND SHARE
Import trails and waypoints from GPX files and geocache LOC files. Share your flags and trails by email, Messages, or AirDrop as standard GPX files that work with any GPS unit or mapping software. Back up your maps and data to a computer over Wi-Fi.
Designed for iPhone and iPad.
Note: Continued use of GPS in the background can noticeably reduce battery life.

bluejetty:00071097:ios.description:
Anybody ordered a pizza? We deliver fresh, juicy pizza all around the world in 30 minutes, because it is Masha and the Bear, and they are opening their own pizzeria! 
All the characters of the series can't wait to try it!
Join Masha and start cooking!
What's inside:
- 9 hungry guests!
- 16 pizza recipes!
- 35 ingredients!
Take orders!
There are Margaritas, Pepperonis, Mexican pizzas, as well as 10 other varieties in our menu! We even have one with strawberries! What pizza has the guest chosen this time?
Make pizza!
We'll flatten the dough, add some pepperonis, tomatoes, basil, mushrooms, olives, onions and other ingredients! Some pepper, a bit of salt - and there we go - the pizza is ready to meet the oven! Don't forget to grate some cheese on top to have a delicious brown crust! So many ingredients, recipes and combinations - where else will you see this?
Deliver orders!
We'll have to make it snappy to leave our every customer full and happy!
Pop into the pizza-car and off we go - delivering our culinary masterpiece while it's hot!
A bee swarm ahead? Got a flat tyre? See a gap on the way? Nothing to worry about! Masha and the Bear will handle anything without dropping an olive!
At the end of the journey, what's left is to cut the pizza and say Bon appetit!
Masha's hands are full with orders so she won't make it without you! Put an apron on, get a rolling pin, and let us make the best pizza on Earth!

What is the Success Academy Charter app?
The Success Academy Charter app helps schools and families stay connected and informed—all in one easy place. Whether it’s a quick message from a teacher, an important alert from the district, or a reminder about tomorrow’s field trip, the Success Academy Charter app makes sure families never miss a thing.
Why families and teachers love the Success Academy Charter app:
• Simple, easy-to-use app and website
• Messages are automatically translated into 190+ languages
• Best-in-class safety and security practices
• One place for all school updates, alerts, and messages
With the Success Academy Charter app, families and staff save time and stay connected—so everyone can focus on helping students succeed.
Success Academy Charter for iOS
The Success Academy Charter app makes it easy for families to stay in the loop and engage with their child’s school community. With the app, parents and guardians can:
• See school news, classroom updates, and photos

This adrenaline-fueled game puts you in the driver's seat of a powerful motorcycle, where you'll race through traffic-packed streets and shoot down enemies.
As a skilled rider, you'll need to navigate through traffic and dodge obstacles to stay ahead of the competition. But that's not all – with a variety of bike customizations and weapon upgrades, you can make your ride the envy of other racers.
Get ready to take on even the toughest opponents in this fast-paced game. With thrilling boss battles and challenging gameplay, Bike Rider will keep you on the edge of your seat. And with stunning graphics and realistic physics, you'll feel like you're really racing through the city streets.
So rev up your motorcycle and get ready to race like never before. Bike Rider: Moto Race Battle is the ultimate game for anyone who loves speed, excitement, and high-octane action. Can you become the ultimate rider and come out on top in this intense combat racing game? Play now and find out!
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS

You can go to your iTunes Account settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed. If you subscribe before your free trial ends, the rest of your free trial period will be forfeited as soon as your purchase is confirmed.

bluejetty:00127977:ios.name: Technopoly – Industrial Empire
bluejetty:00127977:ios.summary: Ready to lead the industrial revolution and become the ultimate factory tycoon? Take charge in Technopoly, an idle industrial strategy game where you build, manage, and expand your very own industrial empire. Optimize supply chains, manage
bluejetty:00127977:ios.description:
Ready to lead the industrial revolution and become the ultimate factory tycoon? Take charge in Technopoly, an idle industrial strategy game where you build, manage, and expand your very own industrial empire. Optimize supply chains, manage resources, and upgrade factories in your quest to create the most efficient production powerhouse!
Build Your Industrial Empire – Start from a single humble factory and expand to a network of advanced industries across multiple islands. Construct Wind Turbines for energy, generate water from desalination plants, grow food, and unlock high-tech manufacturing. Each new facility is a crucial link in your production chain. Plan your strategy: use Energy to produce Water, Water to produce Food, and keep advancing to craft more complex products. Can you optimize the entire supply chain and keep every factory running smoothly?
Optimize Production & Resources – Balance supply and demand like a true industrial manager. Every decision matters: upgrade your factories and mines to boost output, invest in research to invent new technologies, and eliminate bottlenecks in your production line. Resource management is key – mine raw materials, refine them, and allocate resources wisely to maximize efficiency. The better your optimization, the faster your idle empire grows and prospers, even when you’re offline.
Upgrade, Automate & Innovate – Develop over 20+ cutting-edge technologies to supercharge your industries. Upgrade factories, laboratories, and workshops to unlock new products and improvements. Research automation upgrades so your facilities run automatically, keeping the money flowing while you focus on expansion. From basic tools to futuristic tech (even your own Electric Car project!), there’s always something new to invent or improve. Innovation will set you apart from other tycoons – stay ahead of the curve to build the most advanced industrial city.
 Idle Rewards & Offline Progress – Idle mechanics ensure your business keeps growing even while you’re away. Sit back and watch your empire thrive 24/7. Factories continue producing goods and generating income in real-time. Offline mode lets you keep building and planning without an internet connection – perfect for commutes or whenever you need a break. Come back to a treasury full of cash, ready to reinvest in your booming industrial empire. It’s a perfect blend of casual idle fun and strategic management!
Features:
Deep Industrial Strategy – A complex industrial management sim that’s easy to learn but offers rich depth for strategy lovers.
Supply Chain Mastery – Control production chains from mining raw materials to assembling finished products, and fine-tune each step for maximum profit.
Idle Clicker Fun – Simple tap tap gameplay to build and upgrade, combined with idle game mechanics so you’re always progressing.
Build & Customize – Expand to new islands, design your factory city layout, and optimize each factory’s placement for the best output.
20+ Technologies & Upgrades – Unlock advanced tech from renewable energy to robotics. Upgrade every building to boost efficiency and output.
Quests and Challenges – Complete fun quests and achievements to earn bonuses that accelerate your growth. Can you conquer all challenges to become an industrial magnate?
Offline Play – Enjoy full gameplay offline. No Wi-Fi needed to build your empire, so you can play anytime, anywhere.
Join the industrial revolution and build the ultimate factory empire! Whether you’re a casual player who loves idle clicker gameplay or a mid-core strategist craving a complex management simulation, Technopoly has something for you. Download now and start your journey as an industrial tycoon – your technological empire awaits.

Dive into Tranquility: Unveiling the Beauty of Zen Koi Pro+
Unwind and embark on a mesmerizing journey with Zen Koi Pro+, a premium, single-player game experience crafted for ultimate relaxation. Inspired by the captivating Asian myth of a
bluejetty:00138445:ios.description:
Dive into Tranquility: Unveiling the Beauty of Zen Koi Pro+
Unwind and embark on a mesmerizing journey with Zen Koi Pro+, a premium, single-player game experience crafted for ultimate relaxation. Inspired by the captivating Asian myth of a koi fish transforming into a dragon, Zen Koi Pro+ offers a serene escape, brimming with enchanting music and tranquil gameplay.
Immerse yourself in a world of captivating koi:
Over 50 Breathtaking Koi Patterns to Collect: Discover a delightful array of over 50 unique koi patterns, each boasting vibrant colors and captivating designs. As you progress, watch your collection grow as you encounter new koi.
Witness the Rare and Shiny: Brace yourself for the awe-inspiring sight of the rarest koi and majestic dragons. Zen Koi Pro+ elevates the visual experience with a stunning new metallic sheen, making these magnificent creatures truly super-SHINY!
Enjoy the soothing flow of the Koi as it swims gracefully through a calm pond.
Uninterrupted Zen Experience:
Play Anywhere, Anytime: Leave your worries behind and enjoy offline play. Zen Koi Pro+ allows you to delve into the world of koi anytime, anywhere, without the need for an internet connection (available after initial download).
Seamless Cloud Saving: Never lose your progress again. Zen Koi Pro+ seamlessly backs up your game data to the cloud whenever an internet connection is available, ensuring your precious collection remains safe and sound.
Frictionless Fun: Experience the joy of instant gratification! Eggs hatch in a flash, and with 50 unlocked koi slots, building your collection becomes a breeze.
Ad-Free and Hassle-Free: Focus solely on the serenity of the game. Zen Koi Pro+ is entirely free of advertisements and in-app purchases, allowing you to immerse yourself in a truly uninterrupted zen experience.
Zen Koi Pro+ is the Perfect Choice for:
Stress Relief Seekers: Escape the daily grind and find solace in the calming environment cultivated by Zen Koi Pro+. The enchanting music and tranquil gameplay create a space for relaxation and mindfulness.
Completionist Gamers: Embark on a captivating quest to collect all 50+ koi patterns. The thrill of discovery and the satisfaction of completing your collection provide a rewarding and engaging experience.
Casual Gamers: Dive into short and relaxing gameplay sessions whenever you have a spare moment. Zen Koi Pro+ is perfect for unwinding after a long day or enjoying a mindful break.
Family friendly fun: Zen Koi Pro+ is a peaceful mobile game that is suitable for the whole family.
Beyond Relaxation: The Deeper Meaning of Zen Koi Pro+
Zen Koi Pro+ offers more than just a relaxing escape. It's a game steeped in symbolism and cultural significance. The koi, a revered creature in Asian cultures, represents perseverance, good fortune, and longevity. As you collect and nurture your koi, you're not just building a collection, you're embodying these positive values.
Download Zen Koi Pro+ today and embark on a journey of tranquility!

Terms of Service: http://www.landsharkgames.com/terms-of-service/ 
Privacy Policy: http://www.landsharkgames.com/privacy-policy/
Rated 3+ by the Indonesia Game Rating System (IGRS).

bluejetty:00166229:ios.description:
Lost your TV remote? Remote control battery dead? Welcome to the TV Remote app, your solution to all these issues.
TV Remote is a user-friendly and convenient application that allows you to control your smart TV with your iPhone. • Haptic feedback: Provides excellent vibrations for a realistic experience.
• Direct channel launch: Access your favorite channels directly from the app.
With a TV Remote you’ll never have to worry about lost remotes or dead batteries again. Simplify your TV watching experience and enjoy seamless control over your entertainment system.

bluejetty:00145104:ios.name: Bid Whist - Expert AI
bluejetty:00145104:ios.summary:
Whether you’re a seasoned pro or learning Bid Whist for the first time, Bid Whist – Expert AI is a great way to play, learn, and master this classic trick-taking card game.
Learn smarter, play better, and master Bid Whist with powerful AI
bluejetty:00145104:ios.description:
Whether you’re a seasoned pro or learning Bid Whist for the first time, Bid Whist – Expert AI is a great way to play, learn, and master this classic trick-taking card game.
Learn smarter, play better, and master Bid Whist with powerful AI partners and opponents, plus in-depth analysis tools. Play anytime, even offline. Extensive customization options let you enjoy your favorite rules.
CHALLENGING AND ENJOYABLE FOR ALL
New to Bid Whist?
Learn as you play with the NeuralPlay AI, which offers real-time suggestions to guide your moves. Build your skills hands-on, explore strategies, and master decision-making in a single-player experience that teaches you every step of the game.
Already an expert?
Challenge yourself against six levels of advanced AI opponents designed to test your skills, sharpen your strategy, and make every game exciting, competitive, and rewarding.
KEY FEATURES
Learn and Improve
• AI guidance: Receive real-time insights whenever your plays differ from the AI’s choices.
• Built-in card counter: Strengthen your counting and strategic decision-making.
• Trick-by-trick review: Analyze every move in detail to sharpen your gameplay.
• Replay hand: Review and replay a deal to practice and improve.
Convenience and Control
• Offline play: Enjoy the game anytime, even without an internet connection.
• Undo: Quickly correct mistakes and refine your strategy.
• Hints: Get helpful suggestions when you’re unsure of your next move.
• Claim remaining tricks: End the hand early when your cards are unbeatable.
• Skip hand: Move past hands you’d rather not play.
Progression and Customization
• Six AI levels: From beginner-friendly to expert-challenging.
• Detailed statistics: Track your performance and progress.
• Customization: Personalize the look with color themes and card decks.
RULE CUSTOMIZATIONS
Explore a wide variety of ways to play with customizable rule options, including:
• Partnership or solo (Cutthroat) play.
• Kitty size: Choose 6, 5, 4, or no kitty cards.
• Sport kitty: Choose who sees the kitty — everyone, only the declarer, or all players when a suit is selected as trump.
• High/low bid ranking: Choose whether high and low bids are equal, or let low bids outrank high bids.
• Minimum bid: Set the minimum bid between 1 and 4.
• Level-only bidding: After winning the bid, the declarer chooses the trump and direction (High, Low — Aces Good, or Low — Aces Bad).
• Notrump scoring: Decide whether notrump contracts score double.
• Boston scoring: Enable or disable double points for Boston bids.
• Overtrick scoring: Choose whether overtricks score points.
• Joker rules (notrump): Control how jokers are played in notrump contracts (e.g., discard anytime when void, must discard immediately when void, or must place in/exchange with the kitty).
• Two of Spades: Option to make the Two of Spades the high trump.
• Game-over condition: Finish by total points or by number of hands.
DOWNLOAD TODAY
Play, learn, and master Bid Whist - Expert AI. Enjoy a single-player Bid Whist experience designed for practice, strategy, or casual play. Whether you want to improve your skills or relax with an offline card game, play your way with a smart AI partner and opponents, customizable rules, and a fresh challenge every game.

Findly can locate any bluetooth device around you by tracking the strength of the bluetooth signal! 
AirPods, headphones, Fitbit tracker or phone lost? Find one of your AirPods or both AirPods. Findly helps you to find your lost devices within seconds.
► DEVICE RADAR
The device radar shows you all the devices that are near you.
►DISTANCE SCORE
Select the device you want to find and you will see the distance score, the closer you get to the device the score will be higher
► COMPATIBLE DEVICES
Findly supports the following devices:
- Bluetooth earbuds, earphones, headphones
- Apple Devices
- Portable Speakers
- Fitness Tracker, Fitbit tracker
- and many more devices
► HOW TO FIND BLUETOOTH DEVICES:
1. Turn on your Bluetooth
2. Open the app and approve Bluetooth access
3. Select the lost device that you want to find
4. Move around and use the Distance score, Device radar, Odometer to find your device in seconds!
5. You found the device successfully!

Enjoy using!

bluejetty:00022886:ios.summary: Prayer Now ™ is an integrated Islamic smart app with all the daily needs of every Muslim, such as the Athan, Prayer Times in all countries in the world, Reading The Qur’an, Finding Qiblah and Remembrances, Downloading And Listening to the H
bluejetty:00022886:ios.description:
Prayer Now ™ is an integrated Islamic smart app with all the daily needs of every Muslim, such as the Athan, Prayer Times in all countries in the world, Reading The Qur’an, Finding Qiblah and Remembrances, Downloading And Listening to the Holy Qur’an, Greeting Cards, sharing the Khatma with Muslims around the world, and much more features and updates. Prayer Now innovatively aims to enrich the use of technology to meet all the daily needs of every Muslim.
◼MAIN FEATURES◼
▩Prayer Times and Athan ▩
Very accurate Prayer Times in all countries in the world using GPS or without internet, Also, through the Athan, enjoy the sound of the call to prayer for the most famous voices such as Mishary Rashid - Al-Naqshabadi - Saad Al-Ghamdi .. and many more. Calculation Methods of all famous doctrines with the addition of the Hanafi doctrine of the Asr prayer.
▩Islamic Duties Reminder ▩
Prayer Now reminds you of other Islam duties like Daily Azkar, Qiyaam Al-Layl Prayer, Fasting the White Days, Fasting on Mondays and Thursdays, Reminder to Stand Up for Prayer( Iqama ), Quranic Werd, and Reading Surah Al-Kahf on Friday.
▩Muslim Azkar ▩
You can read or listen to daily Azkar like ( Morning Azkar, Evening Azkar, Before Sleep Azkar, and Prayer Azkar).
▩Holy Quran Kareem ▩
Read the Holy Quran in a professional way by making bookmarks and searching for verses or interpretations, in many languages. You can also listen to the most famous reciters such as Al-Hosary, Ahmed Al-Ajmi, Al-Minshawi, and Saad Al-Ghamdi..and many more.
▩Qibla Direction To Mecca ▩
Prayer Now enables you to determine the direction of the Qibla to Mecca in a smart way via GPS, no matter where you are without the need for the Internet.
▩Nearby Mosques Finder ▩
Easily locate the nearest mosque to you via GPS, display the distance and time needed to reach it, and display the way to reach it.
 ◼OTHER COOL FEATURES◼
▩ Ramadan Islam Collection ▩
Ramadan Collection from Prayer Now, allows you easily get current year calendar or Emsakia, and get reminders of Suhoor and Iftar cannon.
▩Prayer Professional Tools ▩
- Allows auto Silent mode during the Prayer Timings.
- Allows to Auto mute Athan voice when the phone is flipped off the screen.
▩ Smart Widgets ▩
Prayer Now comes with smart customizable reach Widgets that allow showing Prayer Times, Islamic Calendar, and Much more.
▩ Quran Zikr Community ▩
Join Zikr Quran Community, contribute to the seal of the Holy Qur’an with Muslims around the world, and know when the khatam will end.
▩ Prayers Community ▩
Prayer Now allows you to join the community of prayers with millions of Muslims around the world and leave prayer to those you love, and wait for Muslims to respond to your prayers in various parts of the world.
▩ Islamic Wallpapers ▩
Prayer Now team offers a rich, exclusive collection of Islamic wallpapers that you can set to your desktop or smartphone and publish with your friends.
▩ Islamic Greeting Cards ▩
Congratulate Muslims around the world with wonderful and different cards and designs on all occasions such as (Eid Al-Adha - Eid Al-Fitr - The Noble Prophet Birthday - Ramadan - Ashura - Stand of Arafat).
▩ Islamic Library ▩
Prayer Now gives you access to enjoy a comprehensive Islamic online library for a wide range of books from heritage and contemporary Islam.
◼SUPPORT LINKS◼
◾ For suggestions or complaints, use this link
https://www.prayer-now.com/en/suggestions-and-complaints/
◾ Follow us on:
◽◽ Facebook : www.facebook.com/PrayerNowMuslims
◽◽ Twitter : www.twitter.com/prayer_now_azan

bluejetty:00122682:ios.description:
Get instant and secure access to your accounts, deposit cheques, pay your bills and transfer money with Atlantic Edge Credit Union mobile banking app. View your account balances onscreen without even having to log in, convenient for when you’re standing in the checkout line.
Everyday banking in the palm of your hand, no matter where you are.
FEATURES INCLUDE
QUICKVIEW
ACCOUNT DETAILS
BILL PAYMENTS
REMOTE DEPOSIT*
SCHEDULED TRANSACTIONS
TRANSFERS
INTERAC® e-Transfer
MESSAGES
ATM LOCATOR
FINANCIAL CALCULATORS
ACCESS
You log in to the app with the same membership details as online banking and once you log out or 
close the app, your secure session will end. Learn more about how we keep your information secure.
To take advantage of the full functionality of this app, you must already be registered and have logged in to online banking. If you are not an online banking member, you can still use the Branch/ATM locator, Rates and our Contact Us information.
SECURITY
Bank securely and with confidence. Our mobile banking app uses the same high level of security as our online banking. For information on security, please see our security section on our website.
PRIVACY
Your privacy is important to us. We never use your information for any other purpose other than 
delivering financial services to you. For information on our Privacy Policies, and how we keep your information safe, please see our privacy section on our website.
LEGAL
If you install the Atlantic Edge Credit Union app, then you must review and are subject to the terms and conditions found on our website, and the Membership Terms and Conditions that you would have received when your account was opened. If you would like to obtain an updated copy of the Membership Terms and Conditions, please contact us. By downloading the credit union mobile banking application, you consent to the installation of this app, its future updates and upgrades. You can withdraw you consent at any time by deleting the app.
FEES
There is no charge for the app but mobile data downloading and internet charges may apply. Check with your mobile phone provider for details.
*The Deposit Anywhere feature uses the camera function on the mobile device

bluejetty:00180767:ios.name: The I Ching or Book of Changes
bluejetty:00180767:ios.summary: Ancient oracle meets modern classic! Explore an interactive English version of "The I Ching or Book of Changes" by Richard Wilhelm, edited by Hellmut Wilhelm, and translated by Cary F. Baynes, using a coin oracle or yarrow stalks, and an in
bluejetty:00180767:ios.description:
Ancient oracle meets modern classic! Explore an interactive English version of "The I Ching or Book of Changes" by Richard Wilhelm, edited by Hellmut Wilhelm, and translated by Cary F. Baynes, using a coin oracle or yarrow stalks, and an integrated journal.
NOTE: The text is only in English.
The I Ching, or Book of Changes, a common source for both Confucianist and Taoist philosophy, is one of the first efforts of the human mind to place itself within the universe. It has exerted a living influence in China for 3,000 years, and interest in it has been rapidly spreading in the West.
“Princeton's Bollingen edition—still regarded as the best and most authentic by I Ching aficionados.” 
The complete work is available in three books. Book I is included with the I Ching or Book of Changes app. Book I includes Judgments pertaining to the diagrams as a whole, the line texts, and the Great Images.
Book II and III are available for additional in-app purchase.
Book II: The Material
Contains the Shuo Koa and the Ta Chuan from the Ten Wings, plus The Structure of the Hexagrams.
Book III: The Commentaries
Contains passages from the Ten Wings considered commentary to the texts, and On Consulting the Oracle.
Text © 1950, 1967, renewed 1977 by Princeton University Press. Used with permission.
Additional features:
Coins, yarrow stalks, quick and manual input oracle methods
Integrated journal for questions and notes
Component trigrams
Related Hexagrams

bluejetty:00153109:ios.developer: 深圳市游梦科技有限公司
bluejetty:00153109:ios.summary:
"Brainy Prank:Twisted Quest" - Return to Childhood with the Most Heartwarming and Hilarious Spot-the-Difference Challenge!
This is a cozy, nostalgia-filled spot-the-difference game that takes you back to the golden era of bell-bottoms, tin
bluejetty:00153109:ios.description:
"Brainy Prank:Twisted Quest" - Return to Childhood with the Most Heartwarming and Hilarious Spot-the-Difference Challenge!
This is a cozy, nostalgia-filled spot-the-difference game that takes you back to the golden era of bell-bottoms, tin wind-up frogs, and black-and-white TVs! Each level hides "time-traveling" modern items—use your sharp eyes to spot them and unlock hilarious memories!
[The Ultimate Spot-the-Difference Challenge]
 What happens when a 1980s grocery store shelf has instant hotpot?
 When the old green mailbox contains a QR code shipping label?
When a enamel washbasin floats with Pop Mart blind boxes...
How far can YOU make it?
Gameplay Highlights
 A Fresh Take on Spot-the-Difference
Scenes are filled with "out-of-era" modern items—like Bluetooth earbuds next to a vintage radio, or bubble tea in an enamel mug. Find these "time-warp" Easter eggs and laugh your way through!
 Heartwarming Art Style
Hand-drawn retro scenes bring 1980s details to life: weathered brick walls, old sewing machines, corner grocery stores... Every frame feels like a faded photograph, instantly triggering childhood nostalgia!
Wacky Easter Eggs
Think it's just about finding objects? Think again! Tap special props to trigger hidden animations—like pulling back the curtains to find a delivery guy standing outside!
Why You'll Love It
Immersive Nostalgia – From "28-inch bicycles" to "snowy CRT TVs," every detail is spot-on!
Absurdly Funny – A self-heating hotpot in the fridge? Stinky tofu noodles on a coal stove? Ridiculous yet oddly fitting!
Light Strategy + Speed – Timed challenges with a "time extension" lifeline!
Hidden Storylines – Unlock heartwarming (and ridiculous) neighborhood tales from the '80s!
 Download now and see if you're a true '80s kid!
By using this application, you agree to Apple's Standard End User License Agreement (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00130989:ios.summary:
Do you have what it takes to succeed in the thrilling world of storage auctions and become a pawn shop treasure tycoon? 
Feel the rush of making strategic bids in storage auctions just like on TV, as you hunt for valuable treasures in auct
bluejetty:00130989:ios.description:
Do you have what it takes to succeed in the thrilling world of storage auctions and become a pawn shop treasure tycoon? 
Feel the rush of making strategic bids in storage auctions just like on TV, as you hunt for valuable treasures in auctions all over the world! Every new dusty storage unit is an opportunity to uncover hidden gems that can be sold for a hefty profit. Bid against the top treasure hunters and use your keen sense of strategy to outsmart your competitors, secure the best deals, collect treasures and build your pawn shop and treasure hunt legacy in this city building and negotiation game journey!
Feel The Thrill Of The Bid
To succeed in the tough world of storage auctions and pawn shop negotiation game shenanigans, you will need to be savvy and strategic. Carefully assess the value of items and determine how much you are willing to bid. You will also need to keep an eye on your competitors and be ready to make quick decisions when the opportunity arises in this business simulator! Only the savviest and strategy loving tycoons will be able to navigate the complex world of storage auctions and come out on top to build their empire in thus tycoon simulator!
Build Your Business Empire
Winning the most treasure-packed storage units in auctions is just the beginning of your journey in this business simulator negotiation game! Run your very own pawn shop to sell rare items at a huge profit and raise your net worth to millionaire status! Invest your earnings to expand your business empire in town and build your own gallery to display your proud rare item collections to other players all over the world! Become the ultimate city building and collection tycoon simulator player in the treasure hunt world of storage auctions and realize your city building dreams!
Become An Accomplished Treasure Hunter
Treasure hunt and collect all kinds of rare and unique items as you continue to explore the world of storage auctions! As well as being sold for huge sums of cash, these incredible finds can be added to your personal collection and showcased in your own online gallery, making you the envy of other players for your treasure hunting feats! With each successful bid and sale, you'll inch closer to your dream of becoming a true storage auction tycoon simulator player in this millionaire pawn shop business simulator strategy and city building 3D game!
Play The TV Show!
Experience the exciting lives of real-life storage auction treasure hunters and prove your own bidding, negotiating and bargaining skills in the comfort of your mobile device of choice! Do you have what it takes to be successful in the storage auction treasure hunting business and get rich like your favorite TV show personalities? The size of your negotiation game business empire and rare items collection will be your best proof of skill! 
Experience a treasure hunting adventure with awesome 3D game visuals that will let you examine every detail of the incredible and rare items you’ll discover and collect in storage auctions! You’ll also have the opportunity to test your bidding skills in different auction styles in this business simulator and treasure hunt journey. Will you risk your collection and everything in your strategy for a chance of big rare items wins in blind auctions? Or are Dutch auctions more your thing, in which the first person to make a bid wins? Be ready for new and exciting twists at every corner in your treasure hunting journey across the world in this tycoon simulator! Join the ranks of the most successful tycoons in the world of storage auctions and build your millionaire business empire!
Make the bold bid that will start your treasure hunt and pawn shop business empire now in this awesome 3D game adventure filled with rare items! Become a treasure tycoon, collect the most valuable treasures and dominate the exciting world of storage auctions in this incredible millionaire business simulator!

bluejetty:00042056:ios.name: ChatSpace - Chat, Talk & Fun
bluejetty:00042056:ios.summary: Share your thoughts and meet great people in a messaging app that really puts you in contact with the world and like-minded people. ChatSpace is the messenger that will change the way you interact with others. Are you looking for friendship
bluejetty:00042056:ios.description:
Share your thoughts and meet great people in a messaging app that really puts you in contact with the world and like-minded people. ChatSpace is the messenger that will change the way you interact with others. Are you looking for friendship, trivial conversations, fun or expert insights? ChatSpace will help you find and talk to individuals that fascinate you and who will listen to you. ChatSpace will make your life much more meaningful as you become part of a growing community.
Chat about your passion
ChatSpace is a social messaging chat app created to connect real people - their hobbies, experiences, their passion. Just download the app to start interacting. Get in, start talking - that’s all. ChatSpace is all about messaging. If you like ChatSpace, you can upgrade your experience by purchasing in-app credit for additional messages and functionality.
Connect with others
You will discover more than just a messenger. You will talk to others and become a part of a community. In ChatSpace, you’re in control of what happens and expand your experience and your personal profile. You create a digital identity that makes you grow and feel more like yourself than you’ve ever done, attracting others and kickstarting great interactions. Send images to your friends and enjoy fun content that arrives via a reliable connection.
Rely on our solid tech and privacy
ChatSpace is a chat messenger built for individuals, but the platform is universal and easy. Our tech is simple to use and solid. We have real-time conversations and guaranteed delivery. We offer a secure environment where privacy is safeguarded and integrity enforced. Your talk is private and protected. Our community has high standards and cares about your feedback. Do get in touch with anything you need to share, report or wish to be upgraded.
Images and GIFs
ChatSpace is as easy as chatting through other leading messengers - and it is much leaner. It works as reliably as talking to your friends via SMS. No matter if you’re online at the same time or not, your message will arrive. This is also true if you add images like GIFs to the chat. These will be sent to your contacts and will make you enjoy the conversation even more.
You are what you chat about. You are free to say what you want. You are what you choose to be on ChatSpace. Why don’t you turn ChatSpace into your personal messenger right now?
Please email us if you have any questions or feedback at support@chatspace.com
Terms of Service: https://www.chatspace.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.chatspace.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00022991:ios.description:
Con l’app CieID puoi accedere ai servizi online della Pubblica Amministrazione e dei privati aderenti ad “Entra con CIE”.
Attiva le credenziali CIE (livello 1 e 2) su www.cartaidentita.it, apri l’App e configura l’accesso semplificato. Potrai autorizzare i tuoi accessi da PC semplicemente:
- inquadrando dalla App il QR code che trovi nella pagina di richiesta accesso e inserendo il codice app CieID che avrai creato in fase di certificazione del dispositivo; se hai attiva la biometria, l’accesso è ancora più semplice perché puoi sostituirla al codice app CieID
oppure
- inserendo le tue credenziali CieID (username e password) nella pagina di richiesta accesso, riceverai una notifica push in App che dovrai accettare tramite l’utilizzo del codice app CieID o della biometria.
Se accedi al servizio online da smartphone, autenticati con le credenziali CieID oppure apri la App e inserisci il codice app CieID, usa il riconoscimento biometrico se attivo.
Se hai un iPhone dotato di tecnologia NFC puoi scegliere di accedere con il massimo livello di sicurezza (livello 3). Dopo aver ricevuto la tua Carta di Identità Elettronica, apri l’App e registra la tua carta inserendo il PIN di otto cifre e avvicinando la Carta sul retro dell’iPhone quando richiesto. 
Con l’App CieID è inoltre disponibile la funzionalità di Recupero PUK, per i cittadini in possesso di una Carta di Identità Elettronica che hanno associato alla propria identità digitale un indirizzo di posta elettronica o un numero di cellulare.
Dichiarazione di accessibilità: https://form.agid.gov.it/view/85d3aa40-88cd-11f0-ae26-159be1ec7c8c

The official USDF and USEF Test Learning App

>> "Flexible and user friendly 5*"
>> "Test saver! 5*"

+ DRAW movements with your finger, TestPro knows the test and gives you hints
+ TAP forwards or backwards in the test a move at a time
+ WATCH the test played, start and stop anywhere
+ LISTEN as movements are spoken out loud individually or while playing

This world needs a little color! Don’t you think? That’s why it’s time to liven things up in Pencil Rush 3D!
How to play Pencil Rush 3D?
1. Open the app and pick up your tool – a colorful pencil.
2. Next, it’s time to take on the challenge. With your pencil in hand, trace and race your way along the obstacle course.

5. Run and make it to the finish line. Look at that colorful collection. Amazing!
Don’t live in a world of gray! Play Pencil Rush 3D and color your day with the rainbow.

bluejetty:00079182:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00079182:ios.description:
Stay safe in the sun with accurate UV forecasts, personalized exposure insights, and smart tools for Time in Daylight and Vitamin D across iPhone and Apple Watch.
Trusted by thousands worldwide, Sunbeam helps you know when UV levels are high, reduce your risk of sunburn, and make more confident decisions about time outdoors. Check the UV Index in seconds, track your sun exposure, and better understand how sunlight fits into your health and daily routine.
Why people choose Sunbeam:
- Know when to protect your skin: See accurate UV forecasts for your current location or anywhere you travel.
- Reduce your risk of sunburn: Understand when UV levels are high and track your personalized sunburn risk over time.
- Understand your sun exposure: Monitor Time in Daylight, Vitamin D, and exposure history with simple, useful insights.
- Plan outdoor time more easily: View hourly UV forecasts for the next 10 days across your favorite locations around the world.
- Beautiful widgets: Check UV forecasts, Vitamin D, and Time in Daylight right on your Home Screen or Lock Screen.
- Live Activities: Track sun exposure sessions in real time from your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island.
- Full Apple Watch support: Use the Apple Watch app and complications to stay informed in the sun wherever you are.
- Siri and Shortcuts support: Check the UV, start an exposure session, view your sun exposure, and more with best-in-class iOS integrations.
- Make your health data more useful: Sync Time in Daylight and Vitamin D with Apple Health.
- Choose a privacy-first app: Your data stays yours. Sunbeam never sells your data or uses it for targeted ads.
Whether you want to protect your skin, spend more time outdoors with confidence, or build a better understanding of your daily sunlight exposure, Sunbeam helps you make smarter decisions in the sun.
Certain features require a Sunbeam Pro subscription.
=========================
If you purchase a Sunbeam Pro subscription, payment will be charged to your Apple ID Account. You will be automatically charged for renewal unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. You can turn off auto-renew at any time by going to your Account Settings on the App Store after purchase. All purchases are final and refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.
Privacy Policy: https://richardj.org/sunbeam/privacy-policy/
Terms and Conditions: https://richardj.org/sunbeam/terms-and-conditions/
=========================

It provides a full facial assessment and analysis, including suggested amounts of fillers and Botox, along with a comprehensive price guide. Cost Transparency: Along with each treatment recommendation, get an estimate of the cost, helping you to budget for your beauty investments wisely.
Comprehensive Product Database: Explore an extensive catalog of botox and filler products. Learn about each option's benefits, suitability, and price range to find the perfect match for your needs.
AIAesthetics is your ultimate tool for exploring and planning cosmetic treatments. With our app, embarking on your beauty enhancement journey is informed, personalized, and transparent. Download AIAesthetics today and start your transformation!

bluejetty:00161833:ios.description:
Virtual Truck Manager 3 is a deep truck management and logistics tycoon where you build a real trucking company—one delivery at a time. Buy trucks, assign trailers, schedule routes, manage drivers, and grow a network of depots across Europe and North America.
Build your trucking company
Start small with a single yard, then expand into a continent-spanning freight business.
Buy and upgrade trucks with real-world inspired specs
Choose the right trailers for every job
Grow your hubs into busy logistics centers with warehouses and offices
Manage a fleet like a real dispatcher
This is not just a clicker—every decision impacts profit and reliability.
Hire and train drivers, mechanics, and dispatchers
Track fuel use, wear, repairs, and driver stamina in real time
Balance loans, maintenance, and operating costs to stay profitable
Use dashboards, KPIs, and smart alerts to keep your fleet moving
Cargo, contracts, and a living economy
Dominate the market in a player-driven economy where demand shifts constantly.
Match cargo types to the correct trailer for bonuses and on-time rewards
Compete on the marketplace, win contracts, and build your own delivery network
Dynamic supply & demand means no two runs feel the same
Live map operations
See your logistics empire come alive on a live map.
Day/night cycle and weather effects
Events like traffic and changing conditions that keep routes fresh
Expand strategically across regions and optimize your network
Multiplayer and competitive play
Prove you’re the best truck manager in global competition.
Form partnerships/alliances with friends
Outbid rivals in synchronous auctions
Climb global leaderboards in league play
Key features
70+ trucks and 20+ trailer classes
Realistic management systems: maintenance, budget, operations
Live map with weather + day/night cycle
Fleet dashboards, KPIs, and smart alerts
Depots across Europe and North America
Seasonal events and limited-time cargo contracts
Partnerships to play together
If you love truck simulator management, fleet tycoon, and building a real logistics empire, Virtual Truck Manager 3 is your next long-term strategy game.
Download now and turn every delivery into profit.

we have always been dedicated to crafting classic mobile games designed for seniors that bring back relaxation, fun, and joy. Our repertoire includes popular titles like Solitaire, 
spades, Color, Jigsaw, Mahjong, Word Search, Block, and more.
+Immerse yourself in the exciting world of the Solitaire game!
+test your card-playing skills with this amazing FREE solitaire game.
+ Get ready for a classic Solitaire adventure like no other!
Why Choose our Solitaire?
Large Card Design: Our large fonts and oversized cards ensure that each game is easy on the eyes. This results in an exceptional solitaire game experience, whether you're using a pad or phone.
Classic Gameplay: Classic solitaire is one of the most addictive card games. We offer you the most classic rules and an authentic card gaming experience.
Brain-Training Challenge: Playing our free solitaire card game enhances problem-solving skills, mental alacrity, and can even aids in a getting a better sleep, making it a truly all around beneficial puzzle card game.
Smooth Interaction: Navigating through our intuitive card game interface is effortless. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned veteran of solitaire, you're guaranteed to have a fantastic time in no time.
Key Features 
Enjoy a wide variety of Solitaire games on the go, no matter where you are.
Switch between Landscape and Portrait modes for your comfort.
Compatible with a wide range of devices
Move cards with a simple tap or a smooth drag-and-drop motion.
Available in multiple languages, making it accessible to Solitaire players worldwide.
Exclusive Solitaire Card Game Features:
Improve Your Skills: Opt for either Draw 1 or Draw 3 modes to experience the classic challenges.
Unlimited deck of cards: There are always a new patience solitaire card game to play.
Various Theme: Engage with different styles of cards and backgrounds under the classic gameplay.
Useful Hint: Endless hints & undo which help you when you get stuck in the card game.
Daily Card Challenges: Take on daily challenges, collect trophies, and improve your skills.
Rewards for Every Game: Collect suits or numbers to complete game tasks and unlock free rewards.
Game Statistics: Keep improving and challenging yourself during every free solitaire game.
Multi-device: Optimized the classic games experience for both phone and pad of all shapes.
Offline Solitaire Card Game Play: Enjoy free solitaire card game offline anytime and anywhere without wifi.
Multi-Card Games: Enjoy various card games for free such as Freecell, Spades, Mahjong Solitaire, and more.

Classic never fades. Solitaire, or Patience is the best way to relax and pass the time, play it anytime, anywhere with patience and insistence. You would love playing this free Solitaire card game.

4. Relax, welcome to parking as it should be.
--------
COMING SOON

--------

bluejetty:00180949:ios.description:
► BAND TOGETHER AND HEAD INTO BATTLE
Ready for a casual fantasy adventure involving epic battles, awesome characters, and a whole host of incredible merge puzzle mechanics that combine together to create a truly addictive casual game, guaranteed to test your tactical abilities and attract an army of ardent fans? Then strap on your armor, summon your army and charge headlong into the exciting world of Merge Legions, where every new adventure is just a single merge away. Download the game now and get merging for victory.
► ARE YOU A MERGE MASTER?
• COMBINED FORCES: Your village is under attack, and to defend it you’ll need to amass an army. Start small in this tactical game by merging simple peasants to create hardened warriors, then head into battle to see if your forces are strong enough to win.
• JOINED UP TACTICS: The more you merge, the stronger your soldiers become, but remember each merge requires energy and, when it comes to fighting, the number of troops in your army is just as important as the strength of each individual warrior. It takes tactical thinking to apportion your resources wisely for the best outcomes.
• A MOTLEY BUT MIGHTY CREW: Your army consists not only of swordsmen, but also orcs, archers, attack insects and—as you progress through the game—mages and other mythical creatures. They can all be merged like-for-like to reach new levels of battle strength and skill.
• SPOILT FOR CHOICE: As your ranks swell, you’ll be able to try out almost endless combinations of different troops to make up a winning squad. Keep soldiers in reserve for special occasions or max out a small battle-hardened team of almost invincible warriors. But remember, if they do die in a fight, you’ll have to start again from scratch.
• EVERYTHING’S COMING TOGETHER: It’s not just soldiers you can merge in this game, you can also level up armor, weaponry, clothing, potions, portals and much more. If you see two of an object on the board, bring them together and find out what you get. Merging can unlock a whole host of in-game benefits, from extra currency to improved fighting stats to energy boosters that will allow you to merge even more.
• KEEP ON QUESTING: Complete daily, weekly and campaign quests to earn even more rewards, with multiple ways to boost your fighting strength, better equip your squad, and expand your resources.
• FEELS MEDIEVAL: As well as beautiful fantasy graphics with great character detail and engaging animation, Merge Legions boasts awesome sound design, with stirring music and realistic noises of battle that really bring the game’s medieval world to life.
► READY FOR THE FIGHT OF YOUR LIFE?
Get ready to save your kingdom and protect your honor in this awesome and original fantasy adventure. Install Merge Legions now and experience a new level of casual gaming fun that merges the best of fighting and puzzle games into a single addictive and entertaining package.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

bluejetty:00121038:ios.description:
A unique multiplayer GPS game, with your own whiskey, emoji, police and dragons. Be a peaceful builder, or an implacable arsonist, it's up to you! 
PLAY IN THE REAL WORLD
This is a game set in the places you visit every day. Your character goes where you go!
Matrix!
CLAIM NEIGHBORHOOD
Stake your claim on places around town by planting cacti. Develop your area and defend it from others.
MEET OTHER PLAYERS
In Cheapshot, players see each other in real time on the map. Talk to them, make new friends or enemies — it’s up to you (and your level of charisma in real life).
BECOME A FORMIDABLE OPPONENT
As you level up, and put on cool gear, you increase the size of a lot of your stats. Soon the whole town will want to be friends with you if only for fear of the size of your damage. 
Features:
- The largest open world in the history of mobile gaming. The whole planet is in your pocket!
- Your own feet as the main game tool. Moving in the real world, you move around the game world. 
- Lots of fun avatars available to choose from. Literally hundreds of options! 
- Regular events with unique and valuable loot. Don't miss out!
- Local and global leaderboards. Can you become the strongest in the city? 
- Taking care of your own territory includes elements from idle, tower defense, and even strategy games - 3 in 1!
- Rewards for each new level, what's waiting for you on the next one?
- Deep system of characteristics and equipment, combine items to suit your own play style. Maybe you're a pacifist and you're not going to make a single shot? - No problem! We don't mind! Give all your attack items to your friends. 
- Absolute sandbox, no quests from tedious NPCs. The only limitation: your love for your own neighbors. 
“So much fun!! The only game I've got hooked on for years. Be all cute and burn other peoples buildings, ain’t that the dream??” — Chris.P.Bacon
“Best game literally” — LordGhadi
Join thousands of players around the world, and experience for yourself what it's like to drop everything you're doing for the day to go around town saving your poor little flowers from the fire!

bluejetty:00076310:ios.summary: AirDroid Parental Control App is designed for your child's safety as a priority. With the high safety features provided by AirDroid Parental Control, you can easily contact your child when they are not around you or they can't respond to yo
bluejetty:00076310:ios.description:
AirDroid Parental Control App is designed for your child's safety as a priority. With the high safety features provided by AirDroid Parental Control, you can easily contact your child when they are not around you or they can't respond to you on time. Find your child in a tap, extremely easy!
New Driving Detection helps parents stay informed about their child’s driving safety. Track driving activity, view trip details, and understand driving habits to encourage safer choices on the road. AirDroid keeps families connected and provides peace of mind while teens build driving independence.
The latest AI-enhanced content control system is now live, delivering more precise and intelligent filtering of inappropriate content.
We're able to access iOS devices now, including features like:
• Daily downtime and app limits are set by the Parent App.
• Website and app usage monitoring on the child’s device.
• App blocking like inappropriate browsers, games, and social apps on the child’s device
• Website blocking and category blocking such as games, gambling, and lockout of unwanted content on the child’s device
• Safe search and custom black-and-white list on the child’s device
• Location tracking of the child's device
• Advanced reporting provided to parents
• Real-time alerts sent to parents
Online monitor, content filter, and anti-cyberbullying functions have been released, which could improve the performance of kids' safeguards and ensure your loved child is always under perfect protection built by you.
What makes you choose AirDroid Parental Control:
· Real-time monitoring - Cast your child's device screen to your phone in real-time to find out what apps they're using in school and the frequency of use to prevent them from getting addicted to their phone.
· Sync app notification - Real-time sync function helps you to know more about your child's chat on social media like Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, etc. Help your child to stay far away from cyberbullying and online fraud.
· Screen time - Set up a unique schedule for your child to limit their use time and prevent them from focusing on it while having class.
· App blocker - Set up phone access permission to ensure your child can only access the permitted app, also you will get an alert when your child tries to install or delete apps.
· GPS location tracker - With the high-accuracy location tracker, you can track your child's location on the map and see their historical route for the day. Ensure your child is safe and they won't visit any high-risk places.
· Location alert - Custom Geofence to your child, you will receive alerts when they pass, just like a 24/7 guard to follow and protect your child.
· Battery check - Monitor your child's device charging status, once the device's power is running low, a notification will be sent to their phone to remind them to charge their phone in time, always stay in touch!
To activate AirDroid Parental Control would be super easy:
1. Install 'AirDroid Parental Control' on your phone.
2. Connect your kids' devices by the invited link or code.
3. Install 'AirDroid Kids' successfully.
4. Link your account with your kid's device, then it works.
To use AirDroid Parental Control you will need to download the app onto each device you wish to control.
AirDroid Parental Control app offers a 3-day free trial of all Premium features. When the trial ends, access to features requires a subscription, with discounts for longer commitments.
The cost of a subscription will be debited from your iTunes account. The subscription will automatically be renewed at chosen intervals unless canceled more than 24 hours before the end of the subscription period. Subscription management is available in the settings of your iTunes account after purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://kids.airdroid.info/#/Privacy
Terms of Service: https://kids.airdroid.info/#/Eula
Payment Terms: https://kids.airdroid.info/#/Payment
Contact Us:
support@airdroid.com

bluejetty:00126842:ios.description:
Just Between Us is a fun chat app for couples that want to keep the spark alive through a fun and interactive messaging system.
Couples using Just Between Us can send photos, videos, texts, romantic invites and conversation prompts. Long distance couples can send each other a thumb kiss as well.
The app is password protected so you can feel confident knowing that no one else will accidentally stumble across your conversations. 
Communicating with your spouse with Just Between Us is encrypted to protect private communication. The app works only with one other person that you synced with, giving couples a dedicated channel for private communication. Just Between Us has undergone an audit by a private third-party security company to independently review its security implementation. It truly is a safe and secure way to connect remotely with your partner! 
How It Works:
1. Download the app and set up your free account. 
2. Invite your sweetheart to do the same. 
3. Share your unique sync code with him or her.
4. Instantly send messages, photos, or videos to each other.
With Just Between Us, you’ll enjoy more flirting, more fun, and a deeper connection with your sweetheart, with the peace of mind that your communication is just between the two of you.
About In-app Purchases
This app is free to download and use right away. You can upgrade to unlock its premium features. Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. You can go to your Apple Account settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. 
Visit https://getyourmarriageon.com/terms-of-use/ to read our full Terms Of Service and https://getyourmarriageon.com/privacy-policy/ to learn about our Privacy Policy. 
Frequently Asked Questions:
Q. Who is this app for?
A. it's designed for couples in committed relationships (e.g. married couples).
Q. What do people use this app for?
A. Sending messages - including photos and videos - to just one other person, not a group or multiple individuals.
Q. Can I chat with multiple people or groups with this messaging app?
A. No. You can message only the one person you're synced with.
Q. Are our messages truly private and encrypted?
A. Yes. This app uses RSA and AES encryption to help protect your private communication.
Q. Besides sending messages and photos, what else makes this app unique?
A. You can send each other "thumb kisses", create photo galleries of your favorite photos, stage photos and videos to send for later, answer inspiring questions to spark conversation, and send invitations to each other.

bluejetty:00086379:ios.summary: mojeIKP is a free application from the Polish Ministry of Health. Install and receive e-referrals, e-prescriptions and e-orders for medical devices right on your phone. Show the QR code at a pharmacy and fill an e-prescription without provi
bluejetty:00086379:ios.description:
mojeIKP is a free application from the Polish Ministry of Health. Install and receive e-referrals, e-prescriptions and e-orders for medical devices right on your phone. Show the QR code at a pharmacy and fill an e-prescription without providing your PESEL (Polish resident identification number). Review your treatment history. Set a reminder to take the medication. Check the medication's leaflet by scanning its packaging. Grant access to your Electronic Medical Records (EDM) to medical staff and facilities. Apply for an EHIC or a replacement certificate for the EHIC. In an emergency, use the rescue function, which will provide step-by-step instructions on how to provide first aid. Have important healthcare phones on hand. Enjoy a free exercise program, pedometer, hydration counter and access to a diet portal.
Basic functionality:
• buying a medication at a pharmacy without having to provide your PESEL number, just let the pharmacist scan the QR code
• quick and convenient access to e-prescriptions and e-referrals by phone, directly from the PUSH notification received
• access to medical events history and Electronic Medical Records (EDM)
• review of e-orders for medical devices
• access to the "My Health" preventive health program and the "10 for Health" questionnaire.
• checking the statusdostęp do programu profilaktycznego "moje zdrowie" of the right to NFZ benefits
• possibility to check the dosage of the prescribed medication
• possibility to set a reminder to take a medicine
• access to the medication leaflet after scanning the package code
• downloading e-prescriptions and e-referrals as a pdf file, which can be sent to relatives or medical staff by e-mail or text message
• granting access to your Electronic Medical Records (EDM) to medical staff and facilities
• applying for the EHIC and the certificate temporarily replacing the EHIC
• access to the Individual Medical Care Plan (IPOM)
• access to children's medical records
• e-registration for specialist appointments, COVID-19 vaccination, HPV vaccination, and preventive screenings
• calculating the risk of death from cardiovascular diseases
• access to information on how to give first aid
• quick access to diets prepared by the Polish National Health Fund (NFZ), including recipes and shopping lists
• quiz on prevention
• "8 weeks to health" training program
• information about the number of steps taken integrated with the Health app
• support for proper hydration of the body
• access to the Home Medical Care program
• ability to verify a medical professional

HOW IT WORKS
• Paste a message or emai
bluejetty:00129716:ios.description:
Not sure what to say? Paste their message, pick a style, and Better Reply writes three replies you can send. Answer texts, emails and chats in seconds, or rewrite what you've typed so it sounds right.
HOW IT WORKS
• Paste a message or email, or add a screenshot of the chat
• Pick a style, like Be kind, Say no politely or Formal email
• Get a reply. Swipe for another, tap Change it to adjust it, and tap to copy.
60 REPLY STYLES
Kind, short, formal, funny or firm: pick from 60 styles for everyday life, work, friends, fun and tricky moments. Search the library and add the ones you use to your list.
YOUR OWN TEMPLATES
Describe how you want to sound and Better Reply writes the template for you, with a sample reply to try. Or write it yourself. Every template is checked for safety before it's saved.
REPLY FROM ANY APP
• Keyboard: turn on the Better Reply keyboard and use Reply to copied or Rewrite mine in your chat, email and work apps
• Share: share a message or a screenshot from any app and pick a reply
• Reply to Copied: copy a message, then open it from Siri, Spotlight, the Action button or Control Center
The keyboard always types like a normal keyboard. Full Access is only needed for replies and rewrites, and text is only sent when you tap one of them. Nothing is sent to the AI service until you agree.
BETTER REPLY PRO
300 replies a day and as many custom templates as you like, plus every Pro style, in the app and the keyboard. Pro is an auto-renewing subscription charged to your Apple ID. It renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

bluejetty:00178267:ios.description:
Notice your dreams. Guide them gently.
Lucidity is a clean, privacy-minded dream journal and lucid dreaming tool. Capture dreams fast before they fade, add simple tags and moods, and use gentle tools that support awareness—never noise.
Why Lucidity?
- Simple & fast: Open, write, done. Clean typography and a focused editor help you get thoughts out quickly.
- Beginner friendly: Explore and learn about the world of lucid dreaming with easy to use guides.
- Remember more: Subtle prompts and timing options encourage consistent journaling without getting in your way.
- Your data, your call: Clear controls and a straightforward Privacy Policy. No precise location or health data collection.
- Privacy first: Require biometric authentication to access the app (optional)
Highlights
Dream Journal: Write entries with optional tags and moods; search, filter, and favorite entries when you need to find something later.
Gentle Timing Tools: Optional reminders to aid in your lucid dreaming journey
Auto Shutoff Alarms: Short gentle alarms that wake you then stop—so you can slip back into a dream routine.
Sync & Restore: Sign in to keep your journal backed up and available across your devices.
Lucidity PRO (optional upgrade) includes:
- Remove ads
- Dream journal analytics to help you identify trends and oddities in your dreams.
- Support ongoing development, with additional features over time
Support & Policies
Support: support@lucidityapp.co
Privacy: lucidityapp.co/privacy-policy
Terms: lucidityapp.co/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00013885:ios.description:
BRImo merupakan mobile banking favorit masyarakat Indonesia dengan total 41,3 juta pengguna hingga saat ini. Dirancang untuk memfasilitasi berbagai transaksi keuangan nasabah kapan saja dan di mana saja, BRImo hadir dengan berbagai fitur unggulan yang memenuhi kebutuhan finansial dan gaya hidup dalam satu aplikasi. 
Nikmati pengalaman finansial yang serba mudah dan serba bisa hanya dengan BRImo. Jangan sampai ketinggalan untuk merasakan kemudahan layanan BRImo yang banyak dipilih oleh jutaan pengguna!
• Registrasi dari Dalam dan Luar Negeri
BRImo memungkinkan pendaftaran akun BRI dan buka rekening secara full digital tanpa perlu kartu debit, baik dari dalam maupun luar negeri. Nasabah dapat mendaftar menggunakan nomor HP dari 11 negara, termasuk Jepang, Korea Selatan, Hong Kong, USA, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Malaysia, Taiwan, Singapura, dan Timor Leste. Proses pendaftaran menjadi lebih fleksibel dan mudah.
• Transaksi Antar Negara
BRImo memudahkan nasabah yang memiliki kebutuhan transaksi internasional melalui fitur transfer ke lebih dari 160 negara. Selain itu, BRImo mendukung pembayaran menggunakan QR di luar negeri (Singapura), memberikan kemudahan bertransaksi saat bepergian.
• Lifestyle dan Entertainment
BRImo menyediakan berbagai layanan gaya hidup serta hiburan seperti pembelian voucher game, streaming, tiket BRI Liga 1, hingga pemesanan dan pembayaran tiket transportasi termasuk pesawat, semuanya dalam satu aplikasi.
• Investasi
BRImo menyediakan beragam pilihan produk investasi bagi nasabah, mulai dari dana pensiun hingga emas. Bekerja sama dengan Pegadaian, BRImo menawarkan layanan jual, beli, dan cicil emas. Nasabah dapat mengelola investasinya dengan mudah melalui dashboard KSEI dan akses langsung ke BRIGHTS untuk pembelian saham.
• Transaksi Sehari-Hari
BRImo memudahkan berbagai transaksi harian, mulai dari pembayaran tagihan dan cicilan, top up e-wallet dan pulsa/paket data, hingga pembayaran QRIS dengan sumber dana kartu kredit. BRImo juga memungkinkan setor tunai tanpa kartu di ATM BRI, memberikan kemudahan ekstra dalam mengelola keuangan. Dapatkan BRIpoin setiap kali bertransaksi dan tukarkan poin tersebut dengan berbagai e-voucher menarik.
• Layanan Pelanggan yang Mudah Diakses
BRImo menyediakan layanan Contact BRI bebas pulsa, serta fitur chat dalam aplikasi untuk pengaduan transaksi, memastikan nasabah mendapatkan bantuan dengan cepat dan efisien.
• Cashback Realtime
BRImo menjadi satu-satunya aplikasi mobile banking yang menawarkan cashback secara realtime untuk berbagai transaksi finansial, memberikan nilai tambah bagi setiap transaksi yang dilakukan. Jangan lewatkan kesempatan untuk menikmati berbagai manfaat eksklusif hanya di BRImo!
Butuh Bantuan?
Hubungi Layanan Pelanggan BRI:
* Telepon: 1500017
* Email: callbri@bri.co.id
Ingin Tahu Lebih Banyak?
Temukan informasi lengkap tentang BRI dan layanan lainnya:
* Website: bri.co.id
* Facebook: BRIofficialpage

* Youtube: @BANK_BRI
