Whether you
bluejetty:00036498:ios.description:
Meet Skillsta — your pocket trainer for mastering real-life skills! We've broken down complex concepts into bite-sized practical lessons that fit your busy schedule. Skillsta is about learning, doing, and succeeding, all in one.
Whether you're looking to express yourself with confidence, improve how you connect with others, or unlock your full potential — Skillsta is here to empower you to achieve your goals.
———————
WHAT DO YOU GET WITH SKILLSTA?
*Personalized growth journey 
Tailored to fit your goals and pace, your journey ensures you're not just learning — you're growing.
*AI-powered role plays 
Practice new skills through realistic situations while still staying in your comfort zone.
*Consistent recaps 
Reinforce new knowledge with recaps so the skills you learn today stay with you tomorrow.
*Daily dose of microlearning 
Our bite-sized practical lessons take 10 min a day, helping you learn on the go, even with a busy schedule.
*Fun and engaging approach 
Forget about boring books and lectures! Say hi to our bite-sized interactive lessons that make growing enjoyable.
———————
WHAT CAN YOU IMPROVE WITH SKILLSTA?
*Confidence
*Communication
*Storytelling
*Empathy
*Body language
*Active listening
*Creativity
*Self-expression
*Focus
*Charisma
———————
HOW DOES IT WORK?
After you choose to learn with Skillsta and download the app, you can start a 3-day free trial for the weekly plan.
Unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial, you will be automatically charged a price indicated on the payment screen for a chosen subscription period. Don’t worry, though — in any case, you’ll receive a reminder from us that your free trial is about to end.
Also, we offer alternative plans that let you subscribe to the app without a trial.
Note that deleting the app does not cancel your subscriptions.
Terms of Use: https://skillsta.app/policy/terms-and-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://www.skillsta.app/policy/privacy-policy
Subscription Terms: https://skillsta.app/policy/subscription-terms

bluejetty:00073647:ios.description:
Opera GX brings the gaming lifestyle to your mobile. Express yourself with custom skins, discover free games and the best deals with GX Corner, share links easily between mobile and desktop with My Flow, and much more. All in a secure, private browser.
Designed for gamers
Opera GX’s unique design is inspired by gaming and gaming gear, with the same style that won the desktop GX browser the Red Dot and IF Design awards. Choose from custom themes like GX Classic, Ultra Violet, Purple Haze and White Wolf.
Free games, gaming deals, upcoming releases
Always just a tap away, GX Corner brings you daily gaming news, an upcoming release calendar and trailers. It’s everything a gamer needs to stay on top of the latest news and gaming deals in their mobile web browser.
Connect your phone and computer
Just scan a QR code to connect your phone and computer with Flow. It’s encrypted and safe, with no login, password or account needed. Send links, videos, files and notes to yourself in a single click, and access them instantly in your web browser on all your devices.
Lightning fast browser
Choose between the Fast Action Button (FAB) and standard navigation. The FAB is always within reach of your thumb and uses vibrations when you interact with it, which is perfect when you’re on the move.
Private browser: ad blocker, cookie dialog blocker, and more
Browse safely and load pages faster with integrated security features like the built-in ad blocker and cookie dialog blocker. This secure browser also comes with cryptojacking protection, stopping others from using your device to mine cryptocurrencies.
About Opera GX
Opera is a global web innovator headquartered in Oslo, Norway and listed on the NASDAQ stock exchange (OPRA). Founded in 1995 on the idea that everyone should be able to browse the web, we have spent the last 25+ years helping millions of people access the internet in a safe, private and innovative way.
By downloading this application, you are agreeing to the End User Licence Agreement at https://www.opera.com/eula/mobile Also, you can learn how Opera handles and protects your data in our Privacy Statement at https://www.opera.com/privacy

* Beauty, Simplicity, and Reliability - myHomework has a gorgeous appearance and simple interface making it easy for anyone to use. Our apps fill their role as a planner without network connectivity.

2013: Edudemic The 16 Apps And Tools Worth Trying This Year

- Supports time, block and period-based schedules
- Universal (both iPhone, iPad and iPod touch) 
- Compatibility for iPhone 6 and 6 Plus

- Access to our website

bluejetty:00175267:ios.description:
Be brave, be Miraculous! Protect Paris and play as your favorite magical super heroez - Ladybug and Cat Noir!
Explore the city, help friends and complete hero missions! Unleash your creativity while you style characters and make Marinette’s room the ultimate hideout!
Help teenagers Marinette Dupain-Cheng and Adrien Agreste transform into superheroes Ladybug and Cat Noir to protect the city from Akumatized supervillains! With the help of their Kwamis and friends, they can show their true potential! Power up and experience a Miraculous Life! Spots On!
EXPLORE & PLAY - Explore all over Paris while you help your friends, earning magic ladybug coins along the way! Be your own hero!
TRANSFORM - Tikki, spots on! Transform from Marinette and Adrien into Ladybug and Cat Noir to save Paris!
HOUSE DESIGN - Help decorate Marinette’s bedroom and unleash your inner stylist! Style her room your way with new paint, wallpaper, furniture & cute decorations!
FASHION DESIGN - Miraculous Makeovers! Get creative and style the characters with your favorite outfits, shoes and accessories.
HERO MISSIONS - Help your friends and crush supervillians to protect the city!
SAFE & KID FRIENDLY - Fun kids games designed for pre-school, kindergarten, elementary school girls & boys, based on their favorite show available on YouTube, YouTube Kids & Netflix! This interactive Miraculous game is easy and fun to play for children aged 5-9. Parents and other family members can play along too!

- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period 
- You can cancel your subscription at any time, but please note that you will not get a refund for any remaining period of a subscription
- Users may be offered a free trial of the subscription
- One free trial per account, on new subscriptions only

bluejetty:00144698:ios.description:
Looking for a better way to train your dog?
PawChamp is a personalized dog training app trusted by 1,000,000+ dog parents worldwide. Developed with certified dog trainers, behaviorists, and canine experts, PawChamp helps you train your dog, build better habits, and solve common behavior problems with simple, proven methods.
Get help with puppy training, leash pulling, barking, biting, separation anxiety, reactivity, obedience, basic commands, and more, all from your phone.
How can PawChamp help train your dog?
Follow a personalized dog training plan built around your dog’s needs, behavior, and progress.
With PawChamp, you can:
GET a personalized dog training plan
TRAIN with step-by-step video lessons led by dog experts
ASK professional dog trainers for help 24/7 for free
FOLLOW daily training sessions designed for your dog
PRACTICE commands, obedience exercises, and games
STOP unwanted barking, biting, leash pulling, and other behavior problems
LEARN techniques for separation anxiety and dog reactivity
TRACK your training progress with daily streaks
TEST your knowledge with quick dog training quizzes
DOWNLOAD ebooks and training planners
JOIN challenges that help build lasting habits
CALM your dog with vagus nerve routines
What dog behavior problems can PawChamp help with?
PawChamp combines positive dog training techniques with practical guidance from canine experts to help with:
• Leash pulling
• Excessive barking
• Puppy biting
• Separation anxiety
• Reactivity
• Basic obedience
• Commands and recall
• Focus and impulse control
• Calm behavior and healthy routines
Whether you’re training a puppy or working on an adult dog’s behavior, lessons are broken into short sessions that are easy to fit into your day.
Why use PawChamp for dog training?
PawChamp is built for busy dog parents who want clear guidance rather than complicated training routines.
Personalized training: Follow a plan adapted to your dog’s needs.
Expert guidance: Learn from certified dog trainers, behaviorists, and canine experts.
Positive methods: Use science-backed, positive dog training techniques.
Quick sessions: Train consistently without spending hours each day.
Real support: Ask professional dog trainers questions whenever you need help.
Can I use PawChamp for puppy training?
Yes. PawChamp can help you build good habits from the start with puppy training exercises for biting, leash walking, commands, obedience, focus, calm behavior, and more.
You can also continue using PawChamp as your dog grows, with training plans designed for different behaviors and needs.
Is PawChamp free?
PawChamp is free to download and use, and some features are available for free.
To unlock all video lessons, premium challenges, and full personalization, upgrade to a paid subscription. Cancel anytime.
Start training with PawChamp today and build a happier, calmer relationship with your dog.
If you have any issues, contact us at support@paw-champ.com
Privacy Policy: https://paw-champ.com/policy
Terms of Use: https://paw-champ.com/terms

bluejetty:00078203:ios.description:
BANK! is the fast-paced group dice game where you roll, score, and BANK—before someone rolls a 7!

- No player limit—invite everyone!
- Simple to learn, impossible to put down
FEATURES
• Supports 2+ players (no upper limit)
• Cross-platform: iPhone, iPad, and Web
• Automatic digital scoring
• Undo/redo for mistakes
• Game history tracking
• No internet required
Download now and start your first game in seconds!

Whether you’re a beginner or working toward fluency, Du Chinese gives you the tools to read, listen, and understand Mandarin naturally, offering effective Chinese reading practice at every level. With Du Chinese, every story is carefully written, recorded, and translated by our language experts to help you improve your Mandarin Chinese skills faster. We follow proven language learning methods to help you make real, lasting progress in your Chinese language skills. Dive deeper into your learning with detailed grammar tips, built-in dictionary, and a built-in flashcard system to reinforce your Mandarin Chinese vocabulary.
Learning that fits your lifestyle: If you are looking for a quick read before bed, quality focus time with a reading, or a story to listen to while commuting, you’ll find what you need in Du Chinese. Our extensive library of immersive Chinese stories helps you stay engaged, making Mandarin feel natural and fun, so you’ll look forward to reading Chinese every day.

• Instant access to pinyin, definitions, translations, and grammar explanations
• Native speaker audio for every reading
• Built-in dictionary and flashcards for building Chinese vocabulary
• Choose between Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese
• Chinese dictionary integration with Pleco, Skritter, and Hack Chinese
Learn Chinese for free or upgrade to unlock access to:
• 3000+ articles, stories, and courses to explore
• Offline study for learning Mandarin Chinese on-the-go
• Audiobook mode for Chinese listening practice
Download Du Chinese and start reading today!

bluejetty:00158305:ios.description:
Oakville Transit operates small capacity fully accessible transit vehicles providing
specialized transit service currently branded as care-A-van and a commingled on-
demand service branded Ride On-Demand. Standard Oakville Transit fares apply for
both services.
care-A-van (specialized transit) is an application-based door-to-door transportation
service for persons with a disability that prevents them from using fixed route transit. 
This service is provided using fully accessible Oakville Transit small capacity vehicles
and supplemented in partnership with local taxi providers. Standard Oakville Transit
fares apply.
Ride On-Demand is a shared-ride service booked via a mobile app that allows riders to
travel without following a fixed route or schedule. Customers can travel from one
address to another within the designated zone and connect to and from fixed route
service at designated transit hubs in the same zone.
Minimum trip distance of 400 metres is required per booking.
This service is provided using fully accessible Oakville Transit small capacity vehicles.
Standard Oakville Transit fares apply.

Welcome to Bakers Valley! Merge delicious ingredients to help Kate, a talented chef, save her beachside town and its beloved family restaurants from the schemes of evil-minded Rex Hunter. Lucky Granny — an ex-spy and keeper of family secrets — is on your side!
A cosy mystery full of gossip, plot twists and soap-opera drama: explore the town, meet Kate's childhood friends at their harbor hangout, and uncover how to rescue every restaurant and building before the developers get their hands on this jewel of a town.
COOK & MERGE FEATURES:
• MERGE & COOK tasty food — combine ingredients into delicious cakes, pies and burgers, and discover 100s of dishes from around the world through satisfying merge chains! The more you play, the more recipes you'll unlock.
• FOLLOW THE STORY — a mystery with real plot twists: stop Rex Hunter, the villain who's just moved into the mansion on the edge of town!
• MAKEOVER & RENOVATE — restore the beautiful restaurants and every building in Bakers Valley, one satisfying renovation at a time!
• WEEKLY & SEASONAL EVENTS — play with friends and players from around the world in Spy Stories, Dream Hero and many more merging events!
• RELAXING, REWARDING PROGRESSION — win rewards at your own pace, in short sessions or long cosy evenings.

• Online Booking Site

• And more

• Built for young entrepreneurs
• Designed for mobile

PRICING
Free Plan

Download SproutCo and start building your business today.

bluejetty:00068143:ios.summary:
Start with hip-hop, ballet, or K-pop and go from there. Dance Lessons gives you real dance-style tutorials in one app, so you can learn the actual style you want, not a random set of moves.
DANCE VIDEOS, ORGANIZED YOUR WAY
Browse dance vid
bluejetty:00068143:ios.description:
Start with hip-hop, ballet, or K-pop and go from there. Dance Lessons gives you real dance-style tutorials in one app, so you can learn the actual style you want, not a random set of moves.
DANCE VIDEOS, ORGANIZED YOUR WAY
Browse dance videos by style, skill level, or category. A hip-hop routine, a ballet fundamentals series, a K-pop cover: everything is sorted so you find the right lesson fast.
GUIDED COURSES
Follow structured courses that walk you through the moves and technique for a style, one lesson at a time. Repeat a video as many times as you need before moving to the next step.
ASK DANCE PRO COACH
Have a question about a step or a style? Ask Dance Pro Coach by text or voice and get AI-powered guidance right when you need it.
TRENDING DANCES
Check New & Hot for popular and newly added lessons and tutorials, so you always know what other learners are picking up next.
ARTICLES & TIPS
Read articles with dance tips, tutorials, and learning guides to go deeper on technique, styles, and practice habits between lessons.
A GROWING LIBRARY OF STYLES
Hip-hop, ballet, K-pop, salsa, Bollywood, ballroom, tango, waltz, contemporary and more. Pick a style, follow the courses, and build from the basics up.
Lessons, videos and articles are streamed from our servers, so the library can grow without an app update and an internet connection is needed.
FOR EVERY LEVEL
New to dance? Start with beginner lessons that break down the fundamentals. Already have moves? Jump into more advanced routines and keep building your range across styles.
Download Dance Lessons and start learning the style that's calling you.

Master Multiplication & Division the Fun Way!

bluejetty:00015496:ios.description:
Master Multiplication & Division the Fun Way!
Turn math practice into play! Help your child become a multiplication and division champion with our engaging, colorful, and easy-to-use learning app. Perfect for elementary students, this app makes mastering times tables (up to 20!) an exciting adventure.
Why Kids & Parents Love It:
Learn Your Way
Practice tables from 2–20 in sequence (2×1, 2×2…) or mix them up with Random mode for an extra challenge. Master both Multiplication (×) and Division (÷).
Boost Recall Skills
Start with Multiple Choice answers or switch to the kid-friendly Keypad to strengthen memory and confidence.
Flexible Learning Levels
Focus on tables up to 12 (standard), extend to 15, or master all the way to 20. Grows with your child’s skills.
Exciting Test Mode
Add a timer for fast-paced challenges or practice at your own pace without pressure.
Fun Math Games
Reinforce learning through engaging mini-games designed around times tables.
Awesome Rewards
Earn badges and coins for progress and perfect scores—kids love collecting them!
Track Progress
View quiz history and detailed statistics to monitor improvement and identify areas to practice.
Vibrant Themes
Customize the look with Light, Dark, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple, Peach, or System Default themes.
Engaging Sounds
Fun sound effects make learning lively (can be turned on/off anytime).
Parent Controls
Important settings (like resetting progress) are protected with a simple parent verification.

Turn math practice into play! Help your child become a multiplication and division champion with our engaging, colorful, and easy-to-use learning app. Perfect for elementary students, this app makes mastering times tables (up to 20!) an exciting adventure.

Why Kids & Parents Love It:

Learn Your Way
Practice tables from 2–20 in sequence (2×1, 2×2…) or mix them up with Random mode for an extra challenge. Master both Multiplication (×) and Division (÷).

Boost Recall Skills
Start with Multiple Choice answers or switch to the kid-friendly Keypad to strengthen memory and confidence.

Flexible Learning Levels
Focus on tables up to 12 (standard), extend to 15, or master all the way to 20. Grows with your child’s skills.

Exciting Test Mode
Add a timer for fast-paced challenges or practice at your own pace without pressure.

Fun Math Games
Reinforce learning through engaging mini-games designed around times tables.

Awesome Rewards
Earn badges and coins for progress and perfect scores—kids love collecting them!

Track Progress
View quiz history and detailed statistics to monitor improvement and identify areas to practice.

Vibrant Themes
Customize the look with Light, Dark, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple, Peach, or System Default themes.

Engaging Sounds
Fun sound effects make learning lively (can be turned on/off anytime).

Parent Controls
Important settings (like resetting progress) are protected with a simple parent verification.

bluejetty:00099930:ios.description:
Welcome to the ultimate goblin tycoon game!
Goblin Miner: Idle Merger is a fun and addictive idle game where mischievous goblins work, dig, and merge their way to unimaginable gold riches. Build your goblin kingdom, upgrade your labs, and watch your empire grow — even while you’re away!
BUILD YOUR GOBLIN EMPIRE
Start the game in a small enchanted mine, and turn it into a thriving goblin empire! Chop wood, mine resources, and earn piles of gold to unlock new labs, upgrades, and runes.
MERGE & UPGRADE GOBLINS
Combine similar goblins to create faster and more powerful ones! Merge your way through the game to evolve lazy workers into elite gold-digging tycoons.
EXPLORE AND EXPAND
Unlock new territories and dig deeper! Grow your goblin workforce, upgrade labs, and discover hidden secrets that boost your gold income in this exciting idle game.
COLLECT RUNES & BOOST YOUR GAME
Gather powerful game cards that unlock special goblin abilities, increase your mining speed, and help you generate even more gold. Progress faster and dominate the mine!
STRATEGY OR CHAOS — YOU CHOOSE
This game lets you play your way! Plan your merges and upgrades for max efficiency, or let your goblins go wild and reap the gold rewards either way.
SPECIAL EVENTS & CHALLENGES
Take part in themed in-game events packed with exclusive rewards. Compete, collect, and climb the leaderboards in this dynamic goblin-powered game.
Start your journey to become the richest goblin in the forest!
Whether you’re a fan of idle, merge, or tycoon games, Goblin Miner delivers nonstop fun, greedy goblins, and mountains of glorious gold.

bluejetty:00131890:ios.description:
Pixel Pro Winter Sports is an incredibly addictive pixel-art makeover of your favourite wintertime sports.
Carve down the slopes in Downhill skiing, nip over to the Bobsled track for a hair-raising run, or aim for Olympic gold in the Slalom or Ski Jump.
Each sport has its own gameplay mechanics and challenges. All simple, but addicting.
Every discipline has a Single Event mode, for a quick fix of fun. Game Center is integrated, so you can challenge friends and attempt to break the world records.
But the best way to play, is in each sport's Career mode. Compete in 20 events around the globe, each with slightly different challenges. Place in the top 10 to earn prize money, then use it to upgrade your equipment - for longer Ski Jumps or quicker Skiing or Bobsled times. Place high enough at the end of the season, and more events are unlocked. As you play, the World Championships and Olympiads will come around - medals are up for grabs if you can handle the pressure.
FEATURES:
Downhill Skiing
Bobsled (2-seat and 4-seat)
Ski Jump (90m, 120m and Ski Flying)
Slalom Skiing (Slalom and Giant Slalom)
Easy and Pro modes
Quick Play & Career modes
Special event medals (World Championships and Olympiads)
20 unique locations
Unlockable equipment
Stats and records for all disciplines
Game Center leaderboards and achievements

bluejetty:00091723:ios.description:
RideWell℠ provides driving feedback to personal automobile policyholders of The Cincinnati Insurance Companies, helping them become safer and better drivers.
The app automatically detects when driving starts and stops by using the drivers’ smartphone sensors to measure their vehicles’ movements. RideWell runs in the background and uses GPS and low-power sensing methods to reduce battery consumption as it logs all driving trips. Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically reduce battery life. The app shows trip summaries, details on driving habits and gives useful feedback on becoming a better driver.
To use the RideWell app, drivers are insured by The Cincinnati Insurance Companies and gain access when the policyholder enrolls in RideWell through the MyCincinnati app. For additional information, insureds should call their independent agent recommending RideWell.

No aplicativo você encontra a profissional ideal para sua família.

- Estabeleça os seus próprios valores e horários

bluejetty:00182485:ios.name: Warpath: Ace Shooter
bluejetty:00182485:ios.summary:
Experience the new maritime map! Crush the Raven Fleet and fight for Strategic Places at sea!
Your mission: Coordinate your forces and defeat the Ravens at air, land, and sea. Use your powerful modern arsenal to defend your Base and break
bluejetty:00182485:ios.description:
Experience the new maritime map! Crush the Raven Fleet and fight for Strategic Places at sea!
Your mission: Coordinate your forces and defeat the Ravens at air, land, and sea. Use your powerful modern arsenal to defend your Base and break through the Raven blockade. Meet the Ravens head-on, outmaneuver their fleets, and become master of the seas!
▶ FEATURES◀
EXCITING SNIPER ACTION
Control the battlefield, destroy your enemies
● Hone your skills in over a hundred missions, set in diverse battlefields both on the ground and in the air.
● Collect powerful assault rifles, sniper rifles, and more. Modify your guns with new parts to create the world's most potent arsenal.
● Smooth controls, lush graphics and sound design, and slow-mo camera angles will leave your heart racing.
REAL-TIME STRATEGY 
Plan out your attack and in engage in epic Real-time battles on iconic maps.
● Use skill and strategy to battle to the top. 
● Target your enemies and expand your territory with calculated maneuvers. 
● Reign supreme on the battlefield to gain strength and mount more forces against hostile targets. 
DEEPLY CUSTOMIZABLE MILITARY UNITS 
Max out your loadout! 
● Lock and load with the biggest and baddest guns, tanks and aircraft; and establish an army ready to wage war on the global battlefield. 
● Customize your units by assembling, disassembling, modifying and upgrading. 
● Then test your loadout in the thrill of real war as you shoot down your enemies. 
URBAN CONSTRUCTION
● Various construction options and editable buildings! 
● Build your own military base with ultra-high degree of freedom.
● Collect marble memorial, statue and latest festival decorations to show off your unique mansion. 
UNBEATABLE ALLIANCE COMRADERY
● Work with loyal Allies to increase your Power and gain control of Cities and Nations around the World.
● Contend with other Alliances to determine who is stronger. Band together with your comrades to achieve the unachievable and write your name in the annals of history.
STUNNING MOBILE EXPERIENCE
Top quality HD gaming on your phone, with thrilling graphics and sound. 
● Experience the thrill of commanding war, in the palm of your hand. 
● Zoom freely and teleport to different cities around the world with your allies. 
● Each chapter takes a different direction, coupled with a hard-hitting plot and cinematic gameplay. Explore the terrain by plane and use this to your advantage. 
Join global alliances around the world in the fight for glory. Have you got what it takes to crush the enemy and liberate nations around the world? Will your tactics play off? 
Stay up to date with the latest news by joining the Warpath community.
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/PlayWarpath/ 
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/playwarpath 
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/PlayWarpath/ 
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCHX2nNL33q24VrJdGFwjTgw

bluejetty:00128903:ios.description:
Here's the thing:
If you've been uploading content to YouTube or any other social media platform without adding thumbnails, you are losing tons of traffic and views.
Do you know why?
It's because studies have shown that on places like YouTube, Facebook, and Twitter, videos and other social content that does NOT have thumbnails receive far fewer views than those that have thumbnails and vice versa.
There are also reports by search experts that having a video thumbnail on search engines like Google can double your search traffic.
Why so?
Thumbnails are usually the first thing that catches people’s eyes when they make a query on Google, YouTube, or other search engines. The more attractive your thumbnails, the better. The worst case scenario is when you don't have a thumbnail attached to your videos and social media content.
What should you do?
It's simple: start creating and adding thumbnails to your content. Once you do that, not only will your content appear more beautiful, you'll also be attracting more clicks.
And that's why we've created this amazing thumbnail maker app for you.
With Thumbnail Maker, you can create literally any kind of thumbnail and banner, including:
- YouTube thumbnails and banners
- Facebook covers
- YT cover photos
- LinkedIn cover images
- Twitter timeline photos and header images
- Instagram thumbnails and covers
And many more.
There aren't many iOS apps that allow you to create diverse thumbnails and banners for multiple platforms like Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, etc., but this tool does.
Which means you won't have to spend money on multiple apps or switch back and forth between apps when you can get everything in one place — our Thumbnail Maker.
Plus, it is EXTREMELY CONVENIENT to use.
HIGHLIGHTS OF THUMBNAIL MAKER
Ability to create thumbnails and covers for different brands (customized particularly for each brand) 
Availability of a huge variety of free backgrounds in a different category (or simply import your own custom backgrounds)
Ability to select preferred dimensions
Ability to add text and overlay for personalization
Availability of tons of uniquely designed typography fonts, font colors, and special font effects to create thumbnails that stand out
Unbeatable design elements that let you add unique shapes and symbols to your thumbnails
Ability to enhance the visual appeal of your thumbnails with dozens of professionally designed filters
Availability of stickers to buff up your thumbnails for further refinement
User-friendly interface designed to support speed and convenience
Ability to save your finished work in the Photo Library.
HOW TO USE THUMBNAIL MAKER
Download, install and open the app.
Upload an image or select a background from the category of your choice. Or simply select blank canvas.
Choose your preferred dimensions
Add text, overlay, or brand to your thumbnail. 
Save and share your thumbnail.
Note:
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current subscription period. Automatic renewals will cost the same price you were originally charged for the subscription. You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings on the App Store after purchase. Read our terms of service and Privacy Policy for more information.

• A vocal range test that finds your range and voice type

1) Take the range test, or skip it and start singing

bluejetty:00128455:ios.name: Lazy Jump 3D
bluejetty:00128455:ios.summary:
► FLAIL UPWARDS
Slide, stumble, flip and flail your way through endless levels in this hyper-casual, hyper-entertaining physics-based puzzle game. When your character has all the strength and coordination of a wet rag, you’ll need really q
bluejetty:00128455:ios.description:
► FLAIL UPWARDS
Slide, stumble, flip and flail your way through endless levels in this hyper-casual, hyper-entertaining physics-based puzzle game. When your character has all the strength and coordination of a wet rag, you’ll need really quick thinking and a firm grasp of the laws of physics to get them to complete even the simplest of tasks. Add to that a smattering of fiendish obstacles and unexpected mechanics, and it’ll take all of your wits to keep your cute ragdoll character from constantly falling flat on their fanny and get them to reach the level goal – whether that’s scoring a real goal with a soccer ball or something as simple as answering the telephone.
► THE PHYSICS OF INERTIA
• Once you flop, you can’t stop: Over 700 levels of crazy ragdoll action, with over 20 different obstacle types, tens of different task types, and dozens of different locations, meaning you’ll bever get bored of just lolling around in this action-packed but strangely relaxing arcade game.
• Trust the science: The graphics in Lazy Jump may be crazily cute, but each level’s puzzles and mechanics conform firmly to the real laws of physics. Engage your logical thinking, your scientific understanding and your visual perception skills to guide your floppy ragdoll through each fiendish obstacle course and reach the level goal before their maladroit floppiness drives you out of your mind.
• Lazy but inventive: Lazy Jump is a game that features a huge range of different puzzle types, so you’ll have to get your loose-limbed heroes to do any number of different tasks, from basic household chores to amazing feats of floppy athleticism. Flip, flop, slide and drop your family of ragdolls around the screen in this ingenious and addictive game.
• Useless but cute: The family of ragdoll characters in Lazy Jump may be endlessly and infuriatingly ungainly, but they’re also super cute thanks to the game’s vibrant and engaging graphics. There’s also bouncy, joyful music and satisfying sound effects that ensure the game is always a fun, cozy and relaxing place to spend time.
► MADDENINGLY GOOD FUN
Bounce off the ceiling, slide down the walls, and flop on your fanny time after time, then drag yourself up, dust yourself off and stumble all over again in this endlessly endearing and entertaining game where the only rule is to never give up. If you’re looking for a mobile game that combines serious logic puzzles with adorable graphics, crazily inventive challenges and an atmosphere of outlandish fun, then Lazy Jump should be right up your alley. Download it now and get flailing and flopping to win.
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00071660:ios.description:
Welcome to our exciting game! Sharpen your shooting and matching skills with this addictive and action-packed arcade game. Experience the thrill of dunking balls into the right baskets while strategically popping matching colored balls for maximum points. Come along now and join the fun!
Once you play, you will come for Dunk and Pop every day!
How to play:
• Swipe left and right to control the ball's shooting direction with precision and finesse.
• Test your accuracy by aiming for the right basket and perform jaw-dropping dunks that will leave you in awe.
• Keep an eye out for clusters of same-colored balls and skillfully match and pop them to trigger explosive chain reactions.
• Challenge yourself to achieve the highest score possible by popping as many balls as you can within the time limit.
Features:
• Simple and intuitive controls that make it easy for players of all ages to pick up and enjoy.
• Stunning visuals and vibrant colors create an immersive and visually pleasing gameplay experience.
• Engaging sound effects and upbeat music enhance the excitement as you progress through the game.
• Unlock a variety of balls and baskets to customize your gameplay and show off your unique style.
• Compete with friends and players from around the world on the leaderboards to claim the top spot.
• Regular updates with new levels, challenges, and rewards to keep you coming back for more.
Get ready for an addictive and thrilling gaming experience that will keep you entertained for hours. Download now and put your shooting and matching skills to the ultimate test!

bluejetty:00062166:ios.description:
An essential tool to help clinicians and students navigate their options to manage and rehabilitate swallowing disorders. See for yourself why SLPs around the world are raving about Dysphagia Therapy!
This handy pocket reference will help you select the right treatments to address the impairments you’ve diagnosed in your dysphagia patients. You’ll have easy access to information about anatomy, cranial nerves, treatment procedures, and patient handouts, making it easier to know what you’re treating and how. 
Novice and experienced clinicians alike will benefit from knowing they’ve thought of all the options. You’ll love having all this information at your fingertips!
Key Features:
** Personalized options for therapy based on assessment results

bluejetty:00094153:ios.description:
Ace Your ServSafe Without Turning the Kitchen into a Crime Scene
So, you’ve decided to be the hero the kitchen never knew it needed. Whether you’re managing a restaurant, slinging drinks, or making sure that raw chicken isn’t cuddling the salad, congrats. You now need to pass the ServSafe exam.
That’s right. It’s time to memorize food temps, rehearse HACCP like it’s Shakespeare, and learn which handwashing sins are punishable by death (or worse, failing).
But don’t worry. We built an app that won’t rot your brain like improperly stored mayo. EZ Prep’s ServSafe Study App is the fastest, smartest, and least nauseating way to study for Food Handler, Food Manager, and Alcohol* Certification safety exams. No flashcards. No boredom. Just what you need.
Whether you're wiping down a counter, dodging a grease fire, or crying in the walk-in fridge, you can study on the go with straightforward questions, snark-free explanations, and an app that works even when the Wi-Fi is as broken as the ice machine.
Written by actual food safety pros (not bots or your cousin who once worked at Chili’s), everything is aligned to the latest ServSafe standards so you’re studying what matters. Not just memorizing what E. coli might do in its spare time.
Here’s What You Get (Besides a Newfound Fear of Poultry)
Food Handler Certification
Temps, time, and why that crusty sponge is probably a biohazard
Manager Exam Prep
Everything from hazard analysis to staff training, minus the HR nightmares
Alcohol Safety
Learn how to spot fake IDs, cut off belligerent guests, and avoid lawsuits without becoming a buzzkill
App Features That Won’t Give You a Hygiene Violation
• Adaptive Difficulty
Questions adjust as you go. Doing well? We turn up the heat. Struggling? We’ll keep it at a gentle simmer.
• Full-Length Practice Exams
Like the real thing, but without the pressure of someone glaring at you in a conference room
• Study Goals & Progress Tracking
Because nothing says "achievement" like a perfect score on handwashing protocols
• Instant Feedback
Know immediately if you’re ServSafe certified or just serving up safety violations
Try it free. No shady upsells. No recurring charges. No pop-ups asking if you “enjoy handling raw meat responsibly.” Just an app built to help you pass, not burn out.
Unlike those ancient ServSafe PDFs or sketchy prep sites with flashing banner ads from 2008, EZ Prep is clean, modern, and built for humans who have kitchens to run and no time for fluff.
Download now and become the food safety legend your establishment desperately needs.
Terms of Use: https://www.eztestprep.com/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://www.eztestprep.com/privacy-policy
Support: support@eztestprep.com
ServSafe® is a registered trademark of the National Restaurant Association and administered exclusively by the NRA. This material is not endorsed or approved by the NRA or ServSafe®.
But we do respect their noble mission of keeping the nation’s nachos pathogen-free.

bluejetty:00144055:ios.summary:
Prove your English level with a globally recognised English test and certificate for employment
Looking to learn English and prove your English level to an employer?
- Test your English skills and get your results instantly at no cost.
-
bluejetty:00144055:ios.description:
Prove your English level with a globally recognised English test and certificate for employment
Looking to learn English and prove your English level to an employer?
- Test your English skills and get your results instantly at no cost.
- Test your knowledge of English grammar and vocabulary, as well as your reading and listening skills. 
- An English Speaking test is also available to assess your pronunciation, fluency and communication skills.
- The EnglishScore Writing Test simulates real-life scenarios in a digital workplace to assess various skills, including grammar, vocabulary, text organisation and communication
- Prepare for other English exams such as IELTS, TOEFL and TOEIC
- Buy a British Council Professional Certificate to prove your English level to an employer for as low as US$20
- Get course recommendations to help you learn English
Why EnglishScore?
- EnglishScore is recognised. Our certificate is accepted by thousands of employers and universities around the world, see some of them here: https://www.englishscore.com/english-test/who-uses-englishscore/ 
- EnglishScore is easy to access. Take the test on your mobile device from anywhere, at any time.
- EnglishScore is trusted. Every year, over two million people take international English exams and qualifications with the British Council.
- EnglishScore is quick and accurate. Know your English level in as little as 30 minutes with a test designed by British Council.
- EnglishScore is free to practise. Join 4.8 million English learners and take multiple practice tests for free.
About the English test and certificate
The EnglishScore test is delivered on a mobile phone, so it requires different security measures and rules. 
We use security features such as face monitoring technology through your smartphone’s selfie camera. You must be alone in a quiet place with your whole face clearly in the camera during the test.
These rules help give you and organisations confidence that your results are accurate and reliable.
To take the test and purchase a certificate, you will need to turn on your test security.
Once the test is complete, EnglishScore awards you with an internationally recognised CEFR level from A2 to C1 and a more detailed score between 0 and 599 aligned to the CEFR framework. This is a recognised global standard for describing language levels. You can use your CEFR score to compare results with tests such as IELTS, TOEIC and TOEFL.
The British Council EnglishScore Professional Certificate is recognised by leading employers and education institutions around the world.
You can use a Professional Certificate to help advance your career, including applying for a job or to enhance your CV.
EnglishScore is also available for businesses, universities and colleges that are looking to conduct English tests at scale. Learn more here:https://www.englishscore.com/for-business/ 
Send any feedback to contact@englishscore.com
Privacy Policy: https://www.englishscore.com/privacy-policy/ 
Terms of Service: https://www.englishscore.com/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00178755:ios.description:
It’s a sensation: A real t-rex has just hatched from an egg – in YOUR dino zoo game! Create a fantastic animal world teeming with prehistoric creatures and wow your visitors. In this dino game, you’re the proud owner of a dino zoo with numerous attractions. 
These are some of the challenges you’ll face in this dino simulation:
• Provide and decorate enclosures for your dinosaurs
• Breed brontisauri, t-rexes, and other prehistoric animals
• Supply your dinosaurs with food, water, and play equipment
• Equip your dino zoo with snack shacks and souvenir shops for your guests
• Create a breathtaking dinosaur park experience
Dinosaur Park – Primeval Zoo is one of the most entertaining dinosaur games in the world of apps. The cute prehistoric animals make this tycoon simulation a thrilling hit all dinosaur lovers! If you grew up with the hit movie Jurassic Park and its sequels, this dino game will let you see the prehistoric world with new eyes.

bluejetty:00169945:ios.summary:
Scriptable is an automation tool that enables you to write scripts that integrates with native features of iOS such as files, calendars, reminders, documents and much more.
An extensive support for widgets enables you to write your own wid
bluejetty:00169945:ios.description:
Scriptable is an automation tool that enables you to write scripts that integrates with native features of iOS such as files, calendars, reminders, documents and much more.
An extensive support for widgets enables you to write your own widgets using JavaScript and run the scripts on your Home Screen. Your widgets can show any data and be customised to look just the way you want. 
With Siri Shortcuts you can present images, tables and more in Siri as well as making Siri read out loud a text when you run a script from a Siri Shortcut.
There's a growing gallery of scripts to get you started with Scriptable.
Here’s a few examples of scripts you can create:
- Ask Siri whether a web service is down.
- Create a widget that shows data from your weather station.
- Postpone the next event in your calendar half an hour.
- Check what is currently on TV.
- Manage a list of movies you would like to watch.
- Upload files to an image optimizer and store a URL to the optimized image.
- Receive a notification with the weather report every morning.
- Create todos with prefilled data in your favorite todo app using URL schemes.
Features include:
- Write and run JavaScript.
- Auto complete of variable names, functions, keywords and properties as you type.
- Access lots of native iOS features from your JavaScript code, including managing files, calendars, reminders, contacts, photos, location, pasteboard, web views and more.
- Create your own widgets. Your scripts run on the Home Screen without needing to open the app.
- Siri Shortcuts enabling you to present images, tables, websites, HTML and more in Siri as well as making Siri read out loud a text.
- Support for input and output parameters in Siri Shortcuts.
- Easily schedule rich notifications to run your scripts periodically.
- Work with files and directories from third party apps using File Bookmarks.
- Synchronise scripts to all of your devices using iCloud Drive.
- Scripts are stored as plain JavaScript files and can be browsed using the Files app.
- Assign one of over 800 glyphs and a color to a script to easily identify it in your directory of scripts.
- Run scripts directly on your Lock Screen and Home Screen using widgets.
- Run a script by 3D touching the app icon.
- Run a script from a share sheet and process the inputs.
- Schedule notifications and run a script directly from a notification.
- URL schemes enabling you to run scripts from other apps.
- Support for x-callback-url enabling advanced integration with other apps that support x-callback-url.
- Export and share scripts.
- Example scripts helping you get started creating your own scripts.
- Extensive documentation for all the native APIs you can use in your scripts. Available offline in the app and online on docs.scriptable.app.
- View the documentation in a separate window on iPad.
- Support for dark mode.
- Customise the editor to your liking.

bluejetty:00034360:ios.description:
A new challenge for puzzle lovers – from the creator of the numerical board game hit Five-O!
If you've played Five-O, you'll find the rules to be simple and familiar. Just arrange the tiles onto the blank spaces in the puzzle so that every sequence adds up to a multiple of five (5, 10, 15, etc.). The puzzles start out with a set of dark tiles that are locked in place. It’s like a crossword puzzle of numbers!
There are 100 hand-crafted puzzles ranging from easy to extremely challenging. But don't worry! If you get stuck, you can tap the lightbulb button to earn a hint.
You can even create brand new puzzles to play yourself! You choose the size of the puzzle and how many starting tiles to reveal. You'll never run out of new puzzles to play!
And if you haven't played Five-O, the board game, be sure to check that one out as well!

bluejetty:00174355:ios.name: OnTheSnow Ski & Snow Report
bluejetty:00174355:ios.summary: OnTheSnow.com, the worldwide leader for snow reports and ski conditions, brings you the world's most downloaded skiing and snowboarding application, the Ski & Snow Report app. Ask SkiGPT for real-time snow intel and trip-planning help, comp
bluejetty:00174355:ios.description:
OnTheSnow.com, the worldwide leader for snow reports and ski conditions, brings you the world's most downloaded skiing and snowboarding application, the Ski & Snow Report app. Ask SkiGPT for real-time snow intel and trip-planning help, compare snow reports for your favorite ski resorts, view and upload firsthand reports and photos, and check out the webcams and weather forecast for ski resorts you're planning to visit. Set a powder alert to a custom tolerance to receive a notification when your favorite resorts get that amount of new snow.
Features Include:
-- NEW — SkiGPT, your always-on ski buddy: real-time snow intel, resort insights, and trip-planning help, powered by OnTheSnow. Ask it anything, right inside the app.
-- Snow Near Me: The My Resorts screen stores, tracks and compares all your favorite ski resorts so you can find out where it is snowing right now, what the conditions are like at your local mountain and get a glimpse of recent snowfall there. Sort your list alphabetically, by distance from you, or by the biggest new snowfall.
-- Access to snow reports from more than 2,000 ski areas, including Park City, Telluride, Jackson Hole, Palisades Tahoe, Keystone, Steamboat, Aspen, Breckenridge, Killington, Stowe, Deer Valley, Vail, Winter Park, Big Sky, Arapahoe Basin, Whistler Blackcomb, Mammoth, Mt. Bachelor, Lake Louise, and many more.
-- Weather forecast and conditions at each ski resort, now with hour-by-hour forecasts, base and summit elevations, and mid-mountain conditions shown by default. View by mountain, by state (i.e. Colorado), by region (i.e. Northeast), or by pass, including Ikon Pass, Epic Pass, Indy Pass, and The Mountain Collective.
-- Live webcams and Firsthand ski reports and photos from fellow skiers who are on the slopes right now. Posting from the lift with a weak signal? Your report and photos are saved and uploaded automatically as soon as the connection improves.
-- Regional weather forecasts delivered to the app Inbox weekly with updates on which mountains will get the best snow for the weekend.
-- Powder alerts when your favorite resorts receive new snow.
-- Mountain overview with stats, snow history graph, and interactive trail maps.

bluejetty:00145806:ios.description:
برنامج سهل الاستخدام مجاني بالكامل يوفر مجموعة كبيرة من الادوات من خلالها تستظيع تعديل الصور باضافه فلاتر وتحسينات كبيرة وواضحة على الصور ومن ثم استخدام التجميعات والدمج الكولاج لتجميع صور متعددة في صورة واحدة ضمن اطارات وبعد تجهيز الصور حسب الطلب يتم 
ادخالها لصانع الفيديو الاحترافي الذي يعمل على انتاج فيديو من خلال مجموعه الصور المدخله واضافه اصوات جاهزة بيانو وموسيقى او من خلال مسجل الصوت او من خلال مكتبه الهاتف لتركب المقطع الصوتي المفضل لديك على مقطع الفيديو لتحتفظ باجمل اللحظات واروعها في فيديو واحد جميل ومييز وتستطيع مشاركته مع الاصدقاء على شبكات التواصل الاجتماعي مثل انستقرام وفيس بوك ويوتيوب وغيرها من مواقع التواصل
يتميز برنامج صانع الفيديو المحترف بمجموعة من المميزات منها :
- عدد لا نهائي من الصور يمكن دمجه داخل الفيديو 
- تركيب صوت واغاني من خلال التسجيل او من خلال مكتبه الجوال
- تحرير الصور واضافه فلاتر ومؤثرات متعددة
- كولاج الصور وتجميعها في اطاررات متنوعه 
- تطبيق سهل الاستخدام 
- متعدد الخدمات والفوائد
- عبارة عن دمج مجموعة تطبيقات متعددة في تطبيق واحد 
- كتابة على الصور 
- اضافه رموز للصور لتضيف نوعا من الجمال 
- دوران الصور مع فلاتر 
- مجموعة اخري كبيرة ومتنوعة اتمنى ان تكتشفها بنفسك

bluejetty:00173589:ios.description:
Draw To Pee—Toilet Finder is a puzzle game offering an entertaining experience in which you must find the toilet by drawing a line. The Draw to Toilet game will test your various intellectual and logical skills as you’ll be challenged with mazey puzzles and draw to save challenges. The gameplay mechanics are simple to follow yet interesting and addictive as you will use your puzzle-solving, drawing, and time-management skills all at once. So, draw fast, avoid obstacles, and use your drawing skills creatively to win the toilet race.
The toilet rush character is in a hurry to answer nature’s call, but another person is in the same way, and you have to help the rush character to draw to the toilet while avoiding crossing paths. There could be many other obstacles blocking your way as you level up in the potty game; these obstacles can be a tricky maze, or the path may be blocked; choose the right way wisely to take the poop rush character to draw to the home toilet at any cost.
Draw a line as you like to connect the character to the toilet to save quickly before your opponent crosses your path and fails your mission. The game’s difficulty increases as you advance to higher levels, and you face intense challenges that are hard to pass. Get it now to start the toilet rush race filled with the draw to save puzzles and time management challenges.

listings.name: Draw to Toilet - Rescue Out
listings.description:
Draw To Pee—Toilet Finder is a puzzle game offering an entertaining experience in which you must find the toilet by drawing a line. The Draw to Toilet game will test your various intellectual and logical skills as you’ll be challenged with mazey puzzles and draw to save challenges. The gameplay mechanics are simple to follow yet interesting and addictive as you will use your puzzle-solving, drawing, and time-management skills all at once. So, draw fast, avoid obstacles, and use your drawing skills creatively to win the toilet race.

The toilet rush character is in a hurry to answer nature’s call, but another person is in the same way, and you have to help the rush character to draw to the toilet while avoiding crossing paths. There could be many other obstacles blocking your way as you level up in the potty game; these obstacles can be a tricky maze, or the path may be blocked; choose the right way wisely to take the poop rush character to draw to the home toilet at any cost.

Draw a line as you like to connect the character to the toilet to save quickly before your opponent crosses your path and fails your mission. The game’s difficulty increases as you advance to higher levels, and you face intense challenges that are hard to pass. Get it now to start the toilet rush race filled with the draw to save puzzles and time management challenges.

Are you ready to explore the world with Turkish Airlines privileges? Our mobile app, which helps you have the best travel experience, remembers your preferences and flights, helping you speed up your journey. Use our multilingual app to take advantage of life-enhancing features like reservations, ticketing, check-in, seat selection, extra baggage allowance, Stopover, Touristanbul, and TKPAY Wallet.
USER-FRIENDLY DESIGN
• Whether it's a vacation or a business trip, travel planning is now more enjoyable! Turkish Airlines mobile app remembers your preferences and flights, and offers personalized recommendations.
• We've introduced a brand new design focused on the ideal user experience. Easily manage your travel plans, tickets, and Miles.
• Quickly purchase tickets, manage your reservations, and view your saved flights with ease.
WIDEN YOUR WORLD
• Get ready to explore the world with Turkish Airlines, the airline that carries passengers to more countries than any other airline in the world. Fly at advantageous prices by browsing special offers.
• Discover flight deals, travel tips, and special offers in the story area! Plan your trip with inspiring content and enjoy privileges.
• Explore city guides for suggestions that will add color to your trip. Prepare for a delightful trip by browsing city attractions, culinary delights, airport transportation information, and more.
TICKET MANAGEMENT
• Save your flight and make your reservation later. Pay anytime, from any device.
• Add a new flight, change or cancel your flight, and add an infant passenger from the My Reservations section.
FAST AND SECURE PAYMENT
• Easily pay by choosing the most convenient payment methods and currencies available on the Turkish Airlines mobile app.
• Earn discounts, Miles, cashback, and TK Money when you spend with TKPAY Wallet.
• Convert your Miles to Turkish Lira with TKPAY Wallet and spend anywhere.
• Purchase tickets faster by saving your credit cards or scanning your credit card with the camera at checkout.
• Always feel secure by storing your credit card and profile information.
MILES&SMILES PRIVILEGES
• Log in to your account with your fingerprint using the personalized Miles&Smiles experience specifically for the Turkish Airlines mobile app.
• Use your earned Miles to issue award tickets or shop at Shop&Miles.
• Easily perform transactions like purchasing and transferring Miles from our app.

bluejetty:00177086:ios.description:
Studiio é o aplicativo que substitui os sistemas de gestão tradicionais, oferecendo mais praticidade para organizar sua agenda, controlar presença e falta, acompanhar as reposições, documentar a evolução do aluno e controlar seus planos, pacote de sessões e mensalidades.
Ainda ofereça acesso para que o aluno cancele a aula e agende sozinho as reposições ou aulas disponíveis.
Mais organização do seu estúdio de Pilates, Yoga, Funcional, Pole Dance, profissionais de fisioterapia, escola de dança, centro de treinamento, aulas de beach tennis, futevôlei e outros esportes.
É descomplicado de verdade! Não precisa entender nada de tecnologia, o aplicativo é interativo e prático. É só deixar ele trabalhar para você.
Studiio é indicado para quem trabalha com horários agendados.
Quais as vantagens de usar o Studiio?
• Agenda digital e inteligente
• Acesso do Aluno para que eles confirmem, desmarquem e agendem suas aulas
• Controle de frequência e reposições
• Gerenciamento rápido dos alunos e planos
• Evolução individual para acompanhamento dos pacientes e alunos
• Resumo da aula com as principais informações dos alunos em uma só tela
• Controle do pacote de aula ou sessão
• Mensagens prontas de lembrete sobre final de plano
• Relatórios de planos finalizados e renovações
• Financeiro descomplicado
• Acesso para instrutores ilimitado
• Quantidade de alunos ilimitados*
• Importação dos contatos do seu celular para agilizar o cadastro
Baixe agora gratuitamente!
QUER SABER MAIS?
• ACESSO DO ALUNO
A liberdade que você quer para seu aluno.
O aluno confirma presença, cancelar ou remarcar a aula sozinho. Tudo de acordo com as regras e prazos que estabelecer e você é notificado sempre que houver alguma mudança. O Acesso do Aluno é muito simples e intuitivo de utilizar: todos seus alunos vão conseguir mexer!
• NÃO SE PERCA MAIS NAS FICHAS DOS ALUNOS
Documente o histórico do atendimento na evolução do aluno e tenha tudo no celular. 
• FINANCEIRO DESCOMPLICADO
Acompanhe vencimentos e recebimentos em um só lugar e ganhe praticidade e rapidez!
• MAIS EFICIÊNCIA COM A AGENDA INTUITIVA
Agendamentos automatizados com visualização de horários vagos.
• INFORMAÇÕES DOS ALUNOS DA PRÓXIMA AULA EM UM TOQUE
Ganhe agilidade no atendimento, com acesso a todas as informações do aluno no Resumo da Aula.
• MAIS AUTONOMIA PARA SEUS INSTRUTORES
Conceda acesso ilimitado aos instrutores, sob seu controle.
• O SEU NEGÓCIO SEM LIMITES
Quantos alunos, agendamentos, reposições, planos quiser, tudo sem limites!
Como usar o aplicativo no dia a dia do seu estúdio?
• Inclua as informações sobre o negócio. Fique tranquilo, você faz sozinho. Em 5 minutos já está tudo configurado para começar a usar.
• Inclua todos seus alunos no app, para agilizar você pode incluí-los importando os contatos do seu celular. Depois é só identificar o plano dele e fazer os agendamentos. Não tem erro, é só seguir o passo a passo.
• Na hora da aula você pode: ver o resumo da aula com as informações dos alunos presentes; dar presença, falta ou gerar reposição; e adicionar a evolução do aluno. Assim tudo ficará digital e sempre com você.
• Compartilhe o acesso do aluno, para ele mesmo desmarcar a aula e já agendar no dia e horário disponível que ele preferir.
• Acompanhe os planos vencidos e mande mensagens prontas de lembrete sobre final de plano.
*Nos planos pagos, sua assinatura Studiio é iniciada somente após confirmação da compra e estará vinculada ao seu ID Apple. Mais detalhes ou cancelamento da renovação automática, basta acessar: Ajustes > ID Apple > Assinaturas e pronto! Não há contrato de longo prazo ou multas por cancelamento, nosso objetivo é facilitar a sua vida.

bluejetty:00077637:ios.description:
Ever watched a plane soar across the blue sky and thought, 'Hey, I could catch that… in my car!'? Well, your oddly specific and gravity-defying dreams are about to come true in 'Plane Chase'!
Embark on a wacky journey of vehicular resilience! You're not just trying to catch flights at the terminal; you're racing to literally leap into the plane! Each level has you speeding behind a plane, strategically dodging absurd obstacles and making wild jumps with only one goal: to land in that plane with style. Initially, you might feel like a toddler chasing pigeons—hopeless. But with each attempt, collect coins to soup up your ride. Boost your engine, fuel up, and inflate those moneybags because the chase keeps getting crazier!
Think it's a straight road to the win? Think again! Levels throw curveballs with multiple paths. Will you risk the rickety rooftop route or the highway of havoc? Make split-second choices that either bump you up or grind your gears down!
Customizations? Oh, we got them! Make your getaway car your best ally. But remember, no amount of spoilers or shiny rims will help you if you run out of fuel. Strategy is your co-pilot on this flight!
Fasten your seatbelts, rev the engine, and remember: it's not car theft if you're aiming for the plane! Are you ready for takeoff in the wackiest chase ever? Download 'Plane Chase' and steer your way through this high-flying, tire-screeching adventure. The skies are literally not the limit!

bluejetty:00143911:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00143911:ios.description:
Join, earn and pay.
The Nodle app is your all-in-one crypto wallet, rewards hub and web3 messenger. Turn your smartphone into a node of the global Nodle Network, earn NODL by completing real-world missions, then swap, send and pay anywhere without expensive hardware or giving up your data.
Whether you are new to crypto or already deep in web3, Nodle gives you a clean, private way to grow a digital wallet and use it like real money.
No mining rigs. No email needed. No personal info required. Just a free crypto wallet that pays you back for being part of something bigger.
—— JOIN ——
• Anonymous wallet in seconds: no email needed
• Activate the Nodle Network mission and your phone becomes a node of a worldwide Bluetooth network
• Bring in what you already own. Mesh imports assets from Binance, Coinbase and MetaMask into your Nodle wallet
• Discover new missions as they go live across the Nodle ecosystem
—— EARN ——
• Earn NODL tokens daily, hands-free, by running the app in the background
• Take on passive and active smart missions using your phone's sensors
• Mint and collect commemorative NFTs from events and drops
• Track every reward, mission and transaction inside the app
• Optimized for minimal battery use; typically 1–3% per 24h via Bluetooth Low Energy
• Restrict data transmission to Wi-Fi only if you prefer
—— PAY ——
• Swap tokens in a few taps, with built-in Bridge across Ethereum, Base, Polygon, zkSync, Optimism and Arbitrum
• Send Envelopes: crypto, NFTs or gifts to anyone, even friends who don't have Nodle yet
• Chat 1:1 or in groups with end-to-end encrypted messaging powered by XMTP, and send value inside the conversation
• Book your Nodle debit card (coming soon) and spend your crypto anywhere cards are accepted
• Send and receive NODL and supported tokens to strengthen the network
—— YOUR PRIVATE, ON-DEVICE AI ASSISTANT ——
• Ask Nodle AI simple questions about your day, right inside the app
• Turn on the optional Apple Health connection to ask about steps, heart rate, sleep and workouts
• Everything runs on your device: your health data is read locally, summarized locally and never sent to Nodle or any third party
• Read-only access, only to what you approve, and off by default. Switch it on or off anytime in Nodle AI Settings > Connectors
• Not a medical service: no diagnosis and no treatment advice, just clear answers about your own activity
—— PRIVACY FIRST ——
No email required. No personal info needed. Your wallet is fully anonymous. Location data is only used to compute your contribution and locate devices at the request of their owners — never sold, never shared.
Any optional data source, such as Apple Health, works the same way: read locally, used locally and never uploaded. Each mission and connector tells you exactly what it collects; the choice is always yours.
—— LIGHT ON YOUR PHONE ——
Engineered for low CPU and battery use. Bluetooth Low Energy keeps the impact tiny, and you can restrict data transmission to Wi-Fi only.
—— WHY NODLE? ——
Earn crypto passively — no hardware, no mining rigs
• All-in-one wallet — swap, bridge, send, message and pay
• Built on a decentralized web3 network with thousands of contributors worldwide
• Designed for beginners and crypto pros alike
• Battery-friendly using Bluetooth Low Energy
• Anonymous and privacy-first
• On-device AI assistant, so even your health and fitness data stays on your phone
—— LEARN ABOUT CRYPTO ——
New to crypto, blockchain or web3? Inside the app you'll find guides that make it easy to understand how the Nodle Network works, how to earn NODL and how to use your crypto wallet safely.
—— A GROWING WEB3 ECOSYSTEM ——
Built on a decentralized network with thousands of contributors worldwide, Nodle is reinventing how people earn and use crypto — from Bluetooth missions to messaging, payments and a real-world card.
—— REACH US ——
Discord, Telegram, X (Twitter), YouTube our team is happy to help.
Download Nodle today - join, earn and pay.

bluejetty:00070130:ios.name: Fotospot Road Trip Community
bluejetty:00070130:ios.summary:
Fotospot is your ultimate road trip companion! 
Discover over 14,000 handpicked, photo-worthy tourist attractions across all 50 U.S. states (plus D.C.). From stunning waterfalls and giant roadside donuts (and one bagel!) to quirky museums,
bluejetty:00070130:ios.description:
Fotospot is your ultimate road trip companion! 
Discover over 14,000 handpicked, photo-worthy tourist attractions across all 50 U.S. states (plus D.C.). From stunning waterfalls and giant roadside donuts (and one bagel!) to quirky museums, iconic film locations, world-class street art, scenic, and historic sites, plus countless other spots featuring the wild, the wonderful, and the just plain weird. 
Bookable Experiences 
In addition to 14,000+ unique spots, we now feature over 1,800 human-curated, bookable experiences right in the app. Imagine yourself learning to surf in Venice Beach, touring iconic "The Walking Dead" locations in Atlanta, white-water rafting on the Rio Grande, exploring the covered bridges of Madison County, crafting a broom in Salem, Mass, enjoying a VIP-guided drive along Maui's Road to Hana, spotting wild horses in North Carolina, or tasting the best cheesesteaks in Philadelphia. And yes, there are ghost tours. So many ghost tours!
Where I've Been 
Easily keep track of your travels with personalized stats. See which states you've visited, view your overall progress, and monitor how you rank in each state. Compete with friends on the leaderboard and get inspired to explore even more. Road Trip Trivia Take your trip to the next level with 
Road Trip Trivia! 
With 800+ multiple choice questions, every mile becomes a chance to test your knowledge, spark conversations, and enjoy those unexpected "a-ha!" moments. 
National Parks
Just like you, we LOVE our National Parks. That’s why we’ve done the research and added every must-see spot to the app—from scenic viewpoints and unique hikes to hidden gems you might otherwise miss. It’s all in your pocket. Our curated National Park list includes:
Arches (73 spots)
Badlands (56 spots)
Bryce Canyon (42 spots)
Death Valley (75 spots)
Glacier (52 spots)
Grand Canyon (62 spots)
Grand Teton (51 spots)
Great Smoky Mountains (87 spots)
Joshua Tree (110)
Olympic (47 spots)
Rocky Mountain (56 spots)
Sequoia & Kings Canyon (70 spots)
Yellowstone (102 spots)
Yosemite (71 spots)
Zion (55 spots)
But Wait, There's More! 
Suggest new spots, add photos and comments, check in to places you visit, save attractions for later, follow your friends' adventures, and earn FREE stuff—all in one app. 
Leave No Trace 
Whether you're visiting a spot in our app or not, please explore responsibly. Take only photos, leave only footprints. Learn more at LNT.org. 
Happy exploring, 
The Fotospot Team

#fotospotting

Over 7 million games played. Thousands of maps. Endless strategic fun.
Join the battle in UniWar, the ultimate multiplayer turn-based strategy game with a passionate online community. Command your army, master the terrain, and outwit real players around the world or challenge the AI in a rich offline campaign.
What the critics say:
 • “Impossible to pass up… a must for strategy fans.” - TouchArcade
 • “10/10 - I’m truly in awe.” - AppCraver
 • “The best strategy game on iPhone.” - PixelatedGeek
Why you’ll love UniWar:
 • 3 unique races, each with 10 different unit types
 • Over 10,000 user-created maps
 • Multiplayer matches: 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, 4v4, 2v2v2
 • Campaign with 30 offline missions plus hundreds of user-created missions
 • Play multiple games at once asynchronously
 • Email and push notifications when it’s your turn
 • In-game chat and global chatroom
 • Fog of war and terrain effects
 • Choose game pace: from 3-minute turns to 3-day matches
Play solo, with friends locally, or compete globally in ranked matches. UniWar offers the tactical depth of chess, the faction-based combat, and the accessibility of mobile gaming.
Free to play with optional subscriptions available:
 • 1-month
 • 3-month
 • 1-year
Subscription details:
 • Your iTunes account will be charged upon purchase and at renewal.
 • Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends.
 • Unused free trial time is forfeited if you purchase a subscription during the trial.

Terms of Use: https://www.spookyhousestudios.com/legal/sh_limited_subscriptions_terms_of_use.html
Download UniWar today and join a global strategy community!

The
bluejetty:00156351:ios.description:
The Bay Alarm™ App allows you to control your security system on-the-go. You can connect to your home or small business system to arm or disarm, manage user codes, view sensor activity, and receive push notifications of system events. 
The App requires a compatible control panel & applicable service. Many people save money by upgrading to cellular alarm communications and eliminating their home or office phone line. For more information about upgrading your alarm system contact Bay Alarm Company today.
The Bay Alarm App offers the following features: 
- System Arming/Disarming 
- All/ Perimeter or Multi-Area Operation 
- Real-time weather for your local zip code 
- Sensor activity zone setting 
- User code management includes the ability to add, delete or edit users from your system on XR150, XR550 (software v 1.05) and XT systems (v 1.17) 
- Receive push notifications and view history of alarm events, arming/disarming, and troubles by other users on your system
- Allows editing & management of user profiles for the XR150 & XR550
All features may not come standard with your App. Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00032792:ios.description:
Start your football career and experience the journey from promising player to global superstar.
In Club Legend, you create your own player and take control of an entire football career. Choose your path, earn your place in the team, score important goals and build your reputation season after season.
Will you stay loyal and become a football legend at one club, or chase bigger opportunities around the world?
BUILD YOUR PLAYER CAREER
Create your player, choose your nationality and select a playstyle that determines your strengths and weaknesses. Improve your attributes through training and develop from a young prospect into a world-class football player.
Every season is another step in your career mode journey.
PLAY THE MATCHES
Your performances matter. Take part in matches, create chances, score goals and help your club compete for trophies.
Become the decisive goal scorer your team can rely on, improve your performances and earn a bigger role in the squad.
EARN YOUR NEXT TRANSFER
Your football career can take you across clubs, leagues and countries.
Perform well to attract interest, receive transfer offers and decide where your career goes next. Join a bigger club, search for more playing time or stay and become a club legend.
BECOME A SOCCER STAR
Go from prospect to established soccer player as you build your reputation throughout your career.
Improve your skills, earn a starting position, become captain and compete for individual awards. Your decisions and performances shape the story of your player career.
REPRESENT YOUR COUNTRY
Club football is only part of the journey. Earn international call-ups and represent your country on the biggest stage.
Score international goals, compete for major trophies and build a career that goes beyond your club.
WIN TROPHIES AND AWARDS
Fight for league titles, domestic cups and major international competitions. Chase individual awards, scoring records and career milestones as your trophy collection grows.
Can you build a career worthy of a football legend?
MAKE CAREER-CHANGING DECISIONS
A great career isn't only about what happens on the pitch.
Choose your clubs, manage your development, react to opportunities and make decisions that can change the direction of your career. Every save gives you another chance to create a different football story.
YOUR CAREER. YOUR LEGACY.
Start as a prospect. Become a regular. Develop into a star.
Build the ultimate football career and see how far your player can go in Club Legend.

bluejetty:00042154:ios.name: Kings Deals & Delivery
bluejetty:00042154:ios.summary:
Kings Grocery Deals & Delivery 
Shop, save & simplify your meal planning with Kings's all-in-one grocery app. Find everything you need, from fresh produce to pet food and pharmacy prescriptions.  Choose convenience that fits your schedule:
bluejetty:00042154:ios.description:
Kings Grocery Deals & Delivery 
Shop, save & simplify your meal planning with Kings's all-in-one grocery app. Find everything you need, from fresh produce to pet food and pharmacy prescriptions.  Choose convenience that fits your schedule: grocery delivery or DriveUp & Go™ grocery pickup service. 
CONVENIENT GROCERY DELIVERY OR PICKUP 
Get grocery delivery or choose DriveUp & Go™ for easy curbside grocery pickup. Use Schedule & Save to automate your household essentials and save more on every order. Flash™ 30-minute delivery available in select markets for additional convenience. 
SEND GROCERIES AS A GIFT 
Shop, add a personalized message & send fresh groceries, flowers, chocolates or everyday essentials to anyone — delivered to their door or ready for store pickup. Select "Make this order a gift" at checkout, with no extra gifting fees. It is the perfect way to care for loved ones, celebrate special occasions, send a thoughtful thank-you gift or help out a friend with a fully stocked fridge. 
MEET YOUR AI SHOPPING ASSISTANT 
Take the guesswork out of meals with Ask AI. Use everyday language to ask for recipe ideas, find items based on dietary needs or compare products. Whether you're asking "What can I make with chicken and rice?" or looking for "gluten-free snacks," our assistant helps you build your grocery list fast. 
MEAL PLANNING & RECIPES 
Get inspired with thousands of shoppable recipes designed to fit every budget and preference. Import your favorite recipes into the app to convert ingredients into a digital shopping list. Plan your weekly menu & add all necessary items to your grocery shopping list with a single tap. 
SHOP EASIER & FASTER 
Quickly add items to your cart based on frequent purchases, recommendations & past orders. View and reorder from your order history at any time. Save your favorite household items, scan barcodes at home to add products to your digital cart instantly and build repeatable shopping lists. 
LOYALTY, DEALS & COUPONS 
Maximize your budget by clipping digital coupons, tracking your reward points and watching your savings stack up automatically at checkout. Find hundreds of weekly grocery coupons, digital offers and exclusive sales. Earn, track and redeem Kings for U™ rewards automatically as you shop. Try FreshPass® for unlimited free grocery delivery on eligible orders, exclusive perks and subscriber-only savings. 
SECURE SNAP/EBT & WIC PAYMENT OPTIONS 
Use your SNAP/EBT benefits to easily pay for online grocery delivery and DriveUp & Go™ grocery pickup orders on eligible items, subject to state availability. WIC benefits are also accepted in store at participating Kings locations only. 
YOUR NEIGHBORHOOD PHARMACY & HEALTH APP 
Order eligible prescriptions in the app and pick them up curbside through DriveUp & Go™ at 1,700+ participating pharmacy locations nationwide. Transfer your prescriptions to save more on your next grocery order, refill scripts for your family or pets, schedule vaccine appointments, access health tests and manage your wellness goals with Sincerely Health. Choose to bundle your Rx with your grocery pickup in one easy trip or go pharmacy-only. 
BUILD HEALTHY HABITS 
Monitor your nutrition, steps, sleep and activity. Earn rewards as you eat better, move more and stay active through the Sincerely Health wellness hub. Take advantage of custom health insights, track your daily wellness metrics, unlock premium rewards for making positive health choices and set achievable goals that support your complete physical well-being. 
Download the Kings app and sign in or create your account to start shopping, saving and simplifying your week.
