bluejetty:00082821:ios.name: Mobile Org 2026
bluejetty:00082821:ios.summary: Mobile Org 2026 is designed to provide a powerful and authentic musical experience, letting you explore and create sounds across diverse genres and cultural styles. Whether you’re a beginner exploring rhythms or a seasoned musician seeking
bluejetty:00082821:ios.description:
Mobile Org 2026 is designed to provide a powerful and authentic musical experience, letting you explore and create sounds across diverse genres and cultural styles. Whether you’re a beginner exploring rhythms or a seasoned musician seeking new tones, Mobile Org 2026 is crafted to bring your musical ideas to life with ease.
Key Features:
Extensive Instrument Library:
Discover a rich array of authentic instrument sounds, including:
Stringed Instruments: Bağlama (traditional Turkish lute), guitar, violin, and saz.
Wind Instruments: Clarinet, saxophone, ney (traditional flute), zurna (double-reed woodwind), kaval, and duduk.
Percussion & Drums: A variety of rhythms and percussion styles that fit everything from traditional folk music to modern beats.
Keyboard Instruments: Piano, accordion, and organ sounds for more conventional or jazz-inspired compositions.
Unique Regional Instruments: Kanun (a string instrument with a unique tone), mey, trumpet, ud (Middle Eastern lute), and more. Mobile Org 2026 brings you a wide selection of sounds to suit any genre, from classical to contemporary music, world music, and more.
Diverse Rhythms to Set the Mood:
Mobile Org 2026 offers a rich selection of preset rhythms, including:
Traditional Rhythms: 2/4, 4/4, 9/8 and more, covering genres like Turkish folk, oriental, Arabesque, and Balkan music.
International Styles: Waltz, tango, bolero, and modern beats like pop, rock, and hip-hop.
Each rhythm is meticulously designed to enhance your music and can be tailored to suit your creative vision. Switch seamlessly between styles or blend rhythms to create unique soundscapes.
Microtonal Tuning:
With the microtonal tuning feature, you can adjust the pitch of each note to create authentic sounds that go beyond standard Western tuning. This is essential for traditional and ethnic music styles from the Middle East, Turkey, and beyond, allowing for more expressive, unique melodies.
Why Mobile Org 2026?
Mobile Org 2026 is more than just a music app; it’s a tool for musicians, students, and enthusiasts looking to explore a wide range of musical instruments and styles from around the world. With its realistic instrument sounds, customizable rhythms, and user-friendly interface, Mobile Org is perfect for practice, performance, or spontaneous musical inspiration. Whether you’re looking to create a solo melody, add rhythm to your recordings, or experiment with different musical scales,Mobile Org provides everything you need in one place.
Perfect for:
Professional and Amateur Musicians: Elevate your practice sessions, and add authentic sounds to your compositions.
Music Students and Teachers: An excellent educational tool to explore a variety of instruments and rhythms.
Anyone Passionate about Music: Discover new sounds, experiment with rhythms, and share your creations with ease.
Download Mobile Org 2026 today and start exploring a universe of musical possibilities!

Crazy Popcorn isn't just a short drama app—it's your personal entertainment companion that fits right in your pocket. Whether you're a newcomer or a seasoned drama enthusiast, Crazy Popcorn is your go-to platform for discovering, enjoying, and sharing high-quality skits and stories.

Are you looking for a better classic solitaire card game to relax your mind and train your brain?
This classic solitaire card game is very good for you if you like playing Classic Solitaire games, like Klondike solitaire, Spider Solitaire, Tripeaks Solitaire, Pyramid Solitaire, FreeCell Solitaire, and any Patience solitaire card game.
This classic Klondike solitaire card game is very addicting and challenging. Besides the very good experience of playing solitaire card games, this classic solitaire provides you great different gameplay from other card games as follows:
1. 150+ solitaire backgrounds for themes
2. Very different user experience in daily challenges
3. Play Solitaire card games to build your gardens
4. Play solitaire to run your flower shop
5. Play solitaire to run your cat shop 
Solitaire themes backgrounds card backs card faces
This Klondike solitaire card games has 150+ solitaire backgrounds. The backgrounds make your solitaire game more beautiful and interesting, including beautiful scenery, cute animals, pretty flowers, live fish, birds, and so on. And also it has 100 solitaire card backs and 10+ solitaire card faces.
Daily challenges
The daily challenges of this classic solitaire are interesting. Besides challenging Draw 1 card games and Draw 3 card games, there is also another challenge in which we can play solitaire games to collect animals or fishes in a match-3-like-game.
Solitaire Gardens
Our classic free solitaire card game with the unique gameplay of “Garden” is a good choice for relaxing and brain-storming! You can unlock gardens and collect sun shines by completing the solitaire puzzle, grow beautiful flowers, build and decorate your own gorgeous gardens and share with your friends!
Play solitaire to run your flower shop cat shop
There are also events for running flower shop and cat shop when you are playing solitaire card games. You will get orders and then play solitaire card games to complete the orders to get coins.
Play this popular free classic solitaire card game now! Our Klondike Solitaire game will bring you lots of fun and challenges, and also train your brain!

bluejetty:00160750:ios.name: Around Us: Travel guide & maps
bluejetty:00160750:ios.summary:
You walk past a facade, a statue, a little square, and keep going. Yet every one of these places has a story to tell.
Around Us helps you discover the places around you, then gives you a second reading of them: their history, their anecdot
bluejetty:00160750:ios.description:
You walk past a facade, a statue, a little square, and keep going. Yet every one of these places has a story to tell.
Around Us helps you discover the places around you, then gives you a second reading of them: their history, their anecdotes, their secrets. Wherever you are, around the corner or on the other side of the world, the city becomes a story.
▸ Discover what's around you
Open the map and millions of places appear, from must-see landmarks to hidden gems only locals know. Statues, viewpoints, charming lanes, historic cafés, parks, museums: filters help you find what suits you, and every place card gives you the essentials at a glance.
▸ Listen to the story of places
With the audio guide, put your phone away and look up. In one minute, a captivating narration tells you about the place in front of you: what happened there, who built it, the detail nobody notices. You no longer just walk by, you understand what you're looking at.
With Around Us+, more than 500,000 places have their own audio guide. Give your full attention to what you see, let the story carry you and leave with its secrets. Playback continues with the screen locked, and you can share it with your loved ones through SharePlay.
▸ Ask your travel assistant
"A nice brunch spot nearby?", "What to see in Lisbon in one day?": ask by text or by voice. The assistant suggests places, builds an itinerary and creates lists for you.
▸ Plan and live your itineraries
Choose your stops, organize your route on foot, by bike or by car, and fly over it in 3D before you even leave.
▸ See the world differently
In augmented reality, raise your phone: the places around you appear in their direction, with their distance. Perfect for finding your way and missing nothing.
▸ Save and share your discoveries
Save your favorites, build your collections (a street art walk in Berlin, the most beautiful viewpoints in Rome) and get inspired by other travelers' ones. Read their reviews, add your own, share your photos and reveal your own hidden gems.
▸ A community of curious minds
Around Us grows every day thanks to a community of passionate travelers. Follow those who inspire you, contribute and help others explore differently, away from tourist traps.
▸ Everywhere with you
On iPhone, iPad and Mac, Around Us is with you from planning your trip to the corner of your street.
▸ Around Us+
An optional subscription to go further: audio guides, travel assistant, augmented reality, premium filters, unlimited itineraries and collectible souvenir medals. The essentials of Around Us remain free.
Download Around Us and let curiosity guide your steps. Every place has a story: listen to it.

You walk past a facade, a statue, a little square, and keep going. Yet every one of these places has a story to tell.

Around Us helps you discover the places around you, then gives you a second reading of them: their history, their anecdotes, their secrets. Wherever you are, around the corner or on the other side of the world, the city becomes a story.

▸ Discover what's around you
Open the map and millions of places appear, from must-see landmarks to hidden gems only locals know. Statues, viewpoints, charming lanes, historic cafés, parks, museums: filters help you find what suits you, and every place card gives you the essentials at a glance.

▸ Listen to the story of places
With the audio guide, put your phone away and look up. In one minute, a captivating narration tells you about the place in front of you: what happened there, who built it, the detail nobody notices. You no longer just walk by, you understand what you're looking at.

With Around Us+, more than 500,000 places have their own audio guide. Give your full attention to what you see, let the story carry you and leave with its secrets. Playback continues with the screen locked, and you can share it with your loved ones through SharePlay.

▸ Ask your travel assistant
"A nice brunch spot nearby?", "What to see in Lisbon in one day?": ask by text or by voice. The assistant suggests places, builds an itinerary and creates lists for you.

▸ Plan and live your itineraries
Choose your stops, organize your route on foot, by bike or by car, and fly over it in 3D before you even leave.

▸ See the world differently
In augmented reality, raise your phone: the places around you appear in their direction, with their distance. Perfect for finding your way and missing nothing.

▸ Save and share your discoveries
Save your favorites, build your collections (a street art walk in Berlin, the most beautiful viewpoints in Rome) and get inspired by other travelers' ones. Read their reviews, add your own, share your photos and reveal your own hidden gems.

▸ A community of curious minds
Around Us grows every day thanks to a community of passionate travelers. Follow those who inspire you, contribute and help others explore differently, away from tourist traps.

▸ Everywhere with you
On iPhone, iPad and Mac, Around Us is with you from planning your trip to the corner of your street.

▸ Around Us+
An optional subscription to go further: audio guides, travel assistant, augmented reality, premium filters, unlimited itineraries and collectible souvenir medals. The essentials of Around Us remain free.

Download Around Us and let curiosity guide your steps. Every place has a story: listen to it.

bluejetty:00026832:ios.developer: Vacation and Travel Planner App LLC
bluejetty:00026832:ios.summary: Wanderlog is a free travel app (with an optional Pro subscription) for planning every kind of trip, including road trips and group travel: create a trip itinerary, budget costs, organize flight and hotel reservations, view places to visit o
bluejetty:00026832:ios.description:
Wanderlog is a free travel app (with an optional Pro subscription) for planning every kind of trip, including road trips and group travel: create a trip itinerary, budget costs, organize flight and hotel reservations, view places to visit on a map, and collaborate with friends. With Pro, you can also export your trip to Google Maps and link your Gmail account. After your trip, share a travel guide to inspire other travelers.
- See flights, hotels, and attractions in one place (like TripIt and Tripcase)
- View plans on a travel map & map your route (like Roadtrippers)
- Rearrange the order of places easily by drag-and-drop
- Planning a road trip? Add unlimited stops for free, optimize your route, view times & distances between places, and export places to Google Maps
- Planning group travel? Invite friends and collaborate in real-time just (like Google Docs)
- Automatically import reservations by forwarding emails or connecting your Gmail
- Add things to do from top guides with 1 click (like Tripadvisor and Google Trips/Google Travel)
- Access your trip plans offline
- Add notes and links to your stops
- Have your trip plans automatically sync across devices
- Set budget, track expenses, and split bills with a group
-------
SEE IT ON A MAP
Every time you add a place to visit, it’s immediately pinned on your Google Maps-based travel map. No need to pull up different travel apps and websites to organize plans and see them on a map - you can do it all in the Wanderlog trip planner app! Plus, if you’re visiting points in order, lines will connect the different pins on the map so you can see your route (perfect for road trips!). You can also export all your places to Google Maps too.
STORE PLANS OFFLINE
All your plans are automatically stored offline on the Wanderlog travel planner app - especially helpful during a road trip with poor signal and international travel.
GET ON THE ROAD
Looking for a road trip planner? Travelers can plan their trips and stops with Wanderlog. See your route on a map, or try our route optimizer to automatically rearrange and plan your route to save travel time. See estimated times & distance traveled between places to make sure it all fits, and total time and distance traveled for a given day to make sure you’re not driving too long. Plus, you can add unlimited stops along your road trip for free.
COLLABORATE WITH FRIENDS
For group travel planning, add your tripmates with their email address or by sharing a link to the itinerary. Like for Google Docs, everyone can collaborate in real-time. Set permissions and choose whether people can edit or just view your travel plans.
STAY ORGANIZED
Access flights, hotels, and attractions in one app. Forward flight and hotel confirmation emails to import them directly into your trip plan, or connect your Gmail to automatically add them. Prefer to keep high-level plans? Make generic lists like ‘Things to do’ and ‘Restaurants’ you want to eat at. Traveling on a tight schedule and want to create a detailed itinerary? Organize your day by adding start (and end) times, perfect for keeping track of tickets and reservations.
GET INSPIRATION & INFORMATION
For each place, see key info like a description and picture of the place, average user ratings with links to reviews, opening hours, address, website, and phone number. Stay inspired by exploring top travel guides from the web that feature viewpoints, attractions, and restaurants, and from lists from Google Trips and Google Travel, as well as by other Wanderlog users, and add things to do from those guides to your trip plan with 1 click.
CONTROL YOUR SPENDING
Set a budget for yourself or a group. Take control of your spending and keep track of all expenses. For a group trip, split a bill with other people and easily calculate the cost. Keep a record of who paid for what, how much everyone owes, and settle debts between tripmates.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00040766:ios.description:
Darkness has returned. Will you rise again?
Rupture: Immortal Slasher is a brutal offline dark fantasy action RPG where you play as an immortal knight on a quest for his lost soul. Fight, explore, and survive in a cursed medieval world ruled by death.
Master bloody hack-and-slash combat with real-time dismemberment and finishers.
Face hordes of zombies, demons, undead soldiers, and corrupted creatures. Every battle is a test of will.
Discover a Broken World
Travel through open, handcrafted locations: haunted castles, ruined villages, ice wastelands, and ancient temples. Each region hides secrets, side quests, and terrifying bosses.
Build Your Champion
Play as a Paladin, Berserker, Hunter, or Crusader
Loot dozens of rare weapons and armor sets
Upgrade your character and home base
Customize your style and combat abilities
Death Means Growth
You cannot die – only learn.

Offline. Full Experience
Play anytime, anywhere - completely offline.
No pop-ups. No internet needed. Just you, your sword, and the dark.
Key Features:
Immersive dark fantasy RPG
Fluid combat with blood & dismemberment
Massive exploration zones
Challenging boss fights
Offline play - 100% no Wi-Fi required
Unique armor & weapon sets
Deep lore & unfolding narrative
Perfect for fans of Soulslike and roguelike games
Your story begins at the edge of the sword. Download Rupture: Immortal Slasher and become legend in the land of the damned.

bluejetty:00023421:ios.name: Reminder & Countdown
bluejetty:00023421:ios.summary: The app is designed to remind you about all your important events, meetings, friends’ birthdays, a long-awaited TV Shows premieres, dentist appointments, coming-soon holidays, a wedding date and any upcoming events you don’t want to miss.
bluejetty:00023421:ios.description:
The app is designed to remind you about all your important events, meetings, friends’ birthdays, a long-awaited TV Shows premieres, dentist appointments, coming-soon holidays, a wedding date and any upcoming events you don’t want to miss.
Event information comes in a nicely-wrapped pack. All details (such as date and time, font, icon, alert sound, background and other options) can be configured according to your taste.
The app is complemented with excellent sharing options giving you an opportunity to send your reminders to anyone throughout the world via SMS, MMS, Email, Facebook, Twitter, Google+, Instagram, WhatsApp, Viber and other social networks and services.
KEY FEATURES:
- Multiple reminders
- Counting down in real-time
- Selection of timing units you wish to count down
- Sorting entries by date, name or applying a customizable sorting
- Individual names, time&date options, categories 
- Various icons
- Custom intervals to repeat events
- Configurable alerts before or after a due date
- Individual backgrounds
- A wide variety of fonts to choose from
- Formatting Dates and Times: Full, Short, and Abbreviated time units can be applied
- Importing birthdays from your Address book
- Importing events from the iOS Calendar app and Reminders app
- Changing the default event icon to a personal photo
- Set photos as background
- Sharing countdowns through all available ways sending the whole countdown screenshot or only a part of it
And you can also:
- Enjoy awesome, easy to use UI
- Make colourful notes
- Brighten up reminders
- Use the app as an alarm
Thank you for your thoughts, they are very valuable!
We are continued to make Reminder & Countdown even better, so never lose the drive to share your impressions and feedback with us at support@persapps.com

bluejetty:00096376:ios.summary: Discover the true value of your stamps with PhilSnap — the smarter way to identify, value, and organize any collection. Just snap a photo to recognize a stamp, see trusted market prices, get grading tips, and save it to your digital album.
bluejetty:00096376:ios.description:
Discover the true value of your stamps with PhilSnap — the smarter way to identify, value, and organize any collection. Just snap a photo to recognize a stamp, see trusted market prices, get grading tips, and save it to your digital album.
Perfect for beginners sorting an inherited album, collectors building a catalog, or resellers needing fast, consistent valuations — PhilSnap is your all‑in‑one philately companion.
What can PhilSnap do?
- Accurate Market Valuation
See real‑time price ranges by condition. Spot common issues vs. premium varieties before you buy, sell, or store.
- Instant Stamp Identification
Detect issuing country, year, face value, series/theme, watermark/printing type, and catalog references where available.
- Condition Guidance
Get grading suggestions (Fine, Very Fine, Extremely Fine, Superb) with cues on centering, perforations, gum, creases, and cancellations.
- Variant & Error Awareness
Flag potential varieties (perfs, color shades, overprints, plate flaws) to help you avoid mispricing.
- Postmark Insights
Note cancellations and covers that may add or reduce value.
- Organize Your Collection
Save scans, add notes and purchase data, track total value, and watch your collection grow.
- Learn & Explore
Read beginner guides, expert tips, and stories behind iconic issues and rare finds.
Why Choose PhilSnap?
 Accurate — Reliable stamp valuation in seconds
 Effortless — Point, scan, and get details without manual search
 Insightful — History, catalog context, and market trends at a glance
 Organized — Build a clean, searchable digital album
Premium Subscription
 Upgrade to Premium for unlimited identifications, exclusive market insights, and priority support.

bluejetty:00029272:ios.description:
Ideagen EHS (formerly known as ProcessMAP Mobile) is a comprehensive environmental, health and safety management app. With this app, you can effortlessly report workplace incidents and near misses, conduct audits, perform inspections, record observations, create & manage CAPAs and much more from the convenience of your mobile device.

· Enhance Employee Engagement: Empower employees to participate in safety initiatives through near miss and incident reporting, behavior-based observations and learning programs
· Improve Workplace Safety: Identify and address hazards proactively to prevent accidents and injuries
· Increase Efficiency: Streamline EHS management processes, saving time and resources for your organization
· Ensure Compliance: Simplify compliance with EHS regulations and standards, reducing the risk of fines and penalties
Key Features:
· Intuitive and user-friendly interface for ease of use
· Offline support enables working without an internet connection
· Picture annotation feature for enhanced visual communication
· Image compression functionality for efficient data handling
· QR code scanning tool for quick information retrieval
· Multilingual for global accessibility
· Push notifications keep you informed in real-time
· Signature capture for accountability and validation
· Voice-to-text functionality for convenient data input
· Face ID and Touch ID login options for enhanced security and convenience
· On-device data encryption and Single Sign-On (SSO) for enhanced security

-----------------------

RAM: 6 GB

bluejetty:00021336:ios.description:
American Red Cross volunteers, the Volunteer Connection app is now available! The mobile app is for existing volunteers only. Manage your activity with the American Red Cross conveniently via the new app! Hold the power of Volunteer Connection in the palm of your hand!
Volunteers can use the app to register for shifts, update contact information, submit hours, and other tasks typically managed in Volunteer Connection, the organization's volunteer management system. Now, all of which can be done with the tip and swipe of a finger!
Over 200,000 American Red Cross volunteers help ensure the organization prevents and alleviates human suffering every day. Many respond to disasters, teach life-saving skills to their communities, or support ongoing activities with their skills and talents.
The mobile app will allow existing American Red Cross volunteers to become more engaged with the organization, helping enhance the overall volunteer experience with the organization. Note: This app is for General Volunteers only at this time. Youth and Prospective Volunteers will not have access to the app, until further notice or until their intake process with their respective region is complete.
If you are not a registered volunteer and interested in becoming involved with the American Red Cross, please visit www.redcross.org today!
If you are having problems, please use the link above for assistance.

Key Features:
Scheduling: Manage appointments and track employee assignments effortlessly. Our intuitive calendar interface keeps your team organized and informed.
Messaging: Streamline communication within your team and with clients using our integrated messaging system. Stay connected and responsive, all in one place.
Built-In Phone & Calling: Make and receive calls right inside Homebase360 with our integrated VoIP phone system. Get your own business line, handle incoming calls with full-screen caller alerts, and keep every customer conversation in one place - no separate phone app required.

bluejetty:00080066:ios.description:
Nosher is more than just a food ingredients scanner — it's your essential partner for healthy living, food intolerances, clean eating, and safer shopping. Whether you follow a specific diet like gluten free, vegan, or low FODMAP, are concerned about pregnancy nutrition, or need to manage allergies, Nosher makes every bite safer and smarter.
Scan Smarter, Eat Better
Food packaging can be overwhelming and unclear. With Nosher, you no longer have to guess what’s in your food. Our powerful food ingredient checker gives you peace of mind every time you shop. Just scan a product, and Nosher breaks down its ingredients, highlighting any allergens, additives, or undesirable elements like palm oil, microplastics, or seed oils by scanning ingredient labels.
Categories & Groups: Tailoring to Your Needs
Nosher understands that health choices are personal. That's why we've organized our app into distinct categories and groups for allergy eats and clean product. Whether you're focused on personal health, the environment, vegan living, managing allergies, navigating pregnancy, or deciphering E numbers, Nosher has you covered.
Health Categories: Dive Deeper into Nutrition
Environment Categories: Sustainable Living
Vegan Categories: Cruelty-Free Living
Allergy Categories: A Safer Food World With Detailed Allergy Eats
Pregnancy Categories: Nourishing Your Pregnancy Journey
E Numbers Categories: Decoding Additives
Smart Shopping Tips:
Instant Scans: Scan labels on-the-go during grocery shopping for quick insights and good food.
Product Comparison: Compare products side by side and make informed choices.
Shopping Profiles: Create personalized shopping profiles based on your family's dietary preferences using Nosher food allergy app.
Family Profiles: Food Safety for Every Age!
Nosher food health scanner cares for your entire family. Create profiles for your baby, family members, and loved ones to detect food tolerances and allergies. Tailor your grocery choices to ensure the well-being of your nearest and dearest.
Vegan Friendly Living
Check is it vegan? Nosher is your ideal food checker companion! Seamlessly scan products with vegan scanner to ensure they align with your vegan lifestyle. Easily identify plant-based delights and make choices that resonate with your values.
Gluten Free? No Problem!
For those steering clear of gluten, Nosher is a game-changer healthy food scanner. Scan food labels with confidence, instantly detecting gluten containing ingredients. Use Nosher's Gluten free scanner and enjoy peace of mind knowing your choices are gluten free and tailored to your health dietary needs.
Dairy Free Delight
Embrace dairy free living with Nosher! Effortlessly scan products to verify their dairy content. Our app ensures you stay on track with your dairy free journey, making every food choice a step towards a healthier you.
Beyond Food: Microplastics & Palm Oil
Nosher goes beyond the plate! Check for microplastics and palm oil in your products, helping you make choices that are not just about health but also about sustainability. Stay informed about hidden ingredients and contribute to a healthier planet with scans.
Features at a Glance:
Ingredient Scanning: Instantly inspect food ingredient labels for detailed ingredient information.
Vegan Friendly: Tailored for the vegan lifestyle, helping you make cruelty free and healthier choices.
Gluten Detection: Effortlessly identify gluten containing ingredients for a gluten free diet with gf scanner.
Dairy Free Scanner: Verify and enjoy a dairy free lifestyle with Nosher's clean product scanner.
Beyond Food: Detect microplastics and palm oil, promoting a healthier planet and clean products.
Additives & Toxic Products: Explore additives, antioxidants, and antibiotics for a comprehensive ingredient view.
Cosmetic Check: Stay informed about harmful ingredients in cosmetics.
Privacy Policy:
https://nosherapp.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use
https://nosherapp.com/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00092747:ios.description:
Nebraska Bank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Nebraska Bank:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Nebraska Bank app, you must be enrolled as a Nebraska Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00013801:ios.description:

 - Transfer funds

 - View Statements
 - Send secure messages

To get started, please download the app and use the same username and password you have setup for America's Christian CU's Online Banking in order to login to Mobile Banking.

Build emotional resilience through gentle progressions that fit your lifestyle. Improve focus, sleep quality, and daily mental clarity.

5-minute daily lessons that fit any schedule
Gentle reminders to keep you on track
Mood and habit tracking to understand your patterns
Progress insights to see your growth over time
You're not chasing perfection – you're building a mindset that feels good.

Beginner-friendly content with progressive growth
Audio lessons include meditations, affirmations, and breathing exercises

Personalized insights based on your quiz answers
Daily mood tracking to identify patterns
Habit monitoring to see what influences your well-being
Guidance rooted in psychology and cognitive-behavioral techniques

Measure positive change – watch negative thoughts decrease and healthy habits strengthen over time
Celebrate breakthroughs – highlight days you overcome anxiety, break cycles, or choose differently

bluejetty:00165996:ios.description:
Meet the future of interval training.
GymNext Flex Timer is the only timer app that combines powerful workout programming with control of large, wall-mounted LED displays—giving you the best of both worlds.
Traditional gym timers rely on clunky remotes and are difficult to use. Mobile apps are flexible, but hard to see across the room. Flex Timer solves both. Build and control your workouts from your phone while displaying them on bright, easy-to-read LED screens anywhere in your gym.
Perfect for HIIT, CrossFit, circuits, bootcamps, boxing, MMA, strength training, and more.
Features:
• Use the app on its own or connect to GymNext LED displays for maximum visibility
• Core timer modes include Count Up/Down, Round, Tabata, EMOM, Mixed Intervals, and Sets with Rest
• Plan your personal workouts or full classes in advance—everything ready in one tap
• Share timers with athletes and trainers instantly using simple links
• Save workouts to your library for quick access
• Control your timer from Apple Watch—completely hands-free
• Smart audio sync keeps your music and timer cues perfectly aligned
• Connect multiple Bluetooth heart rate monitors and track performance in real time
• Set custom heart rate zones for better training feedback
• Control multiple timers across your gym at the same time
• Run different workouts simultaneously for group training
• Reliable Bluetooth control with no line-of-sight limitations
“This will eventually become the standard for all gyms” – Garage Gym Reviews
“All our coaches love the clock” – CrossFit Barrie
“We love it to death” – Wolverine Strength & Conditioning
Download Flex Timer and upgrade the way you train.
We’re always improving. Have feedback? Reach us at support@gymnext.com

bluejetty:00144730:ios.description:
ZikrApp – The Complete Muslim Dhikr & Habit Tracker (Ad-Free)
Your All-in-One Islamic App for Dhikr, Duas, Qaza, Fasting & Habits
Prepare for Ramadan
Transform Your Worship, Every Day
ZikrApp is your essential Islamic companion—helping Muslims track dhikr, manage qaza prayers, schedule fasts, and build lasting habits, all in one beautiful, ad-free app.
Never miss a moment of remembrance:
Forgot your tasbih? Use the digital counter.
Need to make up missed (qaza) prayers? Track and complete them easily.
Want to schedule nafl or Ramadan fasts? Get reminders and progress charts.
Build and track Islamic habits—Tahajjud, Duha, charity, Quran reading, and more.
Access authentic dhikrs and duas from Quran & Sunnah, organized for daily use.
Key Features
Dhikr & Tasbih
100+ authentic dhikrs from Quran & Sunnah
Digital tasbih counter & auto-dhikr mode
Create custom dhikrs and wirds
Qaza & Fasting Tracker
Qaza prayer calculator & tracker
Nafl and qaza fasting schedules with reminders
Ramadan makeup tracking & progress stats
Habit Tracker
Track Islamic habits with daily/weekly charts
Streaks & achievements to motivate you
Custom habit creation
Smart Reminders
Prayer, fasting, and habit notifications
Fully customizable alerts
Analytics
Weekly/monthly progress reports
Fasting calendar & habit completion stats
Screen Time Blocker
Build a healthier relationship with your phone. Set a schedule, choose distracting apps, and let Zikr App gently guide you back to dhikr when it’s time. Includes one free try to experience it, then unlock unlimited access with Premium.
Interactive Home Screen Widgets
Stay consistent without opening the app:
Track your daily progress at a glance
Quick access to your tracker and key habits
Widgets update throughout the day to keep you motivated
Zikr App is built to be calm, simple, and motivating—helping you stay consistent every day.
Why ZikrApp?
Authentic Content: All dhikrs verified from Quran & Sunnah
All-in-One: Dhikr, qaza, fasting, habits—everything in one app
Offline Access: Worship anywhere, anytime
Modern Design: Clean, intuitive, and Islamic-inspired
Privacy First: Your data stays secure and private
Join thousands of Muslims worldwide using ZikrApp to enrich their spiritual journey. Perfect for new Muslims, busy professionals, students, and families.
Download ZikrApp now and make dhikr, qaza, fasting, and Islamic habits a seamless part of your daily life.
Assalamu alaikum!
— The ZikrApp Team

Win the election, take office, and find out how hard it is to keep the job. As prime minister, every promise, alliance, and scandal is yours to manage - and the next vote is always closer than it looks.
Prime Minister Simulator is a choice
bluejetty:00173218:ios.description:
Win the election, take office, and find out how hard it is to keep the job. As prime minister, every promise, alliance, and scandal is yours to manage - and the next vote is always closer than it looks.
Prime Minister Simulator is a choice-based political simulation with tycoon progression, interactive stories, government management, and mini games. Each decision shapes your country, your cabinet, and your chances of staying in power.
CHOOSE YOUR PATH
Enter different story arcs and decide what kind of leader you become. Respond to crises, negotiate with rivals, answer the press, and choose which promises you actually keep.
WIN THE ELECTION
Run the campaign, pick your platform, win the debates, and watch the results roll in. Then do it all again before your term runs out.
RUN THE GOVERNMENT
Manage the budget, pass laws, develop national systems, and balance what the people want with what the country can afford. Approval can rise, fall, or collapse overnight.
BUILD YOUR CABINET
Appoint ministers, reward loyal allies, and keep an eye on the ambitious ones. Coalitions hold your government together - and can bring it down.
GROW THROUGH TYCOON PROGRESSION
Upgrade institutions, unlock new policies, strengthen your party, and turn smart decisions into lasting progress. Watch your influence and your nation develop over time.
PLAY MINI GAMES
Take part in additional challenges - debates, press conferences, late-night votes - that break up the story and test your political instincts.
FACE THE CONSEQUENCES
A crowd-pleasing promise may wreck the budget. A tough reform may cost you the next election. Every choice can change the direction of your story.
Made for players who enjoy political simulator games, election games, government management, choice games, interactive stories, text RPG adventures, strategy games, and tycoon progression.

bluejetty:00062604:ios.name: Proloquo2Go AAC
bluejetty:00062604:ios.summary: Tap images. Type words. Speak. Proloquo2Go is an easy to use communication app for people who cannot speak or need help being understood. Featuring natural sounding voices, including real children’s voices, Proloquo2Go is a simple yet power
bluejetty:00062604:ios.description:
Tap images. Type words. Speak. Proloquo2Go is an easy to use communication app for people who cannot speak or need help being understood. Featuring natural sounding voices, including real children’s voices, Proloquo2Go is a simple yet powerful AAC (augmentative and alternative communication) tool. The app is fully customizable and can be utilized to build language skills and grow with a person’s communication, supporting both beginning and advanced communicators.
Parents, therapists, teachers and users around the world recognize Proloquo2Go as the gold standard in AAC solutions. The app is used by people with autism, Down syndrome, cerebral palsy, Angelman syndrome, and others with speech difficulties. The app is available in English, Spanish, French, and Dutch and supports bilingual use, so you can switch languages on the fly.
Proloquo2Go in action:
Learn and grow
Studies show that just 200-400 words make up 80% of what we say. Known as core words, they act as the basis of Proloquo2Go’s research-based Crescendo™ vocabulary. Users can grow from single words to full sentences in the same app. Crescendo puts core words in consistent locations for easy access and motor-planning. The vocabulary works with AAC best practices like modeling (where you use an AAC system to talk with the user) to develop language skills. Crescendo offers no limit on language development with a 10,000+ fringe word vocabulary and customizable vocabulary levels. Finally, with Progressive Language, words are gradually revealed step-by-step, helping users learn words and their location as their communication expands.
Easy editing
Customizing Proloquo2Go is a breeze! Quickly and easily add new words. Use the app’s built-in library of 25,000 symbols or use your own photos by taking pictures within the app or selecting them from your photo library. For users with fine-motor challenges and vision impairments, Proloquo2Go offers options like 23 pre-programmed grid sizes and accessibility settings which support switch scanning and Apple’s VoiceOver screen reader. Everything from appearance to access is customizable so you can make it your own. 
Type and speak
Besides tapping images, Proloquo2Go also lets you type what you want to say. The app includes a Grid Keyboard arranged alphabetically for people learning to type. For more experienced typists, Proloquo2Go includes a Typing View with a QWERTY keyboard and word prediction that offers suggestions based on what you are typing. 
Hello! ¡Hola! Bonjour! Hallo!
Proloquo2Go lets you select a language and region for the Crescendo vocabulary. Two languages can be used at the same time, allowing seamless bilingual speech. Over 100 included downloadable natural-sounding adult and children’s voices rounds out your choices to use the app your way.
A helping hand
AssistiveWare is here for you every step of the way. Help articles in Proloquo2Go are there whenever you need them. New to AAC? Our website has easy to understand articles in the Learn AAC section, and the AssistiveWare Core Word Classroom includes activities for teaching communication effectively. You can also connect directly with our community of parents, professionals, and users on our Facebook groups. If you have any questions, our support team is available 7 days a week and is always happy to help. All of these online resources can be accessed by going to the AssistiveWare website. 
Note: Discounts are available through Apple’s Educational Volume Purchase Program – 50% off on 20 licenses or more. Joan Bruno’s Gateway to Language & Learning© vocabulary is available as an in-app purchase (English only).
In order to use Proloquo2Go on Apple Watch, it must be paired with an iPhone.

bluejetty:00063560:ios.description:
Jewel Mania - The new match 3 sensation is here, with brilliant jewels in over 600 dazzling puzzles!
Accompany your perky pup on a magical journey filled with waves of excitement and brilliant visuals! Swap jewels to clear the way, and match 4 or more pieces to crush each challenge that lies ahead.
Jewel Mania – the ultimate free puzzle game!
JEWEL MANIA FEATURES:
MATCH JEWELS in 600+ unique puzzles!
- Match jewels to blast your way through more than 600 different puzzles! Each match you create will propel you one step farther in this amazing fantasy world.
DAZZLING PUZZLES challenge you to keep the fun flowing!
- Flow from one challenge to the next as you crush puzzles with ease! Match jewels to keep the puzzle blitz going! Don’t miss a beat, or your game might just be over.
CREATE COMBOS and trigger amazing cascades!
- Ignite crazy combos by using rare jewels at the right time. Blast the board clear and watch your score blossom!
DISCOVER rare Magic Diamonds and Rainbow Stars!
- Use the mysterious power of Magic Diamonds to make big matches, and channel the force of colorful Rainbow Stars to match your way out of tight spots! With powers like these, you’ll have a blast matching your way through our games.
MASTER tricky obstacles like walls, pitfalls, and puzzling portals!
- Different games challenge you with different obstacles. Avoid pitfalls and flow through portals as you progress through this mysterious, magical saga!
VISIT beautiful backgrounds and amazing places with your puppy companion!
- Head out on an epic saga as you and your magical companions travel across mystical worlds solving confounding puzzles.
EASY TO LEARN - hard to master! Can you earn 3 stars on every level?
- Use every bit of magical strength you have to crush each level’s high scores! You’ll only earn 3 stars when you have truly mastered each area.
TOP-NOTCH performance! Animated jewels, effects, and characters!
- Watch in awe as magical effects blossom to blast the board clear. Experience amazing animations and incredible effects!
FREE updates with new puzzles, boosts, and more!
- Jewel Mania is totally free to download and free to play! Watch out for even more free updates as time goes on.
Jewel Mania is the BEST-looking FREE jewel matching game for your iPhone, iPad or iPod Touch! Immerse yourself in a magical kingdom filled with match 3 puzzles, cute companions and mystical mystery.
Fans of candy and jewel games will love Jewel Mania! Download today and start your adventure! 
Please note: Your device must have an active internet connection to download additional levels.
Please note that Jewel Mania™ is free to play, but you can purchase in-app items with real money. To delete this feature, on your device go to Settings Menu -> General -> Restrictions option. You can then simply turn off In-App Purchases under "Allowed Content". In addition, Jewel Mania™ may link to social media services, such as Facebook, and Storm8 will have access to your information through such services.

bluejetty:00062919:ios.description:
Find out what your partner really wants — together, on one device.
This fun and intimate 2-player quiz game helps couples get closer by discovering what they truly know about each other.
Answer questions about yourself and your partner, then take turns guessing each other’s answers. You’ll learn more about preferences, boundaries, and desires — all in a playful, respectful way.
Perfect for date nights, cozy evenings, or anytime you want to spark meaningful conversations.
How it works:

bluejetty:00015274:ios.name: GraphNCalc83
bluejetty:00015274:ios.summary: GraphNCalc83 uses touch, color and blazing speed to handle your math problems. The familiar calculator keyboard, arrow keys and functions are enhanced with full touch input for all graphs, editors and menus. Enter calculations in natural te
bluejetty:00015274:ios.description:
GraphNCalc83 uses touch, color and blazing speed to handle your math problems. The familiar calculator keyboard, arrow keys and functions are enhanced with full touch input for all graphs, editors and menus. Enter calculations in natural textbook format. Enter fractions and view result as fractions. Trace graphs with your finger. Zoom in and out with a pinch. Explore regressions with a tap on the screen. Scroll through the list, matrix and calculation history with a swipe. Tap the ? key for help. Written using the latest 64 bit math libraries, GraphNCalc83 harnesses the amazing computing resources of the iPhone and iPad to provide a colorful, fast and fluid experience. Graphs scroll, glide and zoom smoothly. Matrix, statistics and BASIC programs run 500x times faster than traditional calculators.
GraphNCalc83 includes:
Algebraic entry: Enter problems using full algebraic textbook notation. The command line editor includes interactive parenthesis matching and high lighting, undo and redo, bubble function help and a 200 level calculation history and recall stack. Generate a PDF report of calculations for mailing or printing using the SEND function.
Math functions: Trigonometry, logarithms, function minimum, maximum, numeric integration and derivatives, general solver, real and imaginary numbers, combination, permutation, random number generation, normal, T, chi squared, Fisher, poisson and geometric distributions, binary shift and rotate, test and logic operations, list operations including sort, std. deviation, sum, sequence, matrix determinant, transpose, sum, ref, rref, addition, multiplication.
Graph functions, parametric, f(x,y) and polar equations and statistics plots: Full color graphs with touch to trace, pinch zoom, function minimum, maximum, intersections, asymptotes and numeric integration. Output graphs in high resolution PDF format for mailing or printing. Interactively explore function behavior using variables tied to slider bars.
Statistics, Inferential Statistics and Distributions: A set of inferential statistics worksheets and graphs of distributions are included. The regression analysis screen allows you to quickly compute, view and analyze a data set using a variety of curve fitting methods.
Table: Analyze functions using the table viewer. Use the split screen mode to simultaneously view a graph and table.
Matrix and Lists: Matrix and list editors and a full set of matrix and list operations are built in.
Unit Converter and Constants: Convert between a wide variety of scientific, engineering and common units. A large set of physical constants are also included.
BASIC programming: Create, edit, debug and run BASIC programs. Programs run more than 500 times faster than traditional calculators. Import and execute .83p and .8xp files.
Chemistry: The calculator includes a full featured periodic table, a mass calculator and a data base of element properties. The touch interface allows you to view and interact with the periodic table to view by series, state, melting point, boiling point, electronegativity, electron affinity, valence, ionization, radius, hardness, modulus, density, conductivity, heat and year discovered.
Geometry: The geometry application computes perimeter and area for a variety of 2d geometric figures including squares, rectangles, parallelograms, triangles, polygons, circles, arcs and ellipses. A full triangle solver and interactive unit circle grapher are built in. Solve line intersections, project a point to a line and find a circle given 3 points.
Finance: Compute time value of money problems including annuities, lump sums and uneven cash flow analysis with IRR and NPV 
Built-in user guide: A user guide is included and is a touch away using the ? key or ⓘ on any menu. All functions have a full manual page with description of arguments and examples of use. Pop up bubble help displays function arguments during problem entry and program editing.

ChronosMap is an interactive timeline map for exploring people, events, and journeys across time and place.
Open a map to see where things happened, when they happened, and how different lives and events connect geographically. Move the timeline, inspect locations, follow personal trajectories, and discover dense areas of activity through visual map layers.

Add people, events, and trajectory points directly in the app, or import photos to automatically create location-based journey points from their time and GPS metadata. It is useful for personal travel memories, historical research, biographies, field notes, and any story that is best understood through both time and geography.
Key Features:
Interactive map with timeline navigation
People, events, and trajectory points in one unified view
Create and edit custom maps directly in the app
Import photos to generate personal journey points
Geo Lens for inspecting everything that happened around a location
Timeline markers that reveal periods of activity
Multilingual interface
Works across iPhone, iPad, and Mac
ChronosMap helps you turn scattered moments into a clear spatial timeline.
